### [92] [Scaling Articulated Rationales for MLLM-based Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17639)
*Haoke Xiao,Yueyang Liu,Yuhui Zhang,Xiang Chen,Yufei Liu,Jia Xu,Yalong Guan,Xiaolan Zhu,Xiaoyu Zhang,Shijun Wang,Shuang Yang,Zijie Meng,Zejian Zhang,Ruochen Yang,Xiangyu Wu,Tingting Gao,Han Li,Lantao Hu,Cheng Luo,Kun Gai*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出SARA框架,将稀疏的用户自然语言偏好解释(AURs)转化为可扩展的工业级推荐信号。该框架包含数据引擎、SARA-7B生成模型和SARA-Ranker排序模型,已在快手直播场景中部署并带来线上收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代推荐系统主要依赖点击、观看时长等隐式信号,只能反映用户"做了什么",而无法揭示"为什么喜欢或不喜欢"。自然语言形式的人为偏好解释(AURs)虽能提供极性感知和原因级别的文本信号,但天然稀疏、质量低、覆盖率不足(<1%),难以直接用于工业系统。

Method: 1) 数据引擎:通过问卷机制从2.4亿快手直播用户持续采集AURs,经延迟触发(10秒)、稀疏分发(概率5%)和阈值激励等机制,结合离线Agent Judge质量过滤,产出18.75万条高质量SARA-HQ数据集。2) SARA-7B:基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B,通过大规模SFT和Quality-Refining DPO(QR-DPO)将理性生成能力从8.6万作者扩展到1000万全量作者。3) SARA-Ranker:通过两种方式将正负向理由集成到排序模型——理由嵌入集成(基于MIM软对比学习对齐UA表征与正向理由)和理由SID集成(将负向理由量化为层级语义ID,用于跨作者负反馈建模)。此外还设计了六维度四等级的在线LLM评判器和离线Agent Judge评估框架。

Result: SARA-7B在作者不相交测试集上整体质量达3.33(1-4级),显著优于Gemini-3.1-Pro(2.51)和Qwen3-VL-8B(2.37),BGE-Sim达0.82。SARA-Ranker在线A/B测试中:正向集成带来Click +0.342%、Watch Time +0.986%、Follow +0.616%;负向集成使Hate降低8.164%、Report降低0.44%,LT-7提升0.027%。系统已部署并每日刷新运行超过30天。

Conclusion: SARA将稀疏的用户理由提升为工业推荐系统的一类一等文本信号,首次在工业规模上实现了理由级偏好信号的生产化部署,为社区探索高价值可扩展信号提供了参考。

Abstract: Modern recommendation systems largely infer user preferences from implicit behaviors such as clicks, watch time, and negative feedback, but these signals reveal what users do rather than why they like or dislike content. This work studies articulated user rationales (AURs), i.e., users' natural-language explanations of their preferences, as a new class of polarity-aware and reason-level textual signals for recommendation. Despite their potential value, AURs are difficult to use in industrial systems because they are naturally sparse, often low-quality, and only cover a small fraction of items. We present SARA (Scaling Articulated Rationales), an industrial framework that turns sparse AURs into scalable recommendation signals. SARA first builds a data engine that elicits and curates AURs from 240M Kuaishou Live users, producing SARA-HQ, a quality-controlled and author-centric rationale dataset. It then aligns a general-purpose MLLM into SARA-7B through large-scale SFT and Quality-Refining DPO, extending rationale generation from 86,564 AUR-covered authors to the full 10M-author space. Finally, SARA-Ranker integrates the generated positive and negative rationales into production ranking via rationale-aware interaction modeling and rejection-memory modeling. Extensive offline evaluation, human calibration, and online A/B tests show that SARA-7B generates more specific, polarity-consistent, and grounded rationales than strong MLLM baselines, while SARA-Ranker improves engagement and reduces negative feedback in production. Deployed with daily refresh for over 30 days, SARA establishes articulated rationales as a practical, first-class textual signal for industrial recommendation systems.

</details>


### [93] [One Size Does Not Fit All! Dynamic Retriever and Generator Selection for RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17709)
*Neeraj Anand,Payel Santra,Partha Basuchowdhuri,Debasis Ganguly,Sumit Bhatia*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出DRAG框架，针对RAG系统固定retriever-generator配置导致的计算资源浪费问题，通过查询自适应地选择retriever-generator配置，在3个LLM家族和4个QA基准测试上实现了优于静态RAG管道的效果-效率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG系统通常对所有查询采用统一的retriever-generator配置，但不同查询在复杂度和信息需求上存在显著差异，这导致计算资源分配效率低下。尽管retrieval和generation的适应性已被独立研究，但它们的联合效应对端到端RAG性能的影响尚未充分探索。

Method: 本文提出DRAG（Dynamic RAG）框架，包含两种实例化方法：(1) DRAG_QPP——一种无需训练的路由方法，利用Query Performance Prediction（QPP）信号（使用Average IDF）指导retriever选择，并基于检索上下文的困惑度指导generator选择；(2) DRAG_SFT——一种监督路由方法，微调LLM（Qwen3-4B-Instruct）以联合预测retriever-generator配置并输出结构化JSON。实验涵盖4个retriever复杂度级别（BM25、E5、E5+BGE重排序、查询分解+BGE重排序）和3个LLM家族（GPT-OSS、Qwen-3、Gemma-4），在TriviaQA、HotpotQA、MuSiQue（域内）以及FRAMES（域外）4个QA基准上进行评估。

Result: 实验结果表明：(1) 检索质量的提升通常比生成能力的扩展带来更大的收益，但两者都呈现递减和非单调的回报；(2) DRAG_QPP在保持与强静态基线相当性能的同时大幅降低推理延迟；(3) DRAG_SFT在效果上持续优于静态基线和训练-free的自适应基线；(4) 在FRAMES域外评估中，两种方法均优于所有基线，展现出良好的泛化能力。失败案例分析揭示了三种主要错误模式：过度估计、估计不足和实体错误。

Conclusion: 本文的结论是，RAG中增加复杂度并不一致地提升准确性，高复杂度配置并非低复杂度配置的严格超集，这凸显了RAG的非单调、查询依赖特性以及固定retriever-generator设置的局限性。DRAG框架通过联合自适应retrieval和generation，相比静态RAG管道实现了更有利的效果-效率权衡。未来工作将聚焦于开发更具表达力的路由策略，以更好地捕捉retrieval和generation之间不可分的交互作用。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems typically employ fixed retriever and generator configurations across queries, despite substantial differences in query complexity and information needs, leading to inefficient allocation of computational resources. While retrieval and generation adaptivity have been studied independently, their joint effect on end-to-end RAG performance remains underexplored. We systematically analyze how retriever and generator complexity interacts across factoid and multi-hop question answering (QA), including bridge and composition reasoning tasks. Our analysis shows that stronger retrieval generally yields larger gains than increased generation effort, but both exhibit diminishing and non-monotonic returns, indicating that higher-complexity configurations are not uniformly better across queries. Motivated by these findings, we introduce DRAG, a query-adaptive framework for selecting retriever-generator configurations. We first propose DRAG$_\text{QPP}$, a training-free routing approach that uses Query Performance Prediction (QPP) signals to guide retriever selection and perplexity-based measures over retrieved context to guide generator selection. We further introduce DRAG$_\text{SFT}$, a supervised routing approach that fine-tunes an LLM to jointly predict retriever-generator configurations. Across three LLM families and four QA benchmarks, \qpprag~achieves performance comparable to strong static RAG baselines while substantially reducing inference latency, whereas DRAG$_\text{SFT}$ consistently improves effectiveness over static and training-free adaptive baselines. Overall, DRAG demonstrates that jointly adapting retrieval and generation achieves a more favorable effectiveness-efficiency trade-off than static RAG pipelines.

</details>


### [94] [Quanta: A Self-Contained Python Library for Hybrid Retrieval over Quantised Embeddings, Lexical Indexes, and Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18248)
*Ioannis E. Livieris*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Quanta是一个自包含的Python混合检索库，统一了4-bit量化向量搜索、BM25全文检索和知识图谱遍历，通过单一API提供加权倒数排名融合(WRRF)和两阶段检索（图作为候选扩展器而非相关性评分器），并以临床知识图谱部署为案例展示其行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高级RAG流水线通常需要组合多个独立系统（向量索引、全文搜索引擎、图数据库、关系文档存储），每个系统都有独立的部署面、配置模型和故障模式，集成逻辑在每个项目中都要重写。现有混合检索栈存在两个核心问题：(1)异构分数归一化到统一范围是查询相关的，因此是不恰当的；(2)将图视为独立的索引路径而非融合排名的一部分，且未明确划分候选生成与相关性评分的职责。

Method: Quanta采用单进程MultiRetriever架构，通过异步search()统一调度：向量压缩使用turbovec（TurboQuant实现）存储4-bit量化向量并执行精确搜索（而非ANN）；文档存储支持PostgresDocStore (asyncpg+JSONB+GIN索引)和DuckDBDocStore；融合机制采用加权倒数排名融合(WRRF)处理不可比分数；知识图谱采用两阶段算法——第一阶段通过内容检索产生seeds，第二阶段通过有界BFS遍历扩展候选集，新纳入文档通过dense索引在identifier allowlist约束下重新评分。

Result: 在包含100位患者、30位医生、12项ICD-10诊断、12种程序、12种药物和5家医院的合成医院记录Neo4j图谱上，使用3个dense索引（诊断/程序/患者摘要）+ Tantivy BM25 + 图扩展。k=6、三seeds、两hops配置下，候选池从18增长到59-60（约3.3倍），其中41-42为新文档，约70%获得重新评分；dense与dense+BM25搜索耗时7-9ms，启用图扩展后查询时间升至44-115ms。临床案例中，"heart failure and dyspnoea"查询通过COMORBID_WITH边将E11(2型糖尿病)从第6位提升至第4位，纯由content证据驱动排序。工具调用代理部署中，27B开源模型回答6个未见临床问题无错误，工具执行19-984ms，仅占轮次延迟（19-32s）的不到5%。

Conclusion: Quanta展示了将语义、词汇和结构信号统一于轻量Python库的最小依赖架构。其核心设计原则是分离候选生成与相关性评估：知识图谱仅用于通过有界结构遍历扩大候选集，语义和词汇证据负责排序。4-bit量化向量的精确搜索显著降低内存占用（768维向量从2.86GiB降至366MiB），identifier allowlist同时支持元数据过滤和图扩展候选的受限重评分。可选组件（null implementations）支持从纯dense检索平滑演进到dense-lexical-graph混合检索。论文承认这是系统描述而非受控检索评估，未来工作需在相关标注基准和替代混合排序器上进行对照实验。

Abstract: An advanced retrieval-augmented generation pipeline is typically assembled from three or four independently operated systems: an approximate nearest-neighbour index, a full-text search engine, a graph database, and a relational document store. Each contributes its own deployment surface, configuration model, and failure modes, and the integration logic that binds them is written anew in every project. In this work, we present \textsc{Quanta}, an open-source Python library, which unifies dense vector search over 4-bit quantised embeddings, BM25 full-text retrieval, and knowledge-graph traversal behind a single retrieval API. Quanta makes two design commitments, which distinguish it from existing hybrid retrieval stacks. First, signals are combined by \emph{weighted reciprocal rank fusion} rather than by normalising heterogeneous scores onto a shared range, which we argue is ill-posed because such normalisations are query-dependent. Second, the graph is a \emph{candidate expander and not a relevance scorer}: traversal widens the candidate pool, and the newly admitted documents are re-scored by the dense indexes under an identifier allowlist, so structural adjacency determines what is considered while content evidence determines how it ranks.

</details>


### [95] [PageRecall: Measuring Page Selection in Literature-Grounded Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18154)
*Aaditya Chauhan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文针对LitTraceQA（EMNLP 2026 GroundLM共享任务）提出PageRecall系统，核心发现是文献问答中证据定位的瓶颈在页面选择器而非阅读器。系统通过"展示整篇论文"取代页面选择，将黄金页面召回率从52.6%提升至100%，并引入结构性解析锚点、选项顺序投票纠偏和预发射蕴含门控等组件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 区分证据定位失败中"选择器"与"阅读器"的归因；揭示以往混合指标下被掩盖的组件级失败（页面选择仅52.6%召回、凑数启发式降低F1、选择题末位选项位置偏差）。

Method: 两阶段流水线：(1) BM25+密集检索+首字母匹配+LLM筛选定位论文；(2) 页面选择→证据定位→视觉转录→合成→验证→蕴含门控。关键创新——取消页面选择直接喂入全文；四种结构化锚点（命名对象、方程标签、序数参考文献、图注术语）；选项位置置换投票；针对被引页面的蕴含审计。

Result: 测试集：论文F1 0.762，证据F1 0.441，选择题准确率0.920，综合分0.577。页面选择从52.6%→100%召回；移除凑数启发式后论文F1从0.517提升至0.762；选项顺序校正使选择题准确率从0.840提升至0.920。负面结果：蕴含门控判断与答案正确性近乎独立。

Conclusion: 在文档可装入上下文窗口时，页面排序问题在根本上是不必要的；应先测量选择器召回率再优化阅读器；公开调优选择不等同于经验证的选择；答案正确性与证据基础性是两个独立属性。

Abstract: We describe our system for LitTraceQA (GroundLM @ EMNLP 2026): given a research question, retrieve the relevant papers from a pool of 27,487, cite the page and the table or figure where the answer lives, and answer in a requested format. Our main finding is that evidence grounding is limited by retrieval, not by reading. The page selector put the annotator's page, which we call the gold page, in front of the model that locates evidence only about half the time (52.6% gold-page recall), while that model, given the page, cited the right one in 45 of the 48 locators it emitted (94%). When the page was missing it rarely said so: of 45 such cases it returned nothing 14 times, a wrong page 24 times, and a correct page 7 times, so the pipeline failed quietly almost twice as often as it failed visibly. Since the failure was that the right page was never shown, the fix is to stop choosing: each retrieved paper fits in the model's context, so we show it whole. Page ranking survives only as a fallback inside papers too long to fit, which no test-split paper was, and gold-page recall reaches 100% on the papers we can parse. Separately, questions that identify their target by position rather than content, such as "the first author of the 24th reference", are served by parsing rather than retrieval: we resolve the bibliography into an addressable list, which also supplies identifiers the evidence metric scores. The final system scores 0.762 paper $F_1$, 0.441 evidence $F_1$ and 0.920 multiple-choice accuracy on the held-out test split. Because the pipeline depends on a closed model without seed control, we release a harness that verifies the paper's central claims against committed artifacts.

</details>


### [96] [DUPAR: Dual-Path Conversational Retrieval via Speech Retriever with Cross-Turn Evidence Caching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18042)
*Yuanjun Li,Yiwen Liu,Dapeng Li,Zhiwei Xu,Bin Zhang,Shengtao Zhang,Rong Shen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: DUPAR提出了一种用于知识检索的语音助手对话检索框架，采用快慢双路径设计：快速路径直接通过音频编码器在跨轮证据缓存中检索，慢速路径融合全索引的音频与ASR文本检索结果。其核心创新在于通过训练与冻结BGE-M3文本嵌入对齐的音频编码器，避免ASR级联带来的延迟和错误传播，同时利用基于图的一跳邻居扩展来维护跨轮证据缓存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统级联方法（ASR+文本检索）存在两个核心问题：（1）ASR转录增加延迟并传播识别错误，尤其对专有名词、缩写等技术术语影响严重；（2）直接跨模态语音检索虽避免转录误差，但仍存在模态间对齐残差和声学噪声敏感问题。此外，多轮对话中当前查询常依赖前轮上下文，需要有效利用已检索证据作为先验。

Method: 1. 双路径检索机制：快速路径使用任务自适应的音频编码器（基于Qwen3-Omni初始化，前24层冻结并添加LoRA，后8层全微调，多尺度池化产生1024维嵌入）在跨轮证据缓存中检索；若缓存置信度低于阈值，慢速路径融合音频嵌入和ASR转录的BGE-M3文本嵌入的全索引检索结果。2. 跨轮证据缓存更新：选中的证据通过静态chunk关系图进行一跳邻居扩展，生成下一轮缓存。3. 训练损失：加权余弦相似度损失与音频-文本InfoNCE对比损失的组合，对模糊查询上采样。

Result: 在包含1890个文本块的领域知识库上：(1)音频编码器在干净语音上R@1达到67.6%，接近文本检索的67.7%，查询端延迟获得3.75倍加速，TTFT和TTFA分别减少146.3ms和144.0ms；(2)噪声基准测试中平均R@10从0.771提升至0.875，5dB信噪比下从0.608提升至0.862；(3)跨四种TTS说话风格的整体R@1提升4.2个百分点（65.40%→69.60%），四川方言提升最大；(4)证据缓存在满足条件时使R@1提升32.26个百分点（35.48%→67.74%），显著优于全索引检索。

Conclusion: DUPAR框架通过双路径设计有效平衡了检索效率与鲁棒性：音频编码器在接近文本检索精度的同时大幅降低延迟，且对噪声和说话风格变化更具鲁棒性。证据缓存机制在图连通性和前轮检索正确的条件下显著抑制干扰项。未来工作将评估完整路由与缓存刷新机制在真实多轮对话和更广泛声学条件下的表现。

Abstract: Voice assistants grounded in external knowledge typically use automatic speech recognition (ASR) to transcribe speech queries before retrieving evidence from textual knowledge bases. This cascade adds latency and propagates recognition errors, whereas direct speech retrieval is vulnerable to cross-modal misalignment. To address these limitations, we propose DUPAR, a conversational retrieval framework with complementary slow and fast paths. The fast path uses a task-adapted audio encoder aligned with frozen BGE-M3 text embeddings to search a cross-turn evidence cache. When cache confidence is insufficient, the slow path fuses full-index retrieval using audio and ASR-transcript embeddings, and the selected evidence refreshes the next-turn evidence cache through one-hop graph expansion. On a domain-specific knowledge base, our trained audio encoder approaches text-retrieval accuracy on clean speech with a 3.75$\times$ query-side speedup over ASR + Text Encoder. It raises average Recall@10 from 0.771 to 0.875 on the noise benchmark and improves overall Recall@1 by 4.2 percentage points across synthesized speaking styles. Compared with full-index audio retrieval, cross-turn evidence caching significantly reduces retrieval errors when the previous turn retrieves correct evidence and the follow-up targets a one-hop neighboring chunk.

</details>


### [97] [Single-Token Expected-Value Scoring for Cold-Start Candidate Ranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18188)
*Qihang Wang,Jinwei Tan,Mengyuan Shi,Mayank Sharma,Shuai Zhao,Fuxian Li,Ryan Yan,Alexander P. Kreuzer,Mohit Jain,Dheeraj Toshniwal,Manoj Seethamsetty*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出"单Token期望值打分"（Single-Token Expected-Value Scoring）方法，用于冷启动场景下的求职者-职位候选排序。该方法将相关性建模为对有序等级token {1,...,5} 的分类，通过首个token概率分布的数学期望得到确定性评分；并采用MSE+CE混合损失函数微调小型语言模型（Qwen3-8B+LoRA）。离线、端到端仿真及在线A/B实验均表明其优于启发式基线和零样本LLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 招聘领域的AI辅助候选人排序面临冷启动挑战：传统深度神经排序器需要数百万级交互日志，而低流量专业招聘平台缺乏此类数据；零样本LLM则存在输出不稳定、非确定性的问题。现有方法常采用启发式加权线性聚合，假设招聘标准之间可加可分，无法建模真实场景中复杂的非线性交互。

Method: 核心方法包含三点：（1）将候选人-职位相关性转化为有序分类任务，约束模型仅输出等级token {1,2,3,4,5}，以概率分布期望值作为确定性评分，无需开放式生成；（2）设计混合有序回归损失 L = 0.6·MSE + 0.4·CE，既保留等级间序数距离，又强化类别边界；（3）采用Qwen3-8B+LoRA微调（r=16, α=32），配合vLLM fp8推理、并发打分、特征并行获取等延迟优化技术部署。

Result: 离线实验：Qwen3-8B SFT (200k) 在所有NDCG@k和Recall@k指标上优于启发式基线和零样本LLM；相邻等级对（5 vs 4, 4 vs 3）pairwise准确率超61%（启发式仅约51%），远程等级对（5 vs 1）达87.64%；ER期望值打分优于Peak Score p(5)（0.7353 vs 0.7306）。端到端仿真：雇主相关性NDCG@10 +3.1%~+5.9%，求职者相关性NDCG@10 +54.2%~+63.7%，低相关率降幅达23.8%~56.2%。在线A/B：雇主低相关率 -27.31%，雇主keep rate +7.07%，求职者高相关率 +33.79%。

Conclusion: 该工作证明：在严重数据受限的冷启动场景下，通过单Token期望值打分+混合有序损失微调SLM，能够构建兼具确定性、低延迟和高准确性的排序器；瓶颈会从数据量转移到基模型表征能力；研究成果已在Indeed生产环境部署并验证有效。

Abstract: AI-assisted sourcing streamlines candidate review, reducing the administrative burden of manual screening for recruiters. However, deploying language models as production rankers remains challenging. Zero-shot Large Language Models (LLMs) may produce unstable, non-deterministic scores and rank less accurately, while conventional deep neural rankers require millions of logged interactions that a low-traffic, niche sourcing platform does not produce. What is available instead is a few hundred thousand ordinal relevance labels -- small by ranker-training standards, but sufficient when a pretrained language model already encodes the general world knowledge the task depends on. We present single-token expected-value scoring, a ranking primitive that casts candidate-job relevance as an ordinal classification over the grade tokens {1, ..., 5} and reads the relevance score as the expectation of the first-token probability distribution. Because the score comes from a single decoding step rather than open-ended generation, it is a deterministic function of the model's logits, requires no output parsing, and serves at low latency. To learn the non-linear interdependencies of heterogeneous hiring criteria from this supervision alone, we fine-tune a Small Language Model (SLM) with a hybrid ordinal regression loss combining a Mean Squared Error term, which preserves ordinal distance, with a categorical Cross-Entropy term, which sharpens class boundaries. We evaluate along two dimensions -- Jobseeker Relevance and Employer Relevance -- using NDCG@10 and low relevance rate. Offline, our fine-tuned model outperforms a heuristic baseline and zero-shot LLMs. An end-to-end simulation shows the same direction at larger magnitude (+54.2% Jobseeker NDCG@10, -46.7% low relevance rate), and a live online experiment reduces employer low-relevance by 27.3% and raises employer keep rate by 7.07%.

</details>


### [98] [One-Step Retrieval Framework for Real-Time Sponsored Search Ads Using Hierarchical Text Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18296)
*Tongtong Liu,Renyu Zhang,Jiayu Ding,Hongchao Guo,Xintao Yang,He Wei,Zhaoyu Li,Haiyang Wu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: ANGLE提出了一种基于LLM的端到端广告检索框架，通过层次化文本表示（商业意图+广告摘要）和统一生成-判别-排序大模型（GDR-LLM），结合动态约束束搜索（DCBS），实现了一步式检索，在线上A/B测试中消费提升1.81%、GMV提升2.16%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统多级级联架构（MCA）存在各模块独立优化导致目标不一致、误差累积传播的问题；现有基于LLM的生成式检索方法使用离散语义标识符（SIDs），存在泛化性差、需记忆大量映射、解码效率低以及依赖小型奖励模型（如pctr）评估商业价值等局限。

Method: 1. 层次化文本表示：用LLM为广告生成商业意图（粗粒度SText，如游戏类型）和广告摘要（细粒度STerm，如品牌名），构建意图×摘要的倒排索引；2. GDR-LLM统一三任务训练：生成损失L_gen（交叉熵）+ 判别损失L_dis（基于[CLS]的BCE二分类）+ 排序损失L_dpo（DPO偏好优化），总损失加权求和；3. 动态约束束搜索（DCBS）：通过动态前缀树实时过滤无效的int-abs对，确保生成结果对当前用户有效；4. 检索流程：用户查询→GDR-LLM生成意图→DCBS生成有效摘要→倒排索引召回广告→直接送入排序模块，跳过传统的相关性和预排序阶段。

Result: 线上A/B测试（5天，20%流量）：WTS场景消费+1.81%、GMV+2.16%、点击+1.50%；QBS场景GMV+5.01%。离线评估对比7个基线（BERT、SimBert-v2、T5、Qwen-1.8B、Hunyuan-2B、DSI-1B等）：ANGLE-1B在HR@10/50/100、MAP、ACR上均最优（HR@10达0.1961，ACR达69.17%）。消融实验验证了Intent、Abstract、DCBS、GDR-LLM四个组件均不可或缺（去除任一部分性能下降显著）。在线推理采用L40 GPU集群（FP8量化），单卡30 QPS，端到端延迟控制在60ms内。

Conclusion: ANGLE通过层次化文本表示和统一的GDR-LLM框架，有效解决了MCA目标不一致和SIDs泛化性差的问题，简化了检索流水线（消除相关性和预排序模块），在工业级搜索广告场景验证了其有效性。未来将探索进一步去除精排模块的可行性。

Abstract: Traditional retrieval systems typically use multi-stage cascading architectures (MCA), where each module is optimized independently, leading to inconsistent objectives and the premature elimination of high-potential candidates. Recent LLM-based generation methods offer end-to-end solutions but use discrete semantic identifiers (SIDs) to retrieve ads, which are not learned by the base LLM and require memorization of numerous SID-to-ad mappings during SFT, suffering from limited generalization to unseen ads, high maintenance and update costs. The one-to-one mapping between SIDs and advertisements leads to inefficient decoding. Moreover, these methods rely on a small reward model (e.g. pctr) for relevance and ranking, limiting the LLM's ability to fully assess ads' commercial value. To address these challenges, we propose A uNified Generation-discriminative-ranking reaL-time rEtrieval (ANGLE) framework. ANGLE uses LLM-generated hierarchical textual representations, which consist of commercial intent that provide high-level overviews and ad abstract that deliver fine-grained details. Additionally, ANGLE integrates retrieval, relevance, and ranking directly within a single LLM, enabling precise and efficient ranking of ads by leveraging the full capabilities of the LLM. We applied ANGLE to the real-world search scenarios, achieving a 1.81% increase in consumption and a 2.16% increase in gross merchandise volume (GMV). We also conducted offline evaluations of ANGLE and seven baselines, with ANGLE outperforming all across key metrics such as HR and ACR.

</details>


### [99] [Exploring LLMs and RAG for Plausible and Explainable Material Prediction of Vehicle Components](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18437)
*Frederik Wagner,Annerose Eichel,Sabine Schulte im Walde*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文探索使用大语言模型(LLM)和检索增强生成(RAG)来预测车辆零部件的合理材料及其原因,研究发现标准LLM方法已大幅超越先前工作,但RAG方法并未带来实质性改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在汽车维修等高风险领域,LLM被用于辅助决策,但其针对特定领域(如零部件材料)的可靠性和可解释性尚未充分评估。本研究旨在探索LLM是否能在无需大量微调的情况下,准确预测车辆零部件的合理材料并给出解释。

Method: 研究对比三种方法:(1)标准生成式LLM基线(No-RAG),(2)单轮检索增强生成(RAG),(3)迭代式Chain-of-Verification(CoVe)。使用Wikipedia领域过滤语料,结合BM25稀疏检索和DPR密集检索的混合检索管道,测试开源模型Mixtral-8x22B-Instruct-v0.1和闭源模型GPT-4o。开发了定制化的全栈标注工具,支持文本高亮、星标评分、拖拽排序等功能,由领域专家进行评估。

Result: 基线实验中,LLM方法在材料预测任务上大幅超越先前工作(coverage@1达100%,precision@1达97%)。在解释生成任务中,三种方法差异不大且不显著;No-RAG方法在偏好排名中表现最好(2.18),RAG和CoVe反而更差(2.71和2.61)。标注者间一致性差异显著:Task 1的IAA为0.63,但Task 3和Task 4的Krippendorff's α为-0.22和-0.23,表明实质性分歧。研究指出RAG未超越基线的原因包括:超参数优化不足、缺乏高质量合法可用的领域语料、专家评估研究设计存在挑战。

Conclusion: LLM(无论是否使用RAG)在车辆维修辅助领域具有实际部署潜力,但在该研究设置中RAG方法未能超越标准LLM方法。RAG系统仍面临超参数优化、高质量领域语料获取和专家评估设计等挑战。需进一步研究以充分释放RAG在此类任务中的潜力。

Abstract: In this work, we explore whether LLMs can accurately predict and explain plausible materials for vehicle components such as brake discs or fuel injectors without requiring extensive fine-tuning. We test and evaluate three approaches: a standard generative LLM baseline, a single-pass Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) approach, and an iterative Chain-of-Verification (CoVe) variant. For retrieval, we rely on publicly available data using a domain-filtered Wikipedia corpus. Since no gold standard exists for this task, we develop a custom web-based annotation tool supporting crucial functions for structured domain expert evaluation. LLM-based generation substantially outperforms prior work, which is not further surpassed by the tested RAG approaches. Our results surface remaining challenges for RAG-based systems: hyperparameter optimization, the availability of high-quality, legally accessible domain corpora, and expert evaluation study design.

</details>


### [100] [SURF: Subtractive Updates for Recommender Forgetting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18695)
*Filippo Betello,Antonio Purificato,Nicola Tonellotto,Fabrizio Silvestri*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: SURF提出了一种用于序列推荐系统（SRS）的轻量级近似机器遗忘框架，通过在嵌入空间识别目标物品的邻域、训练辅助模型并在推理时减除其分数，实现高效遗忘，无需完全重训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GDPR等隐私法规要求推荐系统支持"被遗忘权"。序列推荐系统因依赖时序交互模式而面临独特挑战：现有方法要么需要计算昂贵的完全重训练，要么未能考虑用户行为的序列特性。分片方法在推荐系统中效果差（用户物品高度互联），影响函数方法依赖的强数学假设常在实际中失效。

Method: SURF采用三阶段减法更新机制：(1) 在学习到的嵌入空间中识别目标物品的k近邻；(2) 在包含这些邻域物品的紧凑子集上训练轻量辅助模型；(3) 推理时从原始模型分数中减除辅助模型分数（公式：ỹ = f_M(S) - α·f_M'(S)）。理论分析包含三个性质：排序稳定性、局部扰动边界、影响移除保证。方法具有模型无关性、可逆性（原始模型不变）。

Result: 在7个数据集上对GRU4Rec、SASRec、BERT4Rec三种骨干模型的实验表明：(1) 遗忘效果：SURF在UL-MRR和UL-Recall上一致达到最优或次优，部分场景优于完全重训练；(2) 推荐质量：NDCG@20最高提升32%，FRBO排序稳定性优于多数基线；(3) 效率：训练时间仅为重训练的2%（最多节省50倍），推理时间在Yelp上仅为重训练的0.11×，远低于基线。超参数α=0.7、k=1取得最佳平衡。

Conclusion: SURF在遗忘效果、推荐质量保留和计算效率之间取得优越平衡，匹配或超越现有基线。理论保证（排序稳定性、局部扰动边界、影响移除）在实践中得到经验验证。由于原始模型参数不变，遗忘操作天然可逆，适合动态生产环境。未来工作将扩展到图像和文本领域。

Abstract: The increasing demand for user privacy and compliance with regulations such as GDPR has made machine unlearning a fundamental requirement for modern recommender systems. However, Sequential Recommender Systems (SRS) pose unique challenges for unlearning due to their reliance on temporal interaction patterns. Existing approaches either require computationally prohibitive full retraining or fail to account for the sequential nature of user behavior. We propose SURF (Subtractive Updates for Recommender Forgetting), a lightweight framework for approximate machine unlearning in SRS. SURF operates in three stages: (i) identifying the neighborhood of the item to forget in the embedding space, (ii) training an auxiliary model on this compact local subset, and (iii) subtracting the auxiliary model's scores from the original model at inference time. Experiments against five baselines on 7 datasets show that SURF achieves unlearning effectiveness comparable to full retraining while substantially reducing computational cost, yielding up to a 32% improvement in NDCG@20 while requiring just 2% of the original retraining baseline time budget. We share our code at this https URL .

</details>

### [101] [Linking Speakers of the German Parliament to Wikidata: Scope and Coverage of Metadata](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18289)
*Thomas Haider,Arne Cypionka,Maximilian Teich*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文将1949年至2021年间在德国联邦议院（Bundestag）发言的所有个人链接至Wikidata，构建了一个将议会演讲记录与结构化传记元数据相结合的纵向数据集，并评估了所检索属性与陈述的覆盖范围、构成及潜在偏差（尤其关注性别、职业背景、历史遗产及跨国维度）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 德国联邦议院官方"Stammdaten"目录仅覆盖民选议员（约87.5%），且元数据有限；而4000余名发言者中其余人员的传记信息分散于DBpedia、GND等资源，缺乏系统性整合。此外，议会数据中存在的性别、历史延续性（如纳粹时期遗留）及跨国维度等社会与意识形态偏差尚未得到系统性评估。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 基于GermaParl语料库提取全部4325名独立发言者及其党派信息，采用四步Wikidata匹配流程：（1）姓名+党派匹配；（2）姓名匹配（限议员）；（3）通用姓名匹配；（4）歧义或多匹配时人工核验。通过Wikidata查询服务检索所有谓词及陈述数据，按性别、职业背景、出生地、语言、外国奖项等维度进行分析。

Result: Wikidata对核心属性（性别、出生日期、语言、职业、国籍、出生地、GND/VIAF ID、党派、职位）的覆盖率高达98–100%；而教育经历（约24%）和官方传记链接（约44%）等CV类字段覆盖显著较低。约51%的发言者已故，348人拥有NSDAP党员编号（1925–1945），369人为纳粹党成员。性别分布呈历史性偏差（约79.4%男性，20.6%女性），但女性演讲占比从第一届的5%升至第18届的近40%。工作地点从波恩（64.6%）转向柏林（21.4%）。出生地包括弗罗茨瓦夫（29）、什切青（12）、格但斯克（9）等现波兰城市，反映二战后德意志人被驱逐的历史背景。语言数据中约15%发言者不以德语为母语，英语仅占1%，显示Wikidata记录不完整。奖项以德国为主，但也有相当数量的奥地利、芬兰和意大利奖项，体现德国-奥地利关系及战时同盟遗留。

Conclusion: 系统性链接德国联邦议院全部发言者至Wikidata揭示了核心传记与政治属性的高覆盖率与详细职业/背景信息的明显空白。该数据集将支持追踪性别平衡演变、政治专业化、政权遗产及跨国联系等长期研究，同时也暴露了议会与Wikidata中存在的结构性偏差与记录不均。未来研究可在该链接基础上连接演讲内容与人物志特征、考察历史延续性与断裂，并批判性评估开放知识图谱中政治行动者的表征方式。

Abstract: This paper links all individuals who spoke in the German Bundestag between 1949 and 2021 to Wikidata, creating a longitudinal dataset that connects parliamentary speech transcripts with structured biographical metadata. We evaluate the coverage, composition, and potential biases of the retrieved properties and statements, with particular attention to gender, professional background, historical legacies, and transnational dimensions such as place of birth, languages, and foreign awards. The results demonstrate both the analytical potential of combining GermaParl with Wikidata and the importance of critically assessing uneven metadata coverage in open knowledge graphs.

</details>


### [102] [Distribution-Aware Distributed Database Testing (Extended Version)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18501)
*Zhou Zhou,Si Liu,Hengfeng Wei,Min Zhang*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文提出DAT（Distribution-Aware Testing），一种面向分布式数据库管理系统（DDBMS）的自动化测试方法，通过系统性地利用数据分布信息来检测与分布式查询处理和优化相关的缺陷，并实现为工具DistRanger，在四个生产级DDBMS上发现31个新缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DBMS测试方法（如SQLancer、EET）主要针对集中式数据库，对分布式特性不敏感，难以触发多样化的分布式执行行为，且生成查询在DDBMS中的可执行率较低（如EET在Citus上仅25%可执行，而在PostgreSQL上为83%），显著限制了缺陷检测效果。同时，测试多样性与查询可执行性之间存在固有矛盾：增加查询复杂度能提升多样性，但会降低可执行性。

Method: DAT包含四大核心技术：(1) DDBMS实例生成：构建模式-分布矩阵（SDM），将逻辑模式与数据分布策略（如本地表、引用表、分布式表、共置表）系统化组合，提供结构化的测试空间；(2) SDM引导的查询变异：通过通用变异算子μ=(ρ,Δ)，包括策略替换（SR）、谓词注入（PI）触发分片路由、连接对齐（JA）触发共置连接；(3) 历史引导反馈机制：从AST中提取特征路径（feature paths），经规范化（基于有效分布角色）和节点级标注（优化标注SRP/CLJ、相关性标注COR）后与历史路径集匹配，过滤掉历史成功率低的不可执行模式，提升查询可执行性；(4) 缺陷检测：采用差异测试，比较同一查询在集中式与分布式部署下的执行结果。

Result: DistRanger在Citus、ShardingSphere、Vitess、ClickHouse四个生产级DDBMS上发现31个此前未知的缺陷，其中28个与分布式查询处理和优化相关；21个已被确认，15个已修复。在24小时对比测试中，DistRanger发现16个缺陷（含13个分布式相关），而SQLancer和EET分别仅发现0个和6个。查询可执行率显著优于基线（最高22.2倍提升），触发分片路由和共置连接优化的频率较基线提升最高达数百倍。消融实验表明查询变异（!MT）和反馈机制（!FB）均为关键组件。

Conclusion: DAT是首个系统性地将分布感知信息贯穿测试全流程的DDBMS测试框架，有效解决了测试多样性与查询可执行性之间的张力，显著优于现有集中式DBMS测试方法。该框架具有良好通用性，可通过扩展Δ规则支持聚合下推等其他分布式查询优化，并通过整合蜕变测试等oracle检测更广泛的缺陷类型。

Abstract: Distributed database management systems (DDBMSs) introduce new challenges for assessing their reliability due to distribution-specific characteristics that affect query execution and optimization. Existing testing approaches, largely designed for centralized DBMSs, often fail to explore diverse distributed execution behaviors and suffer from low executability of generated test queries, thereby limiting their effectiveness in bug detection. We propose DAT (Distribution-Aware Testing), a novel automated approach for detecting query-processing bugs related to distribution strategies and distributed optimizations in DDBMSs, by systematically leveraging distribution-aware information throughout the testing pipeline. DAT builds on a set of techniques that capture diverse combinations of logical schemas and data distribution strategies, and performs guided query mutation to trigger a wide range of distributed query execution behaviors and optimizations, while improving query executability via historical feedback. We implement our approach in a tool, DistRanger, and evaluate it on four widely used production DDBMSs. It uncovers 31 previously unknown bugs, including 28 related to distributed query processing and optimization, and outperforms state-of-the-art testers.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

### [103] [Making AI-Assisted Claims Independently Challengeable: Publication Authority and a Protocol for Falsifiable Publication Records](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17631)
*Torsten Olivi Tiltack,Yifei Dong,Kun Yu,Xu Wang,Wei Liu,Jianlong Zhou,Ren Ping Liu,Fang Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"发布权"（Publication Authority）概念及其形式化协议 PAC-2026 SF-4，用于防止 AI 辅助出版中的"沉默认识论提升"——即证据、分析、授权与展示因指向不同状态而使声明显得比联合记录所支持的更强。通过六项不可补偿的义务、一次性发布许可及可追溯生命周期，确保发布权限仅在完整、全新、全通过记录存在时方可获得。评估基于有限状态模型、不安全配置测试与历史实例路径，支持内部一致性、有界安全与有限可构造性，但不主张事实正确性、广泛部署或标准地位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 辅助出版中，证据、计算、人工授权、读者展示与更正历史可能指向不同状态，使声明"沉默地被提升"为比记录所支持的更强状态；现有溯源与认证标准未规定完整的发布过渡语义。

Method: 采用设计科学研究方法（DSR + FEDS），提出五项发布权法则（问责闭合、授权新鲜性、认识论非放大、语义表面保持、持续可挑战性），并实例化为 PAC-2026 SF-4 固定核心配置文件，规定六项义务（E1/R1/M1/A1/S1/L1）、独立结果映射、原子发布许可及认证生命周期事件。评估使用身份向量、对抗案例、TLA+ 有限模型（10 个配置）与历史实现层。

Result: 语义冻结含 36 个模式、53 个原因码；10 个 TLA+ 模型穷尽探索 110,764 个安全可达状态无不变性违反，76 个故意不安全配置均产生预期违规；23 个 SF-4 时序案例匹配，17 个 SF-3 历史案例保留为回归；G7-B 实例盲测中 183 个评分实例全部匹配预期（N_new=0），240 个归档观测本地复现成功。结果支持内部一致性、有界安全、目标故障敏感性与有限可构造性，但明确不证明事实正确性、通用精化、独立互操作性或现场效能。

Conclusion: 发布权将出版权限定义为完整精确状态的派生属性，使每项义务必须独立获得通过见证，且无法相互补偿；一次性许可确保一次原子发布行为；持续挑战性通过认证追加事件保持发布后状态可重建。该研究提供可检验的设计知识与有界证据，但独立一致性、互操作性与领域效用仍需另行评估；HC-0024（测量证据绑定）与 HC-0062（授权时序与拒绝定位）规范歧义尚未在冻结的 SF-4 中解决，单独的修正候选已提出但未获批准。

Abstract: AI-assisted claims can appear authoritative when evidence, analysis, human authorization, presentation, and correction history refer to different states. Provenance, attestation, and transparency expose history but alone do not specify the publication transition examined here. We develop Publication Authority as an exact-state, non-transferable, single-use publication capability and instantiate it in PAC-2026 (Publication-Accountability Calculus), a machine-readable AIJIM Protocol candidate. We evaluate its fourth bounded semantic freeze (SF-4), a fixed-profile specification designed for replaceable bindings. Six obligations govern evidence, runs and artifacts, measurement disclosure, authorization, surface correspondence, and lifecycle continuity. Each yields a target-bound witness, localized counterexample, or localized unverifiability; none can compensate for another. Only a fresh, complete all-pass record derives the permit consumed by one atomic publication transition. We use identity vectors, adversarial cases, finite models, and historical implementations. Ten models explored 110,764 safe reachable states; 76 unsafe configurations produced the expected violation or observer countermodel. A reader surface passing its correspondence check cannot authorize publication unless the accepted record admits that surface. SF-4 separates evidence horizon from verification time and rejects an authentic but causally invalid authorization. A historical predecessor path reproduced 17 frozen authorization-successor outcomes. A later in-house, instance-blind test of known case classes matched all 183 scored expectations; same-host package execution reproduced its 240 archived observations. Results support internal coherence, bounded safety, fault sensitivity, and limited constructibility, but not factual truth, general refinement, blind interoperability, field efficacy, or standards status.

</details>


### [104] [EvolveTrade: Experience-Driven Policy Refinement for Self-Evolving LLM Trading Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17632)
*Sehee Kim,Yumin Choi,Minki Kang,Sung Ju Hwang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EvolveTrade是一个自进化框架，将LLM交易代理的系统提示视为文本参数化的工具使用策略，通过Policy Agent基于决策痕迹和已实现投资组合反馈定期优化该策略，使冻结的LLM交易代理能适应不断变化的市场环境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM交易代理的信息获取和工具使用流程（由静态手写提示控制）在部署前就已固定，无法根据市场反馈进行适应性调整，这成为其在非平稳金融市场中稳健决策的核心瓶颈。

Method: 1. 将系统提示视为文本参数化策略π_t；2. 每个批次（N=5天）结束后，Policy Agent使用LLM调用f_update(π, B)分析该批次的决策痕迹和已实现投资组合反馈R_t=(h_t, g_t)；3. 重写完整策略文本用于下一批次；4. 在GPT-5-mini（2025年1/4/9月）和Gemini-2.5-Flash（2025年11月、2026年2/4月）上进行15只美国蓝筹股日收盘模拟评估。

Result: 1. EvolveTrade在多数评估环境下获得最佳的LLM基线SR和CR（如GPT-5-mini的1月SR 5.12/CR 5.10%、9月SR 8.43/CR 6.84%）；2. 行为分析显示其激活了静态基线从不调用的状态相关指标（4月回撤中的VaR、信号归一化；9月上涨趋势中的EMA/RSI/SMA）；3. NVDA 1月24日案例中，优化后的仓位策略在次日NVDA下跌17%时贡献+1.33个百分点的相对日收益差异；4. 适中的更新间隔（5天）在适应性与稳定性间取得最佳平衡；5. 50天长周期测试中保持有效。

Conclusion: 使LLM交易代理能够从自身实际交易经验中持续修订工具使用流程，是构建更稳健LLM交易代理的关键方向。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) trading agents can combine market data, news, and executable analysis, but their behavior is often controlled by static hand-written tool-use policies that are fixed before deployment. This limits their ability to adapt how they gather evidence, invoke tools, verify signals, and manage risk under changing market regimes. We introduce EvolveTrade, a self-evolving framework that treats the system prompt of a tool-using trading agent as a text-parameterized policy. After each update interval, a Policy Agent revises this policy using accumulated decision traces and realized portfolio feedback, while keeping the backbone LLM fixed. The updated policy is then used for the next batch of trading decisions, enabling the agent to refine its information-acquisition and portfolio-construction procedure over time. Experiments across multiple market regimes and two LLM backbones show that EvolveTrade often improves Sharpe Ratio and Cumulative Return over fixed-policy LLM baselines, achieving the improved SR and CR in most evaluated settings. Behavioral analyses further show that self-evolved policies increase code-mediated analysis and activate regime-relevant computations; case-level policy-to-return attributions trace how policy-induced allocation changes contribute to realized return differences. These results suggest that adapting the reusable procedure governing tool use is a key direction for building more robust LLM trading agents.

</details>


### [105] [One Color Preprocessing Improves DSATUR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17633)
*Adam Nouira,Lucas Isenmann*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SSLD（Semidefinite Spectral Learning with DSATUR）是一种通过半正定规划（SDP）预处理为DSATUR贪心启发式算法预先固定一个高质量颜色类（独立集），再由DSATUR完成剩余着色的图染色算法。在1600多个基准实例上几乎总能匹配或超越DSATUR，但运行时间约为DSATUR的195倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DSATUR是图染色问题（GCP）最快的启发式之一，但其结果使用的颜色数通常多于SOTA算法。已有研究（Spinrad–Vijayan）证明存在3-可染色图使DSATUR需要n种颜色的最坏情况。作者希望通过在DSATUR之前预处理一个好的颜色类来改进DSATUR。

Method: 提出SSLD算法：(1) 求解一个新的D-SDP（目标为最大化tr(XJ)，约束保证正定、对角线为1、边对应元素为0），得到图的正交表示；(2) 对SDP矩阵进行特征分解，得到顶点嵌入V；(3) 进行T=500次随机投影（每次生成高斯方向r，计算p=Vr），按降序提取贪心独立集，分配颜色0；(4) 用DSATUR完成剩余子图着色，保留多次尝试中的最优结果。同时提出朴素基线GISD（无SDP的随机顺序独立集预处理）作为对照。

Result: 在1604个基准实例（含DIMACS、Spinrad–Vijayan对抗族、Erdős–Rényi、Watts-Strogatz、Barabási–Albert、CELAR/GRAPH频率分配、Job Shop调度）上，SSLD对比DSATUR在876例上使用更少颜色、726例持平、仅2例更差；对比GISD为988/615/1。在所有Spinrad–Vijayan对抗实例上均达到最优χ=3。代价是中位运行时间0.82s，约为DSATUR的195倍；SDP求解在大规模实例上占主导，部分FAP实例超时。

Conclusion: SDP引导的首个颜色类选择策略可有效提升DSATUR着色质量，但缺乏理论保证。未来方向包括：迭代预处理多个颜色类、设计更智能的投影方向、利用稀疏性或更便宜的替代松弛降低SDP求解开销，以及尝试建立D-SDP的近似保证。

Abstract: The Graph Coloring Problem (GCP) is NP-hard and DSATUR stands as one of the fastest heuristics for it despite producing colorings that typically use more colors than state-of-the-art coloring algorithms. We propose SSLD (Semidefinite Spectral Learning with DSATUR), which improves DSATUR by preprocessing a first good color class before letting DSATUR complete coloring the rest of the given graph. We obtain this color class from a Semidefinite Programming (SDP), similar to an SDP used to compute the Lovász theta number. To the best of our knowledge, SSLD is the first approach to improve DSATUR by preprocessing through fixed color classes. We evaluate SSLD against DSATUR and against a naive 1-color-class preprocessing algorithm on DIMACS instances, random graphs (Erdős--Rényi, Watts-Strogatz, Barabási--Albert), Frequency Assignment and Job Shop Scheduling instances. SSLD matches or beats DSATUR in almost every case across over 1600 benchmark instances, and out performs the naive GISD baseline, allows us to confirm the value brought by the SDP-guided choice of the first color class. This quality comes at a runtime cost of roughly 195 times slower that DSATUR, but demonstrating that SDP-guided preprocessing of a first color class is a direction for future improvements.

</details>


### [106] [Physics-Constrained Digital Twins for Sensor Integrity in Urban Pedestrian Flow: Detecting Stealthy False Data Injection with Conformal Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17635)
*Oscar Mogollon Gutierrez,Fatemeh Ghasemi,Mohammadhossein Homaei,Andres Caro,Mar Avila*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对城市行人计数数字孪生系统面临的数据注入攻击威胁,首次形式化了稀疏行人感知中的隐蔽攻击问题,提出了一种基于流守恒约束的检测框架,并引入了"攻击裕度"(attack margin)作为衡量物理约束防御效果的量化指标。在墨尔本六年数据上的实验表明,该方法可将单一设备被攻陷时的最坏情况流场篡改降低54%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市行人计数系统已广泛支撑经济指标、规划决策和安全管理,但其数字孪生将输入数据视为地面真值。电力和水网领域的隐蔽虚假数据注入(FDI)研究显示,攻击者可构造满足物理方程的注入,使状态估计被偏移而残差检测不被触发。行人感知面临更严重的秩亏问题(N≪Me),攻击者的隐蔽空间更大。本文旨在回答:在行人街道路网中编码流守恒定律,能否可测量地缩小隐蔽攻击者可达到的攻击空间。

Method: 1. 威胁模型:定义四类攻击家族(回放A1、斜坡偏置A2、缩放A3、协调注入A4),其中A4允许攻击者构造与虚构流场一致的跨传感器协调注入;2. 数字孪生:在街道有向图上估计潜在流,通过线图上的图注意力网络(GAT)进行状态演化,负二项分布似然处理过度离散计数,学习图局部增益进行同化(扩散半径K=4);3. 守恒约束:利用有向图的节点-边关联矩阵B构建守恒残差r(t)=Bφ̂(t)-ŝ(t),其中源汇项s(t)由带包络的MLP生成;4. 检测统计量:结合创新项与守恒残差的加权得分z(t),通过自适应共形预测(adaptive conformal inference)在季节性漂移下在线标定阈值;5. 攻击裕度:形式化η-隐蔽攻击集A_κ(η,λ),定义最坏情况流场篡改I⋆(κ,λ)及其相对缩减M(κ)=1-I⋆(κ,λ)/I⋆(κ,0);6. 白盒攻击求解:通过可微孪生的投影梯度上升求解隐蔽约束下的最坏攻击,采用组合投影(支撑掩码+可行域+隐蔽投影)。

Result: 在墨尔本六年(2019-2024)小时级数据上(58个匹配计数器、4013个节点、9842条有向边,仪表化率仅1.18%):1. 孪生保真度:完整孪生(λ=10)MAE=54.9,CRPS=41.6,KL=0.258,90%覆盖率0.891,优于所有基线预测器;2. 阈值标定:自适应共形预测实现0.011的标称误报率(目标0.01),固定5σ规则仅0.006但漂移范围大;3. 参数化攻击(A1-A3):在κ=5时,本文方法延迟15-79小时,略优于最强基线CATCH(17-86小时);4. 协调/优化攻击(A4):λ=10时Aff-F1=0.72,VUS-PR=0.66,延迟31小时,显著优于CATCH(0.46/0.38/93小时),未约束变体(λ=0)为0.45/0.39/95小时,表明增益来自守恒律而非架构;5. 攻击裕度:κ=1时M=0.54,κ=20(三分之一车队)时降至M=0.19;将街道图替换为距离图后裕度塌缩至0.09,证实增益来自守恒律而非局部性;6. 消融实验:λ权重扫描显示λ=10为最优点(λ=1000时CRPS退化至63.5);7. 大流行分布偏移:自适应阈值19天恢复,固定规则永不恢复。负结果:30天斜坡攻击对所有方法均近乎不可见;λ单独训练(0.15)或检测(0.21)均无法达到联合使用的效果(0.39)。

Conclusion: 流守恒约束对行人数字孪生提供的保护是可量化的而非绝对的:其防御强度随攻击者控制范围增大而衰减。核心结论包括:(1)图必须是物理图而非距离图,因为增益来自守恒律而非局部性;(2)阈值标定与检测得分同等重要,大流行期间68%→42%的误报率改善完全来自自适应共形预测;(3)传感器布局本身是一个安全决策,因为被仪表化的边集决定了攻击者可达的ker(B)子空间。未来方向:将传感器布局优化以最大化攻击裕度,并将该框架推广至自行车计数、公交乘客量、计量供水等其他城市网络守恒量。主要局限:单城市小时级数据、源汇项为学习近似而非测量值、裕度针对单一攻击算法估计、假设1(无污染校准窗口)仍是系统最薄弱环节。

Abstract: City pedestrian counting systems now feed economic indicators, planning decisions and safety operations, yet the twins built on top of them treat the incoming stream as ground truth. We study what happens when it is not. We formalise stealthy false data injection for city-scale pedestrian sensing, where the map from latent flow to observation is far more rank deficient than in the power and water networks for which stealth has been characterised. Our twin estimates directed flows on the pedestrian street graph, assimilates counts through a learned graph-localised gain, and is trained against a flow conservation residual that couples metered and unmetered segments. Detection combines the innovation with that residual, and the alarm threshold is set by adaptive conformal calibration rather than by hand. To measure what the physics buys, we define the attack margin, the relative reduction in worst-case corruption of the estimated flow field, achieved against a white-box adversary that optimises directly through the twin. On six years of Melbourne data the margin reaches 0.54 against a single compromised device and falls to 0.19 when a third of the fleet is compromised, on a network where only 1.18 per cent of walkable segments are metered. Replacing the street graph by a distance graph collapses it to 0.09, which shows that the gain comes from the conservation law rather than from locality.

</details>


### [107] [What You Can't See Is Still What You Learn: A Preregistered Sixty-Society Confirmation That Evidence Masking Drives Compositional Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17637)
*Narcis Marincat*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一项预注册的确认性研究，通过60个"四单元系统"（共享冻结的Qwen2.5-0.5B语言模型骨干，通过学习的连续向量包通信），测试"证据遮蔽"（即限制模块能读取的内容）是否能驱动组合泛化能力。五种条件变化证据遮蔽、所有权标记和用中性填充物替换外部证据。研究证实遮蔽条件在保持组合准确率上具有巨大优势（深度二/三的中位数配对优势+0.846/+0.859），但标记是否提供可用的角色信息以及中性填充物的分解仍无定论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前研究的问题是：限制模块对外部证据的直接访问（即"证据遮蔽"）是否会促使系统学习通过模块间传递可重用的中间结果，从而在面对未见过的程序组合时改善泛化能力。父研究（Marincat, 2026b）发现了巨大的遮蔽优势，但其预注册测试在形式上未通过（深度三准确率0.6988，未达0.70阈值），且留下了归因问题未解——遮蔽同时移除了外部证据并标识了证据归属。本研究旨在通过五条件设计、新的任务世界来测试遮蔽优势并探究其机制。

Method: 方法包括：(1) 任务设计：12个不同的非恒等仿射双射 \(f_i(x)=(a_i x+b_i)\bmod 17\) 组成的"任务世界"，目标计算有序的运算复合并报告为17个字母标签之一。(2) 架构：四个顺序调用共享冻结的Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct骨干（一个共享rank-8 LoRA），通过学习的连续向量包通信（两个896维向量，标准化锚定，更新规则为 \(P=N(U+0.05\Delta P)\)）。(3) 五种条件（R⁻/R⁺/G⁻/G⁺/N⁺）交叉证据访问制度与显式跨度所有权标记。(4) 匹配双胞胎纪律：六个初始化集群×两个顺序×五种条件=60个系统，共享初始化字节、训练样本流、token布局、位置几何和训练预算。(5) 预注册对比：六个对比C1-C6，包括主行为对比C1（R⁺-G⁺）和父研究复制C6(R⁻-G⁻)。(6) 训练：20,000次AdamW更新，批次大小32，浮点32，梯度裁剪范数1.0，仅评估最终检查点。(7) 机制审计：30个审计任务覆盖42个轨迹，包括同值替换、反事实替换、零包替换等干预。

Result: 结果：(1) C1（标记遮蔽优势）和C6（无标记复制）均通过完整联合测试：所有12对匹配轨迹在两个深度上都超过所需边界，C1中位数+0.846/+0.859，C6中位数+0.884/+0.917；遮蔽臂中位深度三准确率为1.000，无运行低于0.40。(2) C3（标记实践冗余）满足标准：R⁺/R⁻差异在两个深度上均为0.000。(3) 标记使用检查失败：0/12的G⁺轨迹通过标记跟随测试，跟踪范围0.038-0.060，因此C2（标记救援）失败，语义角色救援仍未解。(4) N⁺臂分裂为三类：7个完全泛化者、4个未获得者和1个浅层部分者；C4/C5分解对比无定论。(5) 所有18个审计的遮蔽轨迹在合格案例上同值保留和反事实跟随均为1.000；零包删除接近概率；G⁺轨迹未达到所有接口的强典型性。(6) 跨制度互操作性在11/12对中失败。

Conclusion: 结论是：(1) 在测试的种子、世界和预算下，遮蔽制度（限制模块读取其指定证据跨度的内容）展现出巨大的组合泛化优势，确认了父研究的结果。(2) 遮蔽同时移除了任务相关外部证据和潜在的角色信息；尽管中性填空物产生了7个完全泛化者，表明全球注意力几何学可以实现高准确率，但分解归因仍不确定。(3) 标记在训练中位置冗余（每个单元的跨度占据固定槽位），所以它们是实践可忽略的；预注册的标记跟随检查失败，语义角色救援仍未解决。(4) 机制审计表明遮蔽轨迹在包级别具有一致的价值接口差异，但不建立介导或唯一表示。(5) 局限包括：单一任务世界、0.5B基因组、17状态载体空间、薄标记操作、6个初始化集群（符号翻转下限p=0.03125）、未保持计划中的整组评估禁运。研究建议四项后续研究：洗牌槽位标记、空闲分数操纵、N⁺脆弱性、迭代学习。代码、协议、结果和检查点已公开发布。

Abstract: Restricting what a module can read may improve what a system learns to compute. We test this in a preregistered confirmation with sixty four-cell systems sharing a frozen language-model backbone and communicating through learned continuous packets. Five conditions vary evidence masking, ownership markers, and replacement of foreign evidence with neutral filler, across six initialization clusters, each with two data orders, on one fresh task world. With markers available in both regimes, masking improved accuracy on held-out two- and three-operation compositions by median paired differences of 0.846 and 0.859; all twelve pairs cleared the required margins, and the full preregistered behavioral criterion passed. The unmarked replication also passed. No globally visible system passed the marker-following check, so the effect of usable role information remains unresolved. The filler condition yielded seven full generalizers, but its decomposition criteria were inconclusive. Packet interventions in all eighteen audited masked systems followed the predicted intermediate-value changes on eligible cases; these finite, success-conditioned audits do not establish mediation. The results confirm a large advantage of the tested masking regime, while leaving its finer attribution and generality open. Protocols, results, and checkpoints are public.

</details>


### [108] [CapMem: A Benchmark for Caption-Based Episodic Memory in Egocentric Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17688)
*Dingli Liang,Yiqiao Xie,Yukai Huang,Zhaokai Wang,Weitong Cai,Guangwen Feng,Jifei Song,Zhensong Zhang,Hang Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CapMem提出并验证了基于文本标题的记忆系统作为可穿戴助手处理长视频情景记忆任务的可行替代方案，通过构建包含75个视频、1000个人工标注问答对的多领域基准，在12个VLM上的系统评测表明该方案在长视频（>20分钟）场景中显著优于直接视频问答。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前视觉语言模型在处理穿戴设备产生的长时第一人称视频流时，面临帧预算受限、视觉token成本高及长上下文检索失败（"lost-in-the-middle"）等实际约束。现有视频问答基准要么侧重于短时定位，要么依赖VLM自动生成问答对，可能继承模型自身的时空弱点，缺乏对长时第一人称情景记忆中细粒度视觉细节和远程时序回忆能力的系统评测。

Method: （1）定义"情景记忆视频标题问答"（Episodic Memory Video Caption QA）任务，要求模型仅通过自生成的带时间戳文本标题回答问题；（2）构建人工标注的CapMem基准，包含75个视频共33.7小时、1000个多选题、跨16个场景和4个领域（日常生活、户外、工作、宠物），79.2%问题集中在长视频（>20分钟）；（3）采用Ego/Exo与4W1H双轴分类体系及50个问题模板指导标注；（4）设计CleanQA（盲测试）筛选语义偏差、VideoQA（直接视觉输入）与CaptionQA（仅标题输入）对比的两阶段评估流程；（5）执行全帧覆盖、帧对齐控制（排除视觉覆盖率差异）和交叉标题控制（解耦标题质量与文本推理能力）；（6）提出基于标题索引的"检索-验证"框架，结合BM25、哈希余弦、词重叠和时间提示加权检索，仅在视觉证据强且无时钟线索时才覆盖基线预测。

Result: （1）全帧覆盖CaptionQA在12个VLM中对8个优于VideoQA（30秒窗口）和6个优于VideoQA（60秒窗口）；（2）长视频（>20分钟）子集上增益更显著：30秒/60秒窗口分别对10/12和8/12模型胜出；（3）帧对齐后Qwen系列6个模型在长视频上保留均值增益3.22点（30秒，95% CI [+0.45, +6.07]）和2.55点（60秒）；（4）标题质量与文本推理能力共同影响CaptionQA表现（不同标题器与QA模型配对带来2.2–6.1点的变化范围）；（5）标题记忆可摊销视觉处理开销，32问共享时单位问题成本从330k降至14–20k token单位；（6）"检索-验证"框架进一步提升多数开源模型准确率最高达5.3点，且对小模型增益更明显；（7）CaptionQA在中等位置证据上的"丢失"现象较VideoQA更平缓。

Conclusion: 文本标题可作为长时第一人称视频情景记忆的有效可重用表征，在当前VLM帧预算和上下文长度限制下尤其适用于长视频场景；标题记忆具有跨查询摊销视觉处理开销的天然优势，但可能遗漏细微视觉细节，需配合稀疏帧验证机制以兼顾可扩展性与细粒度判别能力。该工作为穿戴式智能体的记忆系统设计提供了从基准到推理策略的完整研究基础。

Abstract: Wearable assistants require episodic memory over egocentric video, yet current vision-language models face bounded frame budgets, growing visual-token costs, and long-context retrieval failures. Under these practical constraints, we study whether textual captions can serve as reusable episodic memory. We define the Episodic Memory Video Caption QA task and introduce CapMem, a human-annotated benchmark with 75 videos totaling 33.7 hours, and 1,000 multiple-choice questions across 16 scenarios. On long videos (>20 min), full-coverage CaptionQA with 30s and 60s caption windows outperforms direct VideoQA for 10/12 and 8/12 models, respectively. On the same video subset, a matched-frame control across six Qwen models retains mean accuracy gains of 3.22 and 2.55 points, respectively. Our caption-guided retrieve-and-verify harness further improves accuracy by up to 5.3 points. These results support the effectiveness of caption memory for episodic reasoning over long egocentric video.

</details>


### [109] [GraphEcho: Structural Redundancy and Evidence Provenance in LLM Graph Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17695)
*Sikun Wang,Yixi Zhou,Lei Fan,Fan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GraphEcho是一个用于评估LLM图智能体能否区分"结构多重性"（同一证据的多条图路径）与"证据来源多重性"（独立来源）的受控基准，并提出了PAPT后训练方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图智能体在检索过程中可能通过多条不同路径重复遇到同一证据来源，错误地将重复访问当作独立佐证。这种"结构冗余"会导致判断偏差和探索预算浪费，但缺乏系统性的评测方法。论文旨在区分"路径数量增加"与"证据来源数量增加"对智能体判断与行为的影响。

Method: 1) 构建GraphEcho-Syn合成基准（800个虚构声明，跨生物医学、材料、农业、经济领域），控制证据内容、来源标识和路径模板，使路径数与来源数可独立变化；2) 引入SciFact真实科学数据集作为迁移评估；3) 设计路径多重性效应(PME)和独立来源效应(ISE)评估指标，以及回声游走率(EWR)、唯一来源召回(USR)等获取指标；4) 提出Provenance-Aware Post-Training (PAPT)，结合GRPO和LoRA微调Qwen3-4B，奖励函数包含判断奖励、来源计数、覆盖率和回声惩罚；5) 评估四个冻结模型（Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B和GPT-5-mini）和多个消融变体。

Result: 1) 静态判断：模型依赖效应差异显著——Qwen3-4B对冗余路径过度敏感（PME=7.47pp），Qwen3-8B和GPT-5-mini则降低冗余路径下的概率但提升不同来源下的概率；2) 所有四个冻结智能体的回声游走率均因冗余支持路径而增加（+5.80至+38.84pp）；3) PAPT在合成任务上将Qwen3-4B的智能体准确率提升41.5pp，回声率降低36.9pp，但来源召回下降；4) 在SciFact迁移评估中，PAPT继续降低回声但准确率反而下降3.6pp；5) 奖励消融表明各奖励项存在权衡关系；6) 发现"效率探索"与"有效证据使用"之间的差距：智能体可学会停止重复但忽略所需信息。

Conclusion: GraphEcho揭示了LLM图智能体中存在结构冗余被误认为独立佐证的核心问题，并证明简单的推理控制（如来源折叠）能在某些场景下替代昂贵的训练。然而，减少重复访问与有效证据使用之间存在张力：PAPT虽能降低回声并提升合成任务准确率，却以覆盖率和迁移准确率为代价。未来的科学基准需要跟踪跨论文的共享数据集和实验，以正确评估智能体识别共同实证来源的能力。

Abstract: A large language model (LLM) agent can follow more graph paths without acquiring more independent evidence. GraphEcho tests whether agents mistake these repeated encounters for additional corroboration. The benchmark varies path counts and evidential origins while holding evidence content fixed, and evaluates both judgments and active exploration. Controlled synthetic experiments reveal model-dependent judgment shifts, but redundant supporting paths increase the share of repeated walks across all evaluated frozen agents. Provenance-aware post-training (PAPT) reduces revisits and improves synthetic accuracy, yet covers fewer distinct sources. On scientific claims, it continues to reduce repetition while accuracy declines. These findings expose a gap between efficient exploration and effective evidence use: an agent can learn to stop repeating itself while overlooking information it needs. GraphEcho provides a controlled way to evaluate both what graph agents conclude and whether their exploration reaches distinct evidential sources.

</details>


### [110] [GVD: Governed Versioning and Deduplication for Document Repositories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17696)
*Mohammadreza Sediqin,Shivali Dalmia,Sumukha Thoppanahalli,Abhishek Mukherji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GVD是一个统一的框架，将文档版本管理、重复检测与规则级一致性推理整合为一个可审计的更新策略，而非仅做成对的分类。它通过两阶段流水线（版本族构建 + 规则级一致性判断）结合反向NLI和反事实跨度探查（CSP），在不使用大语言模型的前提下显著提升了规则一致性F1，并在企业文档上达到高准确率与较低的人工审查负担。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业文档库不断演化，现有方法将版本控制、重复检测和矛盾检测视为独立的成对任务，分类后就停止，无法回答"该保留哪些规则、哪些需要更新、哪些需人工审查"等治理层面的问题。监管场景需要明确知道哪个版本生效、何时被替代以及谁批准了变更，因此需要从"分类"走向"治理"。

Method: GVD在归一化步骤中先将多模态文档转换为人工校验后的RuleUnit，用all-MiniLM-L6-v2编码为384维向量。两阶段流水线：Stage 1版本维护通过文档质心检索+双向覆盖率判断将新文档分入现有版本族；Stage 2规则维护在族内存里做余弦预筛→双向DeBERTa-v3-large NLI（判断Duplicate/Contradiction/Asymmetric/Neutral）→仅对Neutral对执行CSP（反事实跨度探查，通过分析差异span结构区分表面改写、值/极性翻转与实质性非对称修改）。关系特定策略：重复抑制、新知识插入、矛盾/不对称/值变化发送人工审查，并保留版本血缘审计。无需大语言模型，本地部署。

Result: 在120份企业文档（3900个RuleUnit，回放为140次入库、59个版本族、4396条规则决策）上：Stage 1版本族构建F1=0.971；Stage 2规则一致性F1=0.94（P=0.97, R=0.91），其中CSP使F1从0.90提升到0.94，Duplicate类提升+0.08，Neutral类提升+0.07。基线对比：RETSim F1=0.943（Stage 1最强基线）；Vanilla NLI仅0.72，CSP将整体F1由0.90提升到0.94。审查路由：381条矛盾/不对称/值变化送人工，自动处理案例无漏判。

Conclusion: 治理演化中的文档库与成对分类是不同的问题，把一致性关系作为更新策略来执行（而非仅做标签），能在不断增长的集合中保持可审计性。GVD是首个将一致性关系转为仓库更新策略的框架，未来将扩展到更多语言/领域、规模更大的规则集，并集成到RAG流水线评估下游影响。

Abstract: Document repositories evolve continuously. Guidelines and policies are revised, superseded, and re-uploaded, so the same content recurs in different wording and newer versions refine or contradict earlier ones. These inconsistencies belong to the growing collection rather than to any single document, yet existing work treats versioning, duplicate detection, and contradiction detection as isolated pairwise tasks and stops once a pair is labeled. We present GVD (Governed Versioning and Deduplication), a framework that unifies cross-document version linking with rule-level conflict resolution under an auditable update policy. Incoming documents are assigned to version families through bidirectional rule alignment, and their rules are compared against the family memory to identify duplicates, contradictions, asymmetric refinements, and new knowledge, with Counterfactual Span Probing (CSP) resolving related pairs that inference misclassifies as neutral. Relation-specific policies suppress duplicates and escalate only consequential changes for review, retaining version lineage as an audit trail. The pipeline runs fully locally, with no large language model. On 120 enterprise documents processed as 140 ingestions across 59 version families, GVD reaches an F1 of 0.97 for version-family construction and 0.94 for rule-level consistency, with CSP raising rule consistency from 0.90 to 0.94.

</details>


### [111] [NeMo Data Designer: An Extensible Framework for Multimodal Synthetic Data Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17699)
*Johnny Greco,Nabin Mulepati,Andre Manoel,Eric Tramel,Kirit Thadaka,Mike Knepper,Dhruv Nathawani,Dane Corneil,Yev Meyer,Alex Watson,Maarten Van Segbroeck*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: NeMo Data Designer (NDD) 是 NVIDIA 开源的多模态合成数据生成框架，采用声明式配置定义数据集列，支持预览-迭代循环、统计采样器控制多样性、插件扩展及异步执行调度，并已用于 Nemotron 模型训练和企业级部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成数据生成（SDG）在 LLM 全生命周期中愈发重要，但现有流程通常依赖定制脚本，难以解释、共享和复现；同时合成数据的有用性取决于对数据组成与多样性的精细控制、质量验证以及与真实数据的混合。论文旨在解决 SDG 管线缺乏统一框架的问题。

Method: NDD 采用声明式配置（YAML 或 Python builder）定义列（采样器、LLM 文本/代码/结构化输出、图像、嵌入、验证器、LLM 评判器等），通过 DAG 编译器解析列间依赖，异步运行时调度就绪任务并管理模型端点的自适应请求准入（AIMD）。框架内建预览-修订循环、统计采样器作为一等列类型、插件系统（种子读取器、列生成器、处理器），并通过 ModelProvider/ModelConfig 分离模型角色与端点拓扑。

Result: NDD 在 Nemotron 模型开发和企业部署中已生成约 10 万亿 token 合成数据。代表性案例：结构化输出（9,949 个 JSON 样本，JSONSchemaBench 80.2%→86.9%）、Text-to-SQL（300K 候选→96.5K 保留，BIRD 26.77%→41.80%）、搜索代理轨迹（50K 种子→约 7K 有效轨迹，平均约 12 次工具调用）、长文档 VLM（约 11.4M VQA 对，MMLongBench-Doc 26.32%→59.00%）、提示鲁棒性（提示敏感度波动降低约 2 倍）、Nemotron-Personas（10 个区域数据集，15 种语言版本，覆盖约 24 亿人口）。

Conclusion: NDD 将 SDG 从零散脚本转变为显式、可检查、可复用的数据设计过程。其灵活的编程模型和扩展机制使研究者和企业能够在多种数据类型、模态和验证策略下生成经过质量筛选的合成数据。论文强调"数据管道的选择影响模型最终学到的内容，构建数据管道就是构建模型的一部分"。同时讨论了局限性（真实数据校验、过滤分布偏移、复现性、隐私与下游效用）和更广泛的影响。

Abstract: We present NeMo Data Designer (NDD), an open-source, general-purpose framework for multi-modal synthetic data generation (SDG). Designed to be intuitive to use, NDD provides a declarative configuration format in which human and/or agent users define each dataset column, with column types spanning text, code, structured outputs, images, embeddings, and statistical samplers that are explicitly configured to steer dataset diversity. Additional column types and functionality can be introduced using the framework's flexible plugin system. NDD's configuration is an inspectable artifact, supporting workflow sharing and reproducibility. SDG is an inherently iterative process. NDD therefore builds a preview-and-revision loop into its core workflow, allowing users to generate and inspect a small number of records, refine the specification, and rerun generation at full scale. At runtime, NDD resolves dependencies, schedules calls to user-provided model endpoints, and retries failed requests. We describe NDD's architecture and programming model and present case studies spanning structured, agentic, multimodal, and domain-specialized tasks, including datasets used in Nemotron model development and in production enterprise deployments.

</details>


### [112] [A Systematic Evaluation of the COTQ Provincial Land Cover Product: Structural Consistency, Spectral Separability, and Relative Positioning Against ESA, ESRI, and Google Products](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17731)
*Étienne Clabaut,Samuel Foucher,Yacine Bouroubi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究对加拿大魁北克省自主研发的10米高分辨率土地覆盖产品COTQ进行系统性评估，通过结构指标、光谱可分性指标和专家目视解译三种方法，与ESA WorldCover、ESRI LandCover和Google DynamicWorld三个全球10米土地覆盖数据集进行对比分析，覆盖魁北克八大生物气候区。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率土地覆盖产品在不同生态梯度复杂的区域性能差异显著，魁北克省现有的全球土地覆盖产品在该地区存在局限性，催生了本省COTQ产品的开发。但COTQ相对全球产品的性能特征和行为一致性尚不清楚，需要进行客观评估以明确其在运营性土地监测中的定位。

Method: 采用多准则互补评估框架：(1) 结构指标——对象尺寸分布、形状复杂度、调整兰德指数(ARI)、交并比(IoU)； (2) 基于Sentinel-2反射率数据的光谱可分性度量；(3) 对分歧区域进行定向目视解译。所有产品在统一图例下协调，覆盖8个Sentinel-2图块，代表魁北克温带森林、北方森林至北方苔原等主要生物气候域。

Result: COTQ在结构与光谱特征上与ESA WorldCover最为相似，但在城市用地、湿地、岩石/隐花植物覆盖面的类定义与主题优先级方面存在系统性差异。多角度评估客观刻画了COTQ产品的特征，并明确其与全球土地覆盖数据集在魁北克运营性土地监测中的相对定位。

Conclusion: 该研究通过多准则评估方法客观表征了COTQ产品的性能特征，证实其在魁北克复杂生态梯度区域相比全球产品具有一定的优势，特别是在与ESA WorldCover的一致性方面，但需注意类定义差异对特定地表类型(如城市、湿地、岩石/隐花植物覆盖)的影响。研究为COTQ在魁北克运营性土地监测中的应用提供了科学依据。

Abstract: High-resolution land use and land cover (LULC) products derived from Sentinel-2 imagery are widely used for environmental monitoring and land management, yet their performance can vary across regions with complex ecological gradients and heterogeneous surface conditions. In Quebec, these limitations motivated the development of a provincial 10-m land-cover product, the COTQ, designed to support annual monitoring of land occupation and soil artificialisation. This study presents a systematic evaluation of the COTQ product relative to three global 10-m LULC datasets: ESA WorldCover, ESRI LandCover, and Google DynamicWorld. This paper does not introduce a new mapping methodology but focuses on analysing the behaviour and consistency of the COTQ using complementary evaluation approaches. All products are harmonized under a common legend and compared using structural indicators (object-size distributions, shape complexity, Adjusted Rand Index, and Intersection over Union), spectral separability metrics derived from Sentinel-2 reflectance data, and a targeted photo-interpretation of disagreement areas. The analysis is conducted over eight Sentinel-2 tiles selected to represent the main bioclimatic domains of Québec, from temperate and boreal forests to northern tundra environments. The results show that the COTQ exhibits structural and spectral characteristics most similar to ESA WorldCover among the reference global products, while revealing systematic differences linked to class definitions and thematic priorities, particularly for urban areas, wetlands, and rocky or cryptogamic surfaces. This multi-criteria evaluation provides an objective characterization of the COTQ product and clarifies its relative positioning with respect to existing global land-cover datasets for operational land monitoring in Québec.

</details>


### [113] [Imitation Learning for Autonomous Driving in CARLA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17757)
*Jordy Kieto*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文在CARLA仿真器中,通过离线行为克隆训练了一个仅1.36M参数的多模态紧凑策略,使用约3.3小时(236,882个窗口)的系统化生成且经过机动动作验证的自动驾驶仪演示数据。策略融合5帧历史的RGB图像、LiDAR BEV直方图、车辆遥测和车道路径点,通过两层时序Transformer回归20Hz的油门、刹车和转向控制。释放的策略能够在训练路线和未见过的路线上自主行驶数小时(作者运行中无碰撞),并能零样本迁移至未见过的CARLA城镇,偶尔还能从大幅轨迹偏差中恢复。文章的核心贡献不在于网络架构,而在于一套系统化的演示数据生成流程(枚举生成点、查询可行机动、验证执行后接纳)以及对释放策略从日志工件的可重建溯源,并按证据等级对每项闭环发现进行分类(定性观察而非系统化测量)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行为克隆训练时最小化的是专家状态分布下的误差,但部署时策略在自回归闭环中运行,自身误差会将其带入专家从未演示过的状态,导致误差累积。低验证损失是驾驶能力的必要不充分条件,真正需要研究的是闭环行为以及演示数据分布的覆盖度对闭环能力的影响。

Method: 1. 系统化演示生成流程:枚举地图所有生成点→查询车道图得到可行机动(左/直/右,基于25°阈值)→随机化起始位姿(航向±3°,横向±0.25m,纵向±0.5m)→自动驾驶仪30s回放(18mph,禁变道)→基于偏航轨迹分类执行机动,仅在可行且配额未满时接纳。2. 多模态时序策略:每模态独立编码器(RGB/LiDAR用三层卷积,waypoint/遥测用单层dense)→拼接投影加固定随机位置编码→两层post-norm Transformer(4头,key=64)→从最新时间步解码油门/刹车/转向的连续值。3. 训练:Adam lr=3e-3, batch=409, 53 epoch, 按录制和方向70/30时序切分,Huber损失用于油门/刹车,MSE用于转向。释放的是epoch-10检查点。4. 离线指标:各控制损失/MAE,转向检测F1,转向起始延迟,滞后误差,平滑度,分方向MSE。5. 闭环部署:20Hz同步模式,5帧缓冲(重复填充),仅由策略自身控制。

Result: 离线:epoch 10验证MAE油门1.53e-3/刹车0.017/转向0.013,转向F1=0.78;epochs 50-53继续改善至0.70e-3/0.008/0.006,F1=0.82,但右转误差约为直行的2倍,左转约2.6倍(对应89%直行/5.85%左/4.67%右的窗口分布)。epoch 10后不久出现训练不稳定(验证损失峰值5.7e-2,转向F1短暂降至0),epoch 20-22恢复,释放的策略位于此事件之前。闭环(均为作者定性观察,非系统化测量):在Town01/02训练和未见路线上无干预无碰撞自主行驶数小时;零样本迁移至具有不同道路几何的未见CARLA城镇;偶有从大幅轨迹偏差恢复的观察,但作者明确不声称系统性恢复能力。所有数据、代码、ONNX模型、逐项声明证据审计均已公开。

Conclusion: 一个仅1.36M参数的紧凑多模态策略,纯粹通过离线行为克隆,在约3.3小时系统化生成且经机动验证的自动驾驶仪演示上训练,即可在CARLA中自回归驾驶,无碰撞无人干预地在训练和未见路线上持续数小时,并能零样本迁移至未见城镇、偶有从大幅偏差恢复——尽管训练数据中没有恢复演示。这表明离线指标拟合良好只是前提,真正的能力必须通过闭环评估来判断。报告的核心贡献是方法层面的:控制和验证演示分布、从日志工件重建策略溯源、按证据等级分级每项闭环发现。这些观察促使下一步开展演示覆盖度与特权路径上下文如何塑造行为克隆闭环能力的对照实验。

Abstract: Behavioral cloning trains a policy offline on expert demonstrations, but deployment is closed loop: each action affects the observations the policy receives next. We study how much closed-loop driving competence a compact multimodal policy can acquire from offline demonstrations in the CARLA simulator. The policy uses five-frame histories of RGB images, LiDAR, vehicle telemetry, and lane waypoints to predict throttle, brake, and steering at 20 Hz. Demonstrations were collected in three stages, ending with a systematic route-generation procedure that enumerates spawn points and feasible maneuvers and verifies completed autopilot routes. The released 1.36 million parameter policy was trained on 236,882 windows, representing about 3.3 hours of driving from 448 captures. The resulting policy drives autonomously for hours on training and held-out routes. In our runs, it did so without collisions and also transferred qualitatively to an unseen CARLA town with different road geometry. We also observed recovery from large trajectory deviations, although we do not claim systematic recovery without controlled evaluation. We report offline metrics and distinguish measured results from qualitative closed-loop observations. We release the code, trained checkpoint, ONNX model, data sample, and an evidence audit for the reported claims.

</details>


### [114] [SAGE: Governed Artifact Generation from Enterprise Guidelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17775)
*Mohammadreza Sediqin,Shivali Dalmia,Sumukha Thoppanahalli,Srinivasa Karthikeya Reddy Kovvuri,Abhishek Mukherji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 SAGE，一个面向企业指南文档的治理化多阶段 LLM 流水线，通过共享版本化规则存储、模式校验的阶段间契约和端到端溯源机制，将非结构化指南文档自动转换为可审计的结构化工作制品，将人工处理时间从 2–3 天压缩至 20–100 分钟，并在 120 份真实企业文档上实现 3.2% 幻觉率和 96% 文档成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业指南文档包含叙述文本、复杂表格和嵌入图像，当前将其转换为标注指南、SOW 等结构化工作制品需 QM/PM 人工耗时 2–3 天/份，且易产生不一致和错误。现有 LLM/VLM 仅停留在"提取"环节，缺乏验证、一致性检查、版本管理和可追溯的制品生成等治理能力，无法满足生产级企业部署对数据质量、合规审计和稳定交付的要求。

Method: SAGE 采用以共享版本化规则存储（RuleStore）为核心的多阶段流水线架构：(1) 解析阶段——PyMuPDF/LibreOffice 确定性提取文本，Qwen2.5-VL-32B 处理图像/表格，按 26 字段模式归一化并分配 persona 路由标签；(2) 一致性模块——嵌入相似度+NLI 进行去重、矛盾检测和缺口分析；(3) 两级评估——L1 基于 Pydantic 的确定性结构校验，L2 基于 LLM-as-judge 的语义评分（RuleUnit 5 维，Example/Gap 3 维），按最小维度分数阈值实现自动批准/HITL 升级/拒绝三档路由；(4) 依赖感知 HITL 工作流——按阶段处理规则→缺口→制品，零编辑批准作为 L2 校准信号反馈；(5) 制品生成——从规则存储生成 9 类制品（QM 6 类+PM 3 类），通过 RC/SC/PA/CSC 加权指标 ART 控制发布。所有模型为可自托管以满足 NDA 要求。

Result: 在 120 份真实企业文档上：解析阶段 99.2% 页面覆盖率、96% 文档成功率；规则提取 84.8% 证据率、3.2% 幻觉率（L2 判定器 F1=0.957，Cohen's κ=0.813），71.4% 自动批准，28.6% 进入 HITL；治理消融实验显示一致性模块消除 117 个重复项、发现 113 处矛盾和 1,040 处缺口；生成 812 份制品，规则覆盖率 93.7%，跨段矛盾 96.3%，54.2% 自动批准；与无治理的单次基线相比，幻觉率从 15.7% 降至 3.2%，规则覆盖率从 62.8% 提升至 93.7%；端到端时间从 1,423 分钟降至 70–85 分钟。

Conclusion: SAGE 证明治理化流水线（而非模型本身）是企业文档理解质量的关键驱动力，共享规则存储+两级评估+阈值驱动 HITL 路由的组合可有效兼顾自动化与可审计性。未来工作包括退化版式下的表格检测、从已批准制品学习 persona 适配、以及向多语言和法律/临床/监管领域扩展。

Abstract: Enterprise guideline documents mix narrative text, complex tables, and embedded images, and converting them into structured work artifacts still takes two to three days of manual effort each. Current language and vision-language models extract from such documents but offer no governed workflow beyond extraction: no validation, no consistency checking, no traceable artifact generation. We introduce SAGE, a governed multi-stage LLM pipeline organized around a shared versioned rule store with stable identifiers, schema-validated inter-stage contracts, and end-to-end provenance tracking. Extracted rules undergo deterministic structural validation and LLM-based semantic scoring, then a consistency module that removes duplicates, flags contradictions, and surfaces specification gaps; only uncertain or flagged items reach reviewers, while high-confidence outputs are auto-approved. On 120 documents, SAGE cuts turnaround from days to 20-100 minutes, achieving a 96% document-level success rate with 3.2% hallucination, extracting 3,896 rules and producing 812 artifacts ready for human review; without governance, hallucination rises to 15.7%.

</details>


### [115] [FairCompressAgent: An Agentic Framework for Fairness-Aware Model Compression for FPGA Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17786)
*Yuanbo Guo,Yiyu Shi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出FairCompressAgent（FCA）——一种智能体框架，将公平性感知的剪枝、增量量化和稀疏低秩分解通过统一算子接口集成，由语言模型规划器根据模型画像与实测反馈选择压缩配置，并在用户需求变更时支持在线调整与不可行性诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型压缩通常只平衡精度与计算成本，忽略了不同人口群体间的公平性差异，且已有公平感知压缩方法（FairPrune、FairQuantize、FairLRF）在组合使用与配置选择上缺乏统一接口和显式约束机制；面向FPGA部署时，存储与算子的表征兼容性使得决策更加复杂。

Method: 将公平感知压缩建模为受约束的配置选择问题（最大化平均精度、最小化EOpp、最小化推理张量存储），通过统一的群敏感二阶评分接口整合剪枝、量化和稀疏低秩分解算子及其兼容组合（如P→Q、L→Q）；采用语言模型规划器+执行器+评估器的智能体架构，结合共享会话记录、约束校验、停止策略与归一化违规诊断，并支持用户在搜索过程中更新需求。

Result: 在Fitzpatrick-17k+VGG-11上对40个预评估配置比较四种搜索方法：在精度约束请求U下，FCA选出存储减少59.54%（S/S₀=0.4046）、验证P_avg从0.5141提升至0.5233、EOpp从0.2251降至0.2168的模型，且平均仅用7.33次候选评估即达到与one-shot规划（12次）相同的最终选择；在更严格的公平请求F下，四种方法均不可行，FCA能报告最小归一化违规0.0839；在线测试显示支持需求更新与交互式细化。

Conclusion: FCA通过统一算子接口、显式约束和实测反馈，为面向FPGA部署的公平感知模型压缩提供了一种可组合、可交互、可复现的智能体工作流；其"以完整配置为单位"的选择视角和表征感知的设计原则，为后续将公平性评估扩展到目标硬件奠定了基础。

Abstract: Fairness-aware model compression requires selecting methods and configurations that balance accuracy, fairness, and deployment cost. These decisions become more difficult when compression methods are composed or the user's requirements change. In this paper, we propose FairCompressAgent (FCA), an agentic framework that integrates fairness-aware pruning, incremental quantization, and sparse low-rank factorization through a common operator interface. A language-model planner uses model profiles and measured outcomes to select compression configurations, while an execution layer performs compression, fine-tuning, evaluation, and constraint-based selection. FCA also supports requirement updates and reports the remaining violation when a request cannot be satisfied. Experiments on Fitzpatrick-17k with VGG-11 compare four search methods over 40 measured configurations. Under the accuracy-constrained request, FCA selects a compressed model with 59.54% less inference tensor storage, while validation average precision increases from 0.5141 to 0.5233 and equalized opportunity (EOpp) decreases from 0.2251 to 0.2168. It reaches the same final selection as one-shot planning with 7.33 versus 12 candidate evaluations on average, under their respective stopping policies. Repeated fine-tuning, held-out testing, and online requirement updates characterize the stability and interactive use of this compression workflow. The results demonstrate how measured feedback and explicit constraints support the selection and interactive refinement of fairness-aware compression configurations.

</details>


### [116] [A Four-Stage Decomposition of Word-Problem Solving and Mechanistic Fragility in LLM Math Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17804)
*Zhongdi Qu,Carla P. Gomes*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出LLM解小学数学应用题的内在计算可分解为四阶段流水线（Schema Abstraction、Operation Planning、Operand Binding、Computation），并通过机制性方法定位出NoOp干扰句导致的失败发生在Operation Planning阶段，由一组注意力头执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究在两个方向上对LLM数学推理得出看似矛盾的结论：一方面LLM能高准确率解应用题，另一方面插入一个无关NoOp句就会导致崩溃（Mirzadeh et al., 2025），另有研究则发现LLM存在"抽象再计算"的两阶段机制（Cheng et al., 2025）。本文旨在以机制性视角统一这两种发现：LLM确实通过有序流水线推理，NoOp脆弱性源于该流水线中某一特定阶段的失败。

Method: 在Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct（主模型，80层）上使用GSM-Symbolic、GSM-P1、自建GSM-NoOp与GSM-Filler等数据集。三种机制性方法独立交叉验证阶段边界：(1) 残差余弦相似度（跨模板vs同模板）自动识别层间跃迁；(2) 分类线性探针（实体、运算符、操作数、最终答案）读取各层表示内容；(3) 跨提示激活patching测试因果信息位置。NoOp失效定位：使用Engagement-Anchored Direct Logit Attribution（DLA）识别Operation Planning带内特定注意力头子集（抗干扰ℋ⁻与助干扰ℋ⁺），通过双向α-scaling（α=0消融与α=2放大）验证因果作用。在Gemma-2-9B-it与Qwen-2.5-14B-Instruct上做泛化复制，并在SVAMP与PhantomWiki上做任务迁移验证。

Result: 在Llama-3.3-70B上识别出四个阶段边界：L22（Schema Abstraction，实体可解码性从0.78降至随机0.53）、L36（Operation Planning，由patching因果定位）、L40（Operand Binding，操作数从随机跳至0.77）、L80（Computation，最终答案升至0.93）。Operation Planning由L23–L36带内297个注意力头实现（ℋ⁻=134头，ℋ⁺=163头）。消融实验：ℋ⁺将正确解题准确率从1.0降至0.06，ℋ⁻降至0.47，联合降至0.02（随机外部对照组保持≥0.98，差距达10–20σ）。放大实验：在NoOp-wrong样本上将ℋ⁻放大α=2可恢复0.51准确率（相对随机外部对照+0.32，约4σ），ℋ⁺放大恢复0.33。消融ℋ引起的失败91%被双盲标注为Operation Planning类型失败。该四阶段结构在Gemma-2-9B（42层）和Qwen-2.5-14B（48层）上重现，SVAMP与PhantomWiki任务上也观察到阶段化结构。

Conclusion: LLM解数学应用题时确实通过有序的多阶段机制处理，而非纯表面模式匹配；NoOp引发的脆弱性是Operation Planning这一中间阶段被局部污染的结果，而非全局推理崩溃。Stage 1、Stage 3、Stage 4具有可由线性探针直接观察的内容特征，Stage 2因无可客观标注的"完整操作计划"形式需由因果patching定位。该机制性解释指向一个无需训练的修复杠杆：放大ℋ⁻注意力头子集可恢复约一半NoOp失败。该四阶段框架从两阶段"抽象再计算"扩展而来，并初步证据表明可泛化至其他推理领域。

Abstract: Large language models solve grade-school math word problems with high accuracy, yet a single irrelevant clause inserted into the problem can collapse it. We reconcile these observations with a mechanistic account. We show that the model's internal computation decomposes into a four-stage sequential pipeline, Schema Abstraction, Operation Planning, Operand Binding, and Computation, each stage producing a distinct intermediate representation in an identifiable band of layers. Using the same scaffold to diagnose distractor-induced failure, we localize the corruption to a single stage, Operation Planning, implemented by a set of attention heads whose causal role we validate bidirectionally. In short, we provide a mechanistic interpretation of math word problem reasoning in LLMs, and their failure when distracted.

</details>


### [117] [Learning Heterogeneous Preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17847)
*Shiwali Mohan,Matt Hong,Dule Shu,Aniek Fransen,Shabnam Hakimi,Matt Klenk*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"个体化效用函数"(individuated utility)替代传统偏好学习中"通用效用"(universal utility)假设，旨在建模主观偏好领域的系统性个体差异。基于理性选择理论(RCT)，作者设计了多阶段神经网络架构，通过决策者、任务和候选项的联合表示学习个体效用函数，并在包含57.5万对美学判断的汽车轮毂设计数据集上验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统偏好学习方法（如RLHF中的奖励模型）假设存在一个跨群体共享的"通用效用函数"，将标注者分歧视为随机噪声。这一假设在客观任务（如数学推理）中成立，但在主观领域（如美学判断、写作质量评估）中存在根本缺陷——个体的偏好受人格、经验、文化等影响存在系统性差异。将这些系统性差异当作噪声处理会掩盖有意义的多样性，导致奖励模型无法忠实代表其所服务的群体偏好。

Method: 1. **问题形式化**：基于Tversky & Kahneman的理性选择理论，定义效用函数 u(d,t,o)，同时依赖于决策者属性d、决策任务t和候选项o，采用Bradley-Tery随机效用模型建模二元选择概率。
2. **多阶段神经网络架构**：
 - 表示阶段(Representation)：使用模态特定编码器分别将决策者（结构化人口统计数据）、任务（类别或sentence embedding）和候选项（低层视觉特征+高层语义设计属性）编码为潜在向量。
 - 评估阶段(Evaluation)：提出两种设计——Design A为每个任务学习独立的效用网络 u_t(d,o)；Design B为所有任务学习共享的联合效用网络 u(d,t,o)。
 - 决策阶段(Decision)：使用Bradley-Terry模型将效用差转换为选择概率。
 - 训练阶段(Training)：使用二元交叉熵损失优化。
3. **数据集**：自建汽车轮毂设计的Wheels数据集，包含2,398名参与者对80个轮毂在9个美学维度（sporty, luxury, elegant等）上的575,520对二元比较判断及人口统计信息。
4. **评估维度**：对比任务专用与联合效用函数、三种泛化划分（随机/新选项/新决策者）、消融实验（有无决策者信息）以及与GPT-5.5和Claude Sonnet的对比。

Result: 1. **效用函数形式化**：Design A（任务专用）准确率达0.71-0.73，显著优于Design B（联合，0.62-0.65），表明任务间的语义相似性不能反映效用景观的相似性。
2. **泛化能力**：在随机划分下性能最佳，在新选项和新决策者划分下虽有所下降但仍远高于随机水平（0.5）。
3. **主观性验证**：消融实验显示，加入决策者信息使预测准确率提升2-8个百分点，其中elegant和sleek维度的个体差异最显著，sporty维度的群体共识最强。
4. **基础模型对比**：Claude Sonnet和GPT-5.5在加入决策者画像提示后几乎无改善（甚至下降），且整体表现劣于所提深度学习模型；这归因于基础模型的RLHF训练基于通用效用聚合数据，无法通过提示工程恢复个体异质性。

Conclusion: 本文确立了"主观偏好学习"作为独立的研究问题，并证明了个体化效用函数相比通用效用函数的根本优势：决策者分歧反映的是系统性偏好异质性而非标注噪声，这对于构建忠实反映人类决策多样性的奖励模型至关重要。研究呼吁在收集偏好数据时应同时记录标注者属性，并指出未来需联合学习表示、引入更丰富的个体特征编码（人格、行为历史等），并将此框架拓展到金融风险评估、公共政策、医疗健康等更广泛的主观决策领域。

Abstract: Learning from human feedback has become a central paradigm for training modern AI systems, where models of human utility are used as reward models in policy learning. Existing methods typically assume a \emph{universal utility} function shared across a population and treat disagreement between annotators as stochastic variation. While suitable for objective tasks, this assumption breaks down in subjective domains where preferences vary systematically across individuals. We study the problem of subjective preference learning, in which observed choices arise from heterogeneous but internally consistent utility functions. Drawing upon rational choice theory, RCT \parencite{tversky1981framing}, we introduce \emph{individuated utility} functions conditioned on both the individual and their decision context, and propose a novel multi-stage architecture for estimating them from multi-modal data. We evaluate our framework on a newly collected dataset of more than $575{,}000$ pairwise aesthetic judgments from $2{,}398$ participants comparing automotive wheel designs. Our experiments show that individuated utility models substantially outperform universal utility models including foundation model baselines. Our results demonstrate that disagreement reflects meaningful preference heterogeneity rather than annotation noise. More broadly, our findings highlight the importance of collecting annotator attributes and learning individuated utility functions, enabling reward models that explicitly account for whose preferences they represent and faithfully capture human decision diversity.

</details>


### [118] [SNOMED CT Concept Recommendation from Masked Clinical Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17855)
*Ali Noori*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文针对SNOMED CT概念推荐提出掩码概念恢复基准测试,在仅使用SNOMED CT实体链接挑战赛数据(204份训练病历、5317个候选概念)的低资源场景下,系统比较了稀疏TF-IDF、密集LSA、稀疏-密集融合、全文档检索证据及检索增强混合方法。稀疏TF-IDF概念原型表现最优(Recall@10达33.43%、MRR为0.1714),而检索增强并未带来提升,概念频率是性能的主导因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SNOMED CT概念推荐是临床语义互操作性的核心,但当目标概念在训练数据中稀缺或缺失时,推荐极为困难。现有工作多关注实体链接或跨度检测,缺乏对"从局部上下文推荐概念"这一任务的系统性低资源基线研究,且缺乏对检索增强是否在仅使用挑战赛数据时带来增益的明确回答。论文旨在填补该空白。

Method: 从SNOMED CT实体链接挑战赛v1.2.1(基于MIMIC-IV-Note)构建掩码概念推荐任务:对每个唯一病历-概念对,以首次标注为锚点取350字符左右上下文,将目标提及替换为[MASK],从5317个训练候选概念中排序。比较方法为流行度基线、稀疏TF-IDF原型(单/双词、子线性TF、50000特征)、96维LSA密集嵌入、稀疏-密集融合(0.75+0.25,内部验证选择)、整篇训练病历检索证据(TF-IDF余弦,top10)、检索增强混合(0.85+0.15)。以配对病历聚类bootstrap(2000次)估计不确定性,并按概念频率分层(1-2、3-10、>10)评估。还构建概念共现图oracle诊断。

Result: 在12809个闭词表测试对中,稀疏TF-IDF原型最优:Recall@1=14.81%、Recall@10=33.43%、MRR=0.2114、nDCG@10=0.2297。密集LSA弱得多(Recall@10=17.10%、MRR=0.0735);稀疏-密集融合差于纯稀疏。检索增强混合Recall@10=31.99%、MRR=0.1937,配对bootstrap显示显著低于稀疏TF-IDF(Recall@10差-0.0144,CI [-0.0184,-0.0104];MRR差-0.0177,CI [-0.0212,-0.0142])。频率分层差异显著:稀疏TF-IDF的Recall@10从罕见(1-2篇)概念的7.74%升至频繁(>10篇)概念的43.90%,中位排名从991降至14。91.42%测试概念类型在训练词表中存在,但9.66%的实例级测试对含未登录概念;若计入失败,最强模型Recall@10降至30.20%、MRR降至0.1910。oracle概念图诊断仅Recall@10=6.85%,与文本信号混合后仍低于纯稀疏。

Conclusion: 在低资源、闭词表场景下,局部词法上下文和术语覆盖率是概念推荐质量的主导因素,稀疏TF-IDF原型是最强可复现基线;粗粒度的整篇病历检索不能带来增益,密集LSA亦不能。性能受概念频率长尾分布严重制约,且9.66%测试对无法在闭词表下被恢复。后续应转向本体支撑的候选生成:索引SNOMED CT的术语、同义词、层级与关系,使用生物医学实体编码器与临床上下文编码器做细粒度检索,并以语言模型在有效候选集内重排序。该论文提供了可复现基线用于未来本体基础和生物医学编码器检索系统的对比。

Abstract: Standardizing clinical language to SNOMED CT supports interoperability, analytics, and reusable phenotyping, but concept recommendation remains difficult when relevant concepts are rare or absent from training data. We present a masked-concept recommendation benchmark using the SNOMED CT Entity Linking Challenge v1.2.1 data derived from MIMIC-IV-Note. The dataset contains 75,491 annotations across 272 discharge summaries, with 204 notes used for training and 68 for historical testing. For each unique note-concept pair, the target mention is masked from a local clinical context and the system ranks SNOMED CT concepts observed during training. We compare a popularity baseline, sparse TF-IDF concept prototypes, dense latent semantic analysis embeddings, sparse-dense fusion, retrieved-note evidence, and a retrieval-augmented hybrid. Sparse TF-IDF performs best, achieving Recall@1 of 14.81%, Recall@10 of 33.43%, MRR of 0.2114, and nDCG@10 of 0.2297. Retrieval augmentation does not improve this baseline, with Recall@10 of 31.99% and MRR of 0.1937. Performance is strongly affected by concept frequency: Recall@10 is 7.74% for concepts appearing in only one or two training notes versus 43.90% for concepts appearing in more than ten. In addition, 9.66% of test note-concept pairs contain concepts unseen during training. These findings show that local lexical context and terminology coverage are major determinants of recommendation quality in low-resource settings and provide a reproducible baseline for future ontology-grounded and biomedical-encoder retrieval systems.

</details>


### [119] [The Inference Engineering Pareto Atlas: Which Optimizations Dominate the Cost, Quality, and Latency Frontier?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17863)
*Srikanta Datta Tumkur,Jay Iyer,Mehar Simhadri,Sai Pavan Kumar,Sai Kapil Kumar,Ramesh Nampelly*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文构建了一个 LLM 推理优化的成本-质量-延迟帕累托图谱（Pareto Atlas），通过在 L4/A100/H100 三种 GPU 上实测 54 个 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 配置锚点，校准仿真器填充全配置空间，并基于 GSM8K 质量评估，给出不同部署约束下的最优配置。核心发现：FP8 权重量化是质量保持的主力军（出现在 3/4 区域最优解中），AWQ-4bit 在 L4 上延迟降至 0.34 倍但严格准确率跌破 95% 质量门槛，朴素 FP8 KV 缓存吞吐量正常但 200 题 GSM8K 全错（0/200），n-gram 推测解码在此栈上无收益；组合方法（9/15）比单一方法（9/21）更频繁地登上帕累托前沿。最优解随约束和 GPU 而变：H100 胜在低延迟，A100 胜在吞吐量和低成本（$0.106/Mtok）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 推理领域每月都有新的优化方法（量化、KV 缓存压缩、推测解码、批处理、稀疏注意力等），但各论文在不同模型、GPU、提示和质量指标下报告各自的加速倍数，无法相互比较或累加。实践中，工程师无法从论文中直接选出满足固定预算、质量底线或延迟目标的方案，缺乏一张统一的"地图"来指导部署决策。

Method: 采用"先实测后仿真"（measure-then-simulate）的策略：（1）在 L4、A100 80GB PCIe、H100 PCIe 三块 GPU（RunPod 实例）上，使用 vLLM 0.12 部署 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，实测 54 个锚点配置（每 GPU 18 个），记录质量、TTFT、TPOT（P50/P99）、吞吐量、显存和成本/百万 token；（2）基于 Vidur 框架的剖析式仿真器，用这些锚点进行校准，跨多次实验漂移低于 1.5%；（3）质量评估在 GSM8K（200 题，5-shot，贪心解码）上测试 FP16、AWQ-4bit、FP8 权重、FP8 KV 缓存的严格和灵活准确率；（4）仿真器填充全配置空间后，在（质量、延迟、成本）三维上计算帕累托前沿，并标注紧延迟、高吞吐、低成本三个部署约束下的主导配置；（5）稀疏注意力仅在仿真中评估，推测解码因 vLLM 0.12 V1 引擎的 NotImplementedError 限制只能测 n-gram 版本。

Result: 主要结果：（1）36 个配置中 18 个到达帕累托前沿；组合方法 9/15 到达前沿 vs 单一方法 9/21；（2）FP8 权重保留 99.4% 准确率（严格 0.760 vs 基线 0.765），延迟降至 0.61-0.65 倍，是跨 GPU 的可移植默认；（3）AWQ-4bit 在 L4 上延迟降至 0.34 倍基线，但严格准确率从 0.765 降至 0.720（-5.9%），勉强错过 95% 质量底线，差距落在 n=200 的 ±3pp 采样误差内；灵活提取恢复至 0.810，说明损失来自格式而非算术；（4）朴素 FP8 KV 缓存 200 题全错（0/200），但吞吐量正常——纯速度基准会推荐它但帕累托图谱会剔除；（5）n-gram 推测解码在两种提示设计下测得 0.90-0.98 倍基线，无收益；（6）部署分区赢家：紧延迟→H100 上的 low_latency_stack（$4.62/Mtok）；高吞吐/低成本→A100 上的 throughput_stack（$0.106/Mtok）；质量底线→A100 上的 batched（$0.289/Mtok）；（7）L4 无配置满足紧延迟预算。

Conclusion: 论文贡献：（1）构建了一份成本-质量-延迟帕累托图谱，将各优化方法及其组合放在统一坐标轴上，并在每个部署区域命名主导配置；（2）提出"先实测后仿真"方法论，用剖析式仿真器从实测锚点外推覆盖全配置空间；（3）总结实践规则：FP8 权重量化是质量保持的工作马；AWQ 在预算硅片上提供更大速度但触及质量底线；朴素 FP8 KV 缓存速度快但完全失效；n-gram 推测在此栈无增益；最优配置随约束和 GPU 变化，H100 适合紧延迟，A100 适合吞吐和低成本。若 A100 价格上涨 50%，成本和质量底线赢家将转向 L4。可复现的协议（锚点→校准→前沿→图谱）才是真正持久的交付物，单独坐标会随内核成熟度和价格变化而失效。

Abstract: LLM inference optimizations report speedups on different models, GPUs, prompts, and quality metrics, making them hard to compare or combine. We build a cost, quality, and latency Pareto atlas to identify the best configurations for different deployment constraints. Since exhaustive testing is impractical, we measure 54 configurations of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct running on vLLM 0.12 across L4, A100, and H100 GPUs and use these anchors to calibrate a simulator. It reproduces measurements at anchored batch sizes, with cross campaign drift below 1.5 percent. A separate quality evaluation tests FP16, AWQ 4bit, FP8 weights, and FP8 KV cache on 200 GSM8K questions with five examples per prompt. Sparse attention is evaluated only in simulation. On the calibrated grid, 18 of 36 configurations reach the Pareto frontier. Combined methods reach it more often than individual methods, with 9 of 15 combinations versus 9 of 21 single methods. Quality testing changes the winners. AWQ 4bit reduces per token latency to 0.34 times baseline on L4 but loses 5.9 percent of strict GSM8K accuracy, narrowly missing the 95 percent quality floor within sampling uncertainty. Flexible answer extraction matches FP16 accuracy, suggesting the loss comes from formatting rather than arithmetic. FP8 weights retain 99.4 percent of baseline accuracy at 0.61 to 0.65 times baseline latency across all three GPUs and appear in three of four regime winners. A naive FP8 KV cache maintains normal throughput but answers none of the 200 questions correctly, showing why speed alone is insufficient. Under two prompt designs, n gram speculative decoding measures at 0.90 to 0.98 times baseline and adds no benefit on this stack. The best choice depends on the constraint and GPU: H100 wins for tight latency, while A100 wins for throughput and low cost at 0.106 dollars per million tokens.

</details>


### [120] [Do Frontier Models Seek Safety Evidence Before Acting?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17865)
*Omer Tafveez*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 SAFE 基准测试，研究四个前沿大模型（GPT-5.5、o3、Claude Opus 4.8、Claude Sonnet 4.6）在部署前是否主动获取安全证据的决策行为，发现证据获取是一项独立于下游响应的安全维度，其行为主要由严重程度和检索成本驱动，而非概率信号或"不愿知情"的偏好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全评估多关注模型在风险信息已知后如何响应，而忽视了更上游的决策点：模型是否愿意主动获取安全证据。行为经济学中的"策略性无知"和"道德回旋空间"理论为这一上游决策提供了预测框架。
