This highlights the benefits of principled low-rank Koopman representations and opens up broader potential for applications.

</details>


### [220] [The Free Inference Dimension: Complexity Measure for Zero-Collision Navigation under Hypothesis Mixtures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17816)
*Luiz Carlos Castro Guedes,Edward Hermann Haeusler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对有限元强化学习（meta-RL）中"嵌套约束族"场景，提出一种新的组合复杂度度量——自由推理维度（Free Inference Dimension, d_FI），用于刻画值混合（VM）智能体在不识别真实环境的情况下实现零碰撞导航的能力上限，并将其与经典VC维、Littlestone维、Natarajan维以及后验众数选择（PMS）维度建立联系，给出理论界、PAC风格泛化界和最优混合策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在Solomonoff归纳/Bayes-自适应控制框架下，平均策略（VM）与选择策略（PMS）何者优先是一个核心问题。作者先前工作发现：对于"嵌套"环境族，VM智能体可在不识别真实环境的前提下，以近似最优、零碰撞方式到达目标——这一"自由推理"现象在密度阈值ρc≈0.7前持续存在。作者希望为该经验相变建立严格的复杂度理论基础，回答"其组合维度是什么、如何嵌入经典维度层级"的问题，并弥合"无碰撞容量"与"识别代价"两类复杂度度量之间的空白。

Method: 方法包括（a）构造对抗性"FI打散博弈"，定义d_FI(S,N)为在所有N级嵌套赋值下均能保持自由推理的最大约束集规模；（b）定义"一致性分数"C(V)作为路径边缘的连续证书，建立C(V)≥0与自由推理等价的刻画定理；（d）提出ε-自由推理及PAC风格松弛维度d_FI^{ε,δ}，借助Natarajan-Haussler增长函数界与Hoeffding不等式推导泛化界；（e）定义PMS识别维度d_PMS并证明混合策略（VM首次碰撞后切换PMS）的最优性；（f）将d_FI与VC、Littlestone、Randomized Littlestone、Stackelberg-Littlestone维度比较，强调"非自适应对手"造成的指数级差距；（g）在六种网格规模、四种族大小N∈{2,5,10,20}的Random-Maze上进行经验验证，包括ρc随N的标度律、泛化界成立率100%以及相变带（Δρ≈0.10–0.15）的精细分辨分析。

Result: 主要结果：（1）证明d_FI<d_VC（相干性间隙Δ_coh≈0.3|S|，约43%开销）；（2）证明d_FI≤d_Nat≤d_FI·L_max；（3）证明泛化界Pr_new≤p_hat+√[d·log(mN)+log(1/δ)/(2m)]；（4）证明d_PMS≤N-1且混合策略B_hybrid(ε)≤分段函数界定；（5）定位非自适应差距：d_FI=Θ(|S|) vs Ldim=O(log N)，20×10网格、N=10时d_FI≈140对比Ldim=3，比例≈47；（6）实验显示ρc(N)在N=2→20上从0.50非递减饱和至≈0.65–0.70，跨网格稳定；（7）泛化界在29个信息性配置中100%成立；（8）精细分辨率下相变带宽度Δρ≈0.10–0.15，ε≈0.15可使失败率由23%降至近零。

Conclusion: 结论：自由推理维度d_FI为嵌套约束族下安全元强化学习提供了可测、可检验的组合复杂度工具，连接了Solomonoff式混合预测、Bayes自适应控制、元RL任务推断与结构化对手在线学习理论；d_FI与d_PMS构成互补二元组，形成"平均—容差—识别"三区间图像与相应最优混合策略；非适应性是造成d_FI相对Littlestone维度呈指数级分离的结构性原因。开放问题包括推广至非嵌套族、定义导航专用Littlestone型维度、形式化非自适应随机Littlestone学习、推导相变带有限尺寸标度律以及刻画对手构造对渐近临界密度的影响。

Abstract: Solomonoff induction frames prediction as a mixture over computable hypotheses, typically leading to identification of the true environment. In a finite meta-reinforcement learning setting with nested constraint families, in our previous work, we observe a different regime: a value-mixture (VM) agent achieves near-optimal, zero-collision navigation without identifying the true environment, a phenomenon we call Free Inference. This regime persists up to a sharp density threshold, beyond which performance degrades and posterior-mode selection (PMS) becomes preferable. We formalize this behavior via the Free Inference dimension dFI(S,N), a combinatorial measure of the environmental complexity a VM agent can handle while preserving trajectory coherence. We prove dFI is strictly smaller than the VC-dimension and relates to the Natarajan dimension up to a path-length factor, capturing the cost of non-decomposable loss. A PAC-style relaxation yields generalization bounds driven by dFI^(epsilon,delta). We also define a complementary PMS identification dimension and show that a hybrid strategy---averaging until the first collision, then switching to selection---is optimal, with links to Littlestone-type dimensions supported by grid-world experiments.

</details>


### [221] [Procedural Pretraining for Molecular Property Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17831)
*Moritz Friedemann,Zachary Shinnick,Philip Torr,Bruno Andreis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种三阶段训练流程（程序性预训练 → 分子预训练 → 下游微调），证明在接触任何分子数据之前，从抽象的算法生成数据中学习到的归纳偏置可以提升分子属性预测性能，且在低数据场景下尤为有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子属性预测常受限于下游标注数据稀缺；现有方法依赖大规模分子语料进行预训练，但成本高昂且不一定必要。本文探索一个问题：模型能否在看到任何分子之前，从完全抽象的程序性数据中学习到有用的计算结构？

Method: 采用三阶段管线：(1) 程序性预训练——在五种程序生成任务上训练（Reverse序列反转、Dyck平衡括号、Dyck-Shuffle交叉括号、NCA神经细胞自动机、SSP最短路径），均以掩码token预测形式进行；(2) 分子预训练——在PubChem 250K子集上以MTM目标继续训练；(3) 下游微调——在Lipophilicity、FreeSolv、QM9上微调。基模型为MoLFormer（~44M参数）。消融实验包括：移除分子预训练阶段、token乱序控制、选择性权重迁移（仅注意力层或仅前馈层）。

Result: 1) 在Lipophilicity上，Reverse任务预训练使测试误差降低4.8%，相当于恢复了250K分子基线与100M分子预训练的MoLFormer之间约90%的性能差距；2) 收益在低数据场景下最大（QM9训练集从108K缩减到1K时，迁移优势单调增长）；3) 程序性预训练预算并非越多越好——四个任务中下游性能在中等预算处达峰，过度训练导致过专门化；4) 乱序token消除所有下游收益，证明迁移依赖结构性而非表面统计量；5) 对多个任务而言，可迁移信息主要存储在注意力层，前馈层与过专门化相关。

Conclusion: 程序性数据可为分子学习提供有用的结构先验，与领域内预训练形成互补，对标注数据稀缺场景尤为有效。这表明提升分子学习效果不仅需要更多分子数据，还需要更好的方式在模型接触分子之前塑造其归纳偏置。开放问题包括：哪些属性使程序性任务可迁移、能否从训练动态预测最佳停止点、以及在更大模型和科学领域中的普适性。

Abstract: Molecular property prediction is often limited by the small size of labeled downstream datasets, motivating pretraining on large corpora of unlabeled molecules. In this work, we ask whether useful inductive biases can instead be learned from abstract, procedurally generated data before a model sees any molecular data. We introduce a three-stage training pipeline consisting of procedural pretraining, molecular pretraining on SMILES, and downstream fine-tuning, and evaluate several procedural tasks spanning sequence structure, cellular automata, and graph reasoning. We find that procedural pretraining can improve molecular property prediction even after subsequent molecular pretraining: on Lipophilicity, \textsc{Reverse} reduces test error by 4.8\%. For context, the magnitude of this improvement is roughly 90\% of the performance difference between our 250K-molecule baseline and the publicly released MoLFormer checkpoint pretrained on approximately 100M molecules. Our analysis shows that the benefit is strongest under downstream data scarcity, depends on the structure of the procedural data rather than only surface-level statistics, and does not increase monotonically with additional procedural training. Instead, transfer typically peaks at an intermediate procedural budget and deteriorates as the model approaches convergence on the procedural task. We further find that, for several tasks, much of the transferable information is localized in the attention layers, while feed-forward layers can contribute to over-specialization. These results show that procedural data can provide transferable structure for molecular learning and offer a complementary route to improving performance when labeled molecular data are limited.

</details>


### [222] [Adaptive hybrid coupling with operator inference, the overlapping Schwarz alternating method and reinforcement learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17837)
*Trishit Mondal,Irina Tezaur,Anthony Gruber*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RL–O-SAM框架：使用深度Q网络（DQN）在重叠Schwarz交替方法（O-SAM）耦合的FOM/OpInf ROM混合仿真中，实现在线自适应切换子域模型保真度，平衡精度、计算成本与切换频率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于Schwarz交替方法的FOM-ROM混合耦合框架中，子域模型在仿真开始前预先指定并保持固定。对于具有移动局部特征（如激波、传播波）的瞬态问题，这种静态分配策略会使高分辨率区域与实际物理需求失配，导致误差累积。缺乏可靠误差指示器是实现动态切换的主要障碍。

Method: 1) OpInf构建离线子域ROM；2) O-SAM迭代耦合子域问题；3) 使用DQN在"决策窗口"粒度上选择FOM/ROM配置（甚至域分解）；奖励函数综合计算成本、相对误差和切换惩罚；离线训练后在线推理，无需参考解。提出两种动作空间：固定DD和自适应DD。

Result: 1D对流扩散（移动前沿）：固定DD策略相对L²误差8.02×10⁻⁴，比最优静态含ROM配置精度高约5倍，墙时低于全FOM；自适应DD无额外收益。3D弹性波（Norma.jl）：两子域误差1.59×10⁻²，三子域误差3.90×10⁻³，分别比最优静态配置精度高约15倍和40倍。DQN有效追踪传播波前，分配FOM至含波子域，ROM配置于其余区域。策略对训练未见参数组合表现出泛化能力。

Conclusion: RL–O-SAM展示了强化学习实现在线预测性模型保真度自适应调节的潜力，可泛化至训练未见的物理参数。推荐在固定DD框架内采用，因自适应DD未带来改进。后续方向：在线OpInf更新（streaming OpInf）、非线性3D固体问题、更复杂RL方法。

Abstract: Hybrid domain decomposition methods provide a flexible framework for coupling full order models (FOMs) and reduced order models (ROMs), but typically assume the model assigned to each subdomain is fixed throughout a simulation. This is limiting for transient problems in which localized features propagate through the domain and the regions requiring high-fidelity resolution change over time. We introduce a reinforcement learning (RL)-based approach for online adaptation of FOM-ROM models coupled via the overlapping Schwarz alternating method (O-SAM), an iterative domain decomposition method that solves subdomain-local problems while exchanging solution information through transmission boundary conditions on overlapping interfaces. Deep Q-networks (DQNs) are trained offline to select among subdomain-local FOMs and pre-trained Operator Inference (OpInf) ROMs using a reward balancing accuracy, cost, and model-switching frequency. Once trained, the policies are deployed predictively on problem instances not seen during training, without requiring a reference FOM solution. We demonstrate the approach on two examples: a 1D advection-diffusion problem with a moving front, and a 3D linear elastic wave propagation problem implemented in the this http URL solid mechanics code. For the advection-diffusion benchmark, the learned policy dynamically allocates high-fidelity resolution as the front propagates and outperforms static FOM/ROM assignments; letting the agent also adapt the domain decomposition provides no further benefit. For the elastic wave benchmark, learned policies for two and three subdomain decompositions track the propagating wave by assigning FOMs to subdomains containing the wave and ROMs elsewhere, as expected. Our results demonstrate the potential of RL to enable predictive online adaptation of model fidelity within Schwarz-based hybrid simulations.

</details>


### [223] [Walking the Score Manifold: Continuous-time Generative Dynamics on Learned Data Manifolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17901)
*Jan Tauberschmidt,Brian B. Moser,Stanislav Frolov,Andreas Dengel,Andrew B. Duncan,Sebastian J. Vollmer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于预训练分数模型的连续时间生成式动力学框架，将数据生成视为在学习到的数据流形上的连续时间演化过程。该方法支持任意时刻生成、时间超分辨率、随机未来轨迹预测，并在视频和科学动力学数据上取得了良好效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的时间依赖数据生成模型通常建立在离散时间网格上，仅能在训练数据的观测时间戳上进行监督，限制了模型在任意时刻生成和时间超分辨率方面的能力。作者希望突破这一限制，将生成过程视为连续时间流形上的演化。

Method: 1. 利用预训练的基于分数的扩散模型（score-based models）作为数据流形的几何先验；2. 学习一个向量场，使数据沿分数诱导的插值路径演化；3. 引入横向指数稳定性目标（transverse exponential stability objective），其实际解释为沿插值路径横向的去噪分数匹配；4. 通过回归目标实现无仿真器（simulation-free）训练；5. 扩展到概率设置，建模未来轨迹的分布。

Result: 在自然视频和科学动力学数据（包括PDE时空场、分子动力学）上的实验表明，该方法能够实现时间超分辨率、生成任意时刻的样本，并在长时域滚动中保持鲁棒性。分数先验为学习随机连续时间生成动力学提供了坚实基础。

Conclusion: 基于分数的先验为学习随机连续时间生成动力学提供了强大的基础。该几何框架通过将生成视为流形上的连续时间演化，突破了离散时间网格的限制，实现了灵活的时间生成能力。

Abstract: Generative modeling of time-dependent data is typically formulated on a discrete temporal grid, restricting supervision to the observed timestamps in the training data. We instead frame generation as continuous-time evolution on a learned data manifold. To this end, we leverage pretrained score-based models as geometric priors and learn a vector field that evolves data along score-induced interpolation paths. Because these dynamics follow transitions that respect the geometry learned by the score model, they support generation at arbitrary timestamps and temporal super-resolution beyond the discretization of the training data. Moreover, this geometric formulation allows us to train the vector field simulation-free through a regression objective. To improve long-horizon rollout robustness, we introduce an objective that promotes path-relative transverse exponential stability. While motivated by stability theory, it admits a practical interpretation as denoising score matching transverse to the interpolation path. Further, we extend the framework to a probabilistic setting that models a distribution over plausible future trajectories. We demonstrate the method on natural video and scientific dynamical data, including temporal super-resolution, PDE-based spatiotemporal fields, and molecular dynamics. Our results show that score-based priors provide a strong foundation for learning stochastic continuous-time generative dynamics.

</details>


### [224] [The Attention Within: Consensus Dynamics in Selective State Space Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17997)
*João Pedro Silvestre,Álvaro Rodríguez Abella,Paulo Tabuada*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从动力系统角度分析选择性状态空间模型（SSM）中的共识现象，将 Mamba-2 的跨层 token 演化建模为常微分方程，并证明了共识平衡点的局部指数稳定性及吸引域的刻画。实验表明，输出门（output gate）是调节共识程度、阻止 token 完全汇聚的关键组件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer 中已知注意力机制会驱动 token 趋于共识（坍缩到单一方向），而选择性 SSM 与 Transformer 结构相似但机制不同。作者想探究：SSM 核心的循环结构是否同样驱动 token 走向共识？现有 SSM 共识分析仅限于时不变参数且无归一化的设置，无法覆盖实际模型。

Method: 1. 推导 Mamba-2 的连续时间模型：展开隐藏状态递推，将 token 演化写成流形 $(\mathbb{S}^{n-1})^\ell$ 上的 ODE，包含层归一化、多维 token、时变权重。2. 利用 SSM 的因果级联（cascade）结构，将 token 收敛归结为标量微分方程。3. 使用输入到状态稳定性（ISS）论证和持续激励（PE）条件，通过归纳法证明共识平衡点的局部指数稳定性。4. 在更强的全局正定性假设下，刻画吸引域，并引入各向异性度量 $c_\star$ 和有效阈值 $c_{\mathrm{eff}}$。5. 在预训练 mamba2-130m 模型上做数值实验，验证理论结果并分析输出门和 SiLU 非线性的作用。

Result: 1. 证明了时变权重矩阵下共识平衡点的局部指数稳定性（Theorem IV.1），这是首个针对该设置的 SSM 共识分析。2. 在全局正定假设下，给出了几乎完整（co-null）的吸引域刻画：token 不收敛到共识当且仅当其 $\tilde\mu$ 分量始终小于有效阈值 $c_{\mathrm{eff}}$（Theorem V.1）。3. 各向异性度量 $c_\star$ 越大，$c_{\mathrm{eff}}$ 越大，吸引域越小；各向同性时 $c_{\mathrm{eff}}=0$，吸引域为全空间去测度零集。4. 实验显示：移除输出门后 token 几乎完全对齐（$\bar\lambda_1\approx 0.8$, $r\approx 1.4$），保留门则对齐程度显著降低（$\bar\lambda_1\approx 0.45$, $r\approx 4$），表明输出门阻止了完全共识。5. SiLU 非线性在随机权重下将交互项的均值从 0 偏置为正（Lemma IV.1），从而促成共识。

Conclusion: 选择性 SSM 与 Transformer 的相似性不仅体现在输入输出表示上，更体现在深度诱导的 token 动力学上：SSM 核心的循环结构同样驱动 token 聚合趋向共识。输出门是阻止 token 完全收敛到单一方向的关键组件，这意味着门控机制对维持 token 多样性具有根本性作用。该工作为时变权重下的 SSM 提供了首个共识分析的理论框架。

Abstract: Selective state space models (SSMs) have recently emerged as a compelling alternative to transformers, combining competitive performance with substantially improved inference efficiency. At each SSM layer, a sequence of hidden states are propagated by a recurrence, mixing information of different tokens. Despite using a different mechanism, this mixing plays a role analogous to attention in transformers. In fact, recent works have shown that the two architectures may be closer than they first appear, as this recurrence admits a formulation akin to linear attention. In transformers, attention is known to drive the tokens to cluster, i.e., to reach consensus, collapsing in the limit to a single direction. Thus, we ask: does the recurrence at the core of SSMs drive the tokens to consensus, as attention does in transformers? To answer this question, we take a dynamical systems perspective on SSMs, modeling the evolution of tokens across layers as an ordinary differential equation. By exploiting input-to-state stability arguments, we establish local exponential stability of the consensus equilibria and characterize their domain of attraction for time-varying weight matrices, a setting not addressed by previous results. We thereby show that the resemblance between SSMs and transformers does run deeper: the recurrence at the core of SSMs aggregates tokens just as attention does. Numerical experiments on a pretrained Mamba-2 model point to the output gate as the component that regulates the extent of this consensus, preventing the tokens from reaching it in full.

</details>


### [225] [Agora: Git as Shared Memory for Collective AutoResearch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18094)
*Yifan Zhang,Yunheng Zou,Shaokun Zhang,Jian Hu,Hao Zhang,Binfeng Xu,Jan Kautz,Yi Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Agora是一个基于Git的共享记忆系统，通过将研究贡献记录为不可变的DAG提交，实现多个自主编码代理的协作研究。其首次大规模运行中，13个语言模型代理在12天内、141个预训练模型支持下，无需训练数据或梯度更新，将119.6M参数的混合注意力-SSM模型从3.39降至1.899 bpb（bits per byte），缩小了与训练后的GPT-2 124M之间62%的差距，发布了1,703项贡献并完成了165次独立复现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单个自主研究代理（如AutoResearch）虽然能独立改进训练设置，但当多个代理并行运行时，每个会话都从零开始，导致更多重复搜索而非更多发现。现有框架通过角色或对话组织任务，但缺乏跨会话持续存在的状态：公开前沿、不可变谱系、负面结果、独立验证。研究社区需要的是持久的公共记忆层，而非会话级的临时工作树。

Method: 核心机制：1) 将研究建模为仅追加的有向无环图（DAG），存储在Git中，每个贡献是不可变的提交（包含工件、声明、指标、谱系），父边表示构建关系；2) 派生SQLite索引，支持前沿、忽视分支、验证状态等查询；3) 质量评分基于跨账户的后续工作加权（排除自我引用），verdict标签区分确认/部分/失败复现；4) 多样性感知的注意力分配，采用类似UCB的评分公式，结合质量百分位、后续工作数和近重复描述惩罚；5) 三类建议槽位（exploit/explore known/explore novel）防止社区陷入单一最优盆地。原型为Go服务+CLI+Next.js Web界面，包含26个HTTP路由和15个CLI命令组。

Result: 权重迁移任务结果：13个代理账户（worker1-5运行在A100，slurm_worker_1-8运行在H100）使用Claude Opus 4.7和GPT-5.5，完成1,703项贡献（1,124个评分结果、284个洞察、203个假设、165个验证、1个报告）。最佳方法包含两阶段：Stage A通过6个捐赠者模型在28个上下文下构建上下文平均bigram表，经随机化SVD分解为嵌入和输出头；Stage B通过96维带状隐藏状态的稀疏确定性编辑重新启用子层。最佳贡献的145提交谱系跨越15个账户，165次独立复现均成功。轨迹分析显示前18个评分贡献贡献了约98%的总下降，前8个改进贡献约70%；696对不同账户的相同分数中63%在1小时内、80%在6小时内出现，表明存在大量并行发现。仅一次人类干预（5月2日部署聚类和多样性视图）使社区在一天内打破了五天的一元化停滞。

Conclusion: 核心发现：协调层而非单个代理是性能瓶颈。Git支持的谱系、派生索引和多样性感知的注意力分配构成足够的基础设施。但该运行未能确立因果关系，因为没有运行无Agora或仅使用普通排行榜的对照实验。提出的匹配评估矩阵（Appendix C）定义了四个实验组（隔离/扁平日志/中央规划器/Agora）来测量共享研究状态何时能真正改善每单位计算资源的发现率。论文建议下一步工作应进行预先注册的对照比较。

Abstract: Autonomous research loops such as AutoResearch show that one coding agent can improve a training setup unattended. Run several of them and each session starts from scratch, so more agents tend to mean more duplicated search rather than more discovery. Agora is a shared memory for such agents: research is recorded as an append-only directed acyclic graph (DAG) stored in Git, so that every claim is a commit anyone can check out and rerun. Each result, insight, hypothesis, verification, and report is an immutable commit whose parent edges say what it builds on; a derived index exposes the frontier, the neglected branches, and the verification status of each claim, and a diversity-aware selection rule keeps the community from collapsing onto one leader. We describe the system and report its first sustained use: a run of nearly 12 days in which 13 language-model workers, with no assigned tasks and no central planner, worked on a weight-transfer problem. Given 141 pretrained donor models and a frozen 119.6M-parameter attention-SSM hybrid whose dimensions match no donor, the workers had to initialize the target without training data or gradient updates. They published 1,703 contributions and drove the evaluator from 3.39 to 1.899 bits per byte, closing 62% of the gap to a trained GPT-2 124M. The winning recipe compresses donor next-token statistics into the target's embedding and output head, then adds a short-range context signal through sparse edits to attention, feed-forward, and state-space blocks. Its 145-commit ancestry spans 15 accounts, and 165 independent reproductions were posted, none of which failed. We describe the single mid-run human intervention that pulled the community out of a monoculture, what the trace does and does not establish, and the controlled comparison that would settle whether shared research state improves discovery per unit of compute.

</details>


### [226] [Rethinking How We Evaluate Methodological Progress in Health AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18134)
*Florent Pollet,Matthew McDermott*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文实证研究EHR-AI算法评估中的两大障碍（可复现性与临床有意义的任务设计），通过统一框架复现12种算法并在MIMIC-IV与NWICU上对比"随机生成任务"与"专家定义的临床有意义任务"。核心发现：(1)算法相对排名在不同数据集与任务家族间高度一致（一致性76%-92%）；(2)临床有意义任务呈现更强的任务-算法交互结构；(3)近年方法并不系统性优于早期方法——结合极宽极稀疏特征表示的梯度提升树（XGBoost）表现最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EHR-AI领域长期受困于两大障碍：一是临床有意义评估任务的定义困难，二是可复现性危机。研究者无法确定算法间的相对优劣是否会在不同任务/数据集上保持一致，从而难以积累方法论知识。本文旨在通过统一评估框架实证回答这一问题。

Method: 构建基于MEDS标准的统一评估框架，复现12种历史与近期算法（RETAIN、ICU-XGBoost、BEHRT、MOTOR、DuETT、MEDS-Tab系列、TECO、MEDS-EIC-AR等）。在两个数据集（MIMIC-IV和NWICU）上对比两类任务家族：10个专家定义的临床有意义任务（ACES标准）与10个随机生成任务（EveryQuery风格）。采用agentic AI（Claude Code+Opus 5）辅助实现，每个模型分配一名agent并通过合成数据验证、MEDS-DEV集成测试、MIMIC演示任务等多阶段检验。统计方法包括：配对一致率（10^6次随机排列检验+Holm校正）、任务级反转率、双因素方差分解、Spearman秩相关+任务引导自助法。

Result: **Q1（跨设置迁移性）**：配对一致率76%-92%，MIMIC-IV随机生成↔NWICU随机生成最高（92%），MIMIC-IV随机生成↔临床有意义任务91%，均显著高于随机水平。MEDS-Tab-large在四个设置中均居首；TECO、MEDS-Tab-LR、BEHRT在四个设置中均垫底。**Q2（结构化交互）**：临床有意义任务的任务级反转率（MC 15.2%, NC 16.7%）显著高于随机生成任务（MG 8.3%, NG 10.9%）；方差分解显示交互项在临床任务中占~24%、随机任务<10%；跨数据集概念匹配任务的算法排名Kendall τ_b=0.601（匹配）vs 0.437（同六概念的非匹配），置换检验p=0.019；预训练目标与预测视野的相关性假设在NWICU上得到验证（Spearman ρ=0.795, p=0.016）。**Q3（方法论进展）**：最佳管线是MEDS-Tab-large（XGBoost+极宽稀疏表格化），但其优势来自数据表征而非新架构；新算法并不系统性优于早期方法；MEDS-EIC-AR在性能-计算成本Pareto前沿上以低成本提供竞争性表现。

Conclusion: 提出"两阶段评估策略"：先用廉价随机生成任务估计稳定成分，再分析系统偏离以挖掘任务/数据集/算法特性知识。结论：方法论知识的积累比预期更具挑战性，但具有结构化异质性的分析价值；agentic AI+共享数据/接口标准（MEDS、MEDS-DEV、ACES）大幅降低了比较研究的工程门槛。局限性：仅两个数据集、12种算法、每设置仅10个任务、复现非精确重制、未跨随机种子重复训练。

Abstract: Methodological progress in artificial intelligence (AI) for electronic health records (EHRs) depends on our ability to determine which algorithms work better, and under which conditions. However, such progress is thought to be hindered by difficulties in reproducibility and in defining clinically meaningful evaluation tasks. We empirically study these barriers by re-implementing 12 historical and recent algorithms within a shared evaluation framework and evaluating them on two clinical datasets, MIMIC-IV and NWICU. We compare two complementary task families: expert-authored clinically meaningful tasks and generated tasks defined from randomly sampled event codes and prediction horizons. We ask whether relative algorithms comparisons transfer across task families and datasets, whether residual task heterogeneity contains useful methodological structure, and what a controlled comparison reveals about progress over the last decade. We find that aggregate pairwise comparisons transfer strongly across evaluation settings, including from randomly generated tasks to clinically meaningful tasks and across datasets. At the same time, clinically meaningful tasks exhibit greater task-method interaction, providing preliminary evidence that task properties can help explain when particular modeling choices are advantageous. Finally, newer algorithms do not consistently outperform earlier approaches: gradient-boosted trees remain highly competitive when paired with a modern, wide and sparse representation of the EHR. Together, these results suggest that useful methodological knowledge may require less task engineering than commonly assumed, while highlighting the importance of understanding the structured heterogeneity that remains across tasks and methods.

</details>


### [227] [MoRE: Mixture of Reused Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18176)
*Eric S. Qiu,Utku Umur Acikalin,Justin Lovelace,Christian Belardi,Arjun B. Mulchandani,Carla P. Gomes,Kilian Q. Weinberger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MoRE（Mixture of Reused Experts）是一种混合架构，通过让相邻层共享专家池（reuse factor R=2）并引入可学习的层深度嵌入（depth embedding），在保持参数量不变的情况下，将每层路由组合空间从 C(N, K) 扩展到 C(2N, K)（约18倍），并在 114M–1.15B 三个规模上一致性地超越标准 MoE（DeepSeek-v3）、Dense 和 MoEUT 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 MoE 每层模型维护独立的专家池，路由组合空间受限于 C(N, K)，扩展空间必须线性增加参数；而完全权重共享的 Transformer（如 Universal Transformer、MoEUT）虽参数高效，但通常缺乏足够的语言建模容量。作者希望结合两者的长处：不增加参数的前提下扩展路由空间，并允许跨层复用专家。

Method: 1) 在相邻 R 层之间通过权重绑定共享同一个大小为 R·N 的专家池，每层保留独立的路由器；2) 引入轻量级可学习的层深度嵌入 d_ℓ，在路由前对输入做加性偏移，使共享专家能区分所在层；3) 实现上仅需修改 expert 之间的权重 tying 并增加一个深度嵌入向量，无需自定义归一化、门控机制或训练稳定化技巧；4) 路由分析显示早期层专家复用率约为随机基线的两倍，随深度递减。

Result: 在 114M/369M/1.15B 三种规模（均匹配参数量和 FLOPs）上，MoRE 在 C4 验证集 perplexity 和 OLMo3 下游任务（LAMBADA、HellaSwag、PIQA、ARC-E、SciQ 等）上一致优于 DeepSeek-v3、Dense 和 MoEUT；统计配对引导检验（α=0.05）确认大多数提升显著；消融实验显示 R≥2 均优于基线但差异不显著，块状相邻共享（A-A-B-B-C-C）优于非对齐和随机共享；CKA 分析表明相邻层表征相似度最高（0.91）；在 Mixtral、Qwen3MoE 架构和 FineWeb 数据上同样验证了泛化性；吞吐量达 DeepSeek 的 96%（配合 SonicMoE），峰值显存基本持平。

Conclusion: MoRE 证明跨层专家复用是提升稀疏语言模型效率的实用路径：通过共享专家池加每层路由与轻量深度嵌入，在不增加参数和几乎不修改实现的前提下，扩展了路由组合空间并实现了跨层专家复用，在所有测试规模上一致降低 perplexity 并提升下游准确率。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures decouple model capacity from computational cost, yet incur high memory footprints as parameters grow linearly with the number of experts. Recurrent Transformers achieve parameter efficiency by reusing layer weights, but typically lack the capacity for competitive language modeling. We propose Mixture of Reused Experts (MoRE), a hybrid that shares expert pools across groups of adjacent layers. Each layer retains its own router but selects from a larger shared pool, expanding the diversity of routing combinations without additional parameters. To enable shared experts to distinguish between layers, we introduce lightweight learnable depth embeddings that condition each layer's input before routing. Experiments across three model scales (114M-1.15B parameters) show that MoRE consistently achieves lower perplexity and stronger downstream performance than standard MoEs and state-of-the-art weight-sharing architectures at matched compute and parameter budgets, with only minimal modifications to existing MoE implementations.

</details>


### [228] [A Lightweight CNN Integrated Compact Convolutional Transformer for Multi-Scale Feature Learning and reducing computational complexity for breast cancer mammography image detection and classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18212)
*Md Taimur Ahad,Ainuddin Ahmed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种将CNN与紧凑型卷积Transformer（CCT）相结合的轻量级混合架构，用于乳腺癌 mammography 图像分类。该模型仅含约25万参数，在3个乳腺X线摄影数据集上通过5折交叉验证达到99%-100%的准确率，并集成了可解释AI（XAI）以增强临床可信度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1. 传统CNN在医学图像分类中虽表现强劲，但难以捕获长距离上下文依赖关系。2. 现有Transformer模型（如ViT）参数量大，计算成本高，不适合资源受限的临床环境。3. CNN在深层易出现梯度退化问题，影响分类性能。4. 缺乏可解释性限制了AI模型在临床诊断中的信任度与实际部署。

Method: 1. 提出CNN + Compact Convolutional Transformer（CCT）混合架构。2. 利用CNN提取初步特征后，通过CCT tokenizer将特征图重塑为紧凑的patch tokens。3. 引入位置编码（positional embeddings）以保留空间结构信息。4. 在CCT层后整合Transformer编码器，捕获长距离依赖关系。5. 采用5折交叉验证在3个乳腺X线摄影数据集上进行评估。6. 集成可解释AI（XAI）模块解释分类决策过程。7. 模型参数量仅250,435，远小于标准ViT。

Result: 1. 在3个乳腺癌 mammography 数据集上，5折交叉验证准确率达到99%-100%。2. 模型仅含250,435个参数，相比ViT显著更轻量。3. 混合架构有效克服了CNN深层梯度退化问题。4. XAI模块成功解释了分类过程，提升了临床可信度。5. 证明了框架在不同数据集上的鲁棒泛化能力。

Conclusion: 本文提出的CNN-CCT混合框架以极少的参数量（25万）在乳腺癌分类任务中取得了接近完美的准确率，同时通过可解释AI增强了模型的临床可用性。该架构特别适用于计算资源受限的临床辅助诊断（CAD）系统部署，兼具轻量化、长距离依赖捕获能力和可解释性，为医学影像AI的临床落地提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Over the years, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have demonstrated strong capability in cancer detection and classification using medical images. However, CNN-based models often struggle to capture long-range contextual dependencies. In such scenarios, integrating Compact Convolutional Transformer (CCT) architectures after the CCT layer allows CNN-extracted features to reshape into compact patch tokens using a CCT tokenizer, followed by the addition of positional embeddings to preserve spatial structure. Using 5-fold cross-validation, the model was tested on 3 sets of breast cancer mammography. With only 250,435 parameters, the model achieved 99%-100% accuracy across 3 datasets, indicating robust generalization. Explainable AI (XAI) was integrated into the model to explain the breast cancer classification process to enhance clinical trust. The results indicate that the proposed framework is suitable for computer-aided diagnosis systems, particularly in resource-constrained clinical environments. The novelty of the proposed CNN-integrated CCT overcomes the limitation of CNN's gradient degradation in the last layers by integrating convolutional tokenization with transformer-based learning. Lighter than ViT, which is effective in capturing long-range dependencies, the model has also proven efficient in breast cancer classification by capturing long-range dependencies among breast tissue regions.

</details>


### [229] [APGEM: Adaptive Policy-Guided Error Mitigation for Quantum Reinforcement Learning on a Real-World CVRP Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18219)
*Shabir Ahmad Sofi,Bisma Majid,Mir Mohammad Yousuf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出APGEM（Adaptive Policy-Guided Error Mitigation），一种面向量子强化学习（QRL）的自适应策略引导纠错缓解控制器。该控制器在ZNE、PEC、CDR和REM四种纠错方法间在线动态选择，基于保真度、熵和计算开销的综合效用函数与ε-贪心时序差分Q分数机制。在基于真实德里地标的CVRP案例中，APGEM在高噪声下将近似比从0.84–0.87恢复至0.92–0.94，并展现出从短训练CDR主导到长训练均衡部署的策略阶段性切换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子强化学习（QRL）在NISQ设备上受噪声严重影响，导致线路保真度下降、学习不稳定。传统纠错缓解方法（如ZNE、PEC、CDR、REM）通常被静态选择并统一应用，不随学习上下文或噪声环境变化。如何让纠错缓解选择与强化学习反馈耦合，实现在线自适应选取，是亟待解决的问题。

Method: 1) 将CVRP建模为MDP，策略由变分量子线路（VQC）实现，采用参数移位规则计算梯度。2) APGEM控制器为四种纠错方法维护Q分数，通过TD规则更新：Q_{t+1}(M)=(1-α)Q_t(M)+αU(M;θ,s)，其中效用U=w_F·F - w_H·H - w_C·C综合保真度、熵和成本。3) 采用ε-贪心策略选择纠错方法，所选方法生成的修正统计量用于动作采样和梯度估计。4) 提出自适应学习率方案η_t=η_0(1+κF_M - λH_M)，将参数更新幅度与执行质量耦合。5) 实验采用4量子比特VQC，模拟五类噪声（去极化、振幅阻尼、相位阻尼、双比特门、读出）×四个强度（0.01–0.10）。

Result: 1) QRL代理优于构造式启发法（最近邻、节约法），逼近元启发法（遗传算法、模拟退火、禁忌搜索）。2) 短训练（100轮）下PEC最强（比0.922）；长训练（500轮）下CDR领先（比0.918）。3) 高噪声下未缓解近似比降至0.84–0.87，APGEM缓解后恢复至0.92–0.94。4) 控制器展现出真实的阶段性自适应行为：短训练以CDR为主（8,332次选择），长训练则均衡分布（ZNE 24,067、PEC 24,485、CDR 19,305、REM 20,692）。5) 去极化、振幅阻尼和读出噪声缓解效果最佳，相位阻尼和门噪声仍具挑战。

Conclusion: APGEM证明了学习感知自适应纠错缓解是噪声鲁棒QRL的可行路径。在真实德里最后一公里配送场景上的实验表明，该框架可将高噪声条件下的近似比恢复至近0.94，且控制器展现出从单一技术主导到多技术均衡的策略成熟过程。未来工作包括在标准CVRPLIB基准上跨实例评测、更丰富VRP变体、面向更大实例的量子比特高效编码，以及在真实量子硬件上的部署。

Abstract: Quantum Reinforcement Learning (QRL) represents policies as variational quantum circuits (VQCs), making it attractive for combinatorial optimization such as the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP). On noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) hardware, however, decoherence degrades fidelity and destabilizes learning, and conventional error mitigation is applied statically without regard to the learning context. We introduce Adaptive Policy-Guided Error Mitigation (APGEM), a controller that selects among Zero-Noise Extrapolation (ZNE), Probabilistic Error Cancellation (PEC), Clifford Data Regression (CDR), and Readout Error Mitigation (REM) online, driven by a fidelity, entropy, and cost aware utility function and an epsilon-greedy rule over temporal-difference Q-scores. We evaluate on a realistic urban-logistics testbed, a Delhi-based CVRP over real landmarks with geodesic inter-node costs, exercised across five noise families and four severity levels. On this instance, the QRL agent outperforms constructive heuristics and approaches metaheuristics, while mitigation restores approximation ratios from 0.84-0.87 to 0.92-0.94 under high noise. The controller shifts from a CDR-dominated regime under short training horizons to a balanced deployment across all four techniques under longer horizons, indicating genuine regime-dependent selection. These preliminary results position adaptive, learning-aware mitigation as a practical route to noise-resilient QRL.

</details>


### [230] [Trajectory Learnability for Offline On-Policy Distillation with Imperfect Teachers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18321)
*Yihao Ai,Weilong Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对离线在线策略蒸馏（Offline OPD）中教师监督不完美的问题，提出了一种基于"可学习性"信号（Learnability）的轨迹级加权蒸馏方法 LWD。该方法利用教师成功的问题训练参考模型，再通过对比教师失败轨迹在参考模型前后的似然变化来构建可学习性信号，并据此对不同失败轨迹分配不同的权重，从而在保留有用监督的同时削弱不可靠的监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线 OPD 通过一次性收集学生轨迹与教师监督来提升效率，但这种复用也使不完美的教师监督持续影响训练。已有研究表明，即使用问题级标签（教师成功/失败）进行选择性丢弃（如 RA-OPD 等）忽略了同一标签下不同轨迹可能含有不同价值的监督信号。直接通过重复前缀续推估计"教师可恢复性"（recoverability）又代价高昂，会丧失离线训练的优势。因此需要一种低成本的细粒度信号来区分教师失败轨迹中可保留的监督量。

Method: 方法 LWD 包含四个阶段：(1) 收集离线记录（学生轨迹、教师监督、教师独立响应的成功标签）；(2) 仅用教师成功的问题进行辅助蒸馏，得到参考模型 π₊；(3) 用 π₊ 和原始收集策略 ρ 对教师失败轨迹中的每个 token 计算对数似然差 ℓ_{i,t} = log π₊(a_{i,t}|s_{i,t}) − log ρ(a_{i,t}|s_{i,t})，作为可学习性信号；(4) 将该信号平滑并按均值 m_i 与波动 v_i 标准化，分层为低/中/高三档，分配有界正权重 ω_low<ω_mid<ω_high 用于最终的离线 OPD 损失加权。整个流程只需两次前向传播，无需额外生成。

Result: 在数学推理（AIME24/25、HMMT25）和代码生成（LiveCodeBench v5/v6）任务上，从 Qwen3-8B 蒸馏到 Qwen3-4B-Base 和 1.7B-Base。LWD 在 4B 规模上比 Lightning-OPD 离线基线最高提升 +2.7 个百分点（AIME24: 66.4%→69.1%），并在多个基准上匹配或超过在线 OPD 变体。计算成本方面，LWD 只需 2 块 GPU、约 22 GPU 小时，远低于在线 OPD 方法的 3 块 GPU、36–48 GPU 小时。消融实验显示：完全保留或完全丢弃教师失败监督均不如共享降低权重，而基于可学习性的分层加权效果最佳。

Conclusion: 研究表明，教师失败不应被视为二元过滤信号，而应作为粗粒度信号进行梯度化利用。基于"仅成功学习"构建的轨迹级可学习性信号能够低成本地区分教师失败轨迹中可保留的监督量。LWD 在显著降低计算成本的同时超越了离线基线并在多基准上匹配或超过在线 OPD 方法，为利用不完美教师监督提供了一种高效实用的方案。

Abstract: Offline on-policy distillation gains efficiency by collecting student trajectories and teacher supervision once and reusing them throughout optimization. The same reuse makes imperfect supervision persistent. Since even strong teachers can fail, we ask \emph{what remains learnable from imperfect teacher supervision?} Teacher failure is only a coarse problem-level signal and does not imply that all supervision along the associated student trajectory is unhelpful. A natural alternative is to estimate teacher recoverability along the trajectory, but repeated continuations largely erase the efficiency advantage of offline distillation. We instead use teacher-successful problems to define a cheap reference for what the student can learn. We train on teacher-successful problems and measure how the likelihood of each observed token in trajectories from teacher-failed problems changes. We use these signed likelihood changes as an operational \emph{learnability signal}: larger increases indicate behavior more strongly promoted by successful-only learning. We aggregate this signal into trajectory-level weights for the original distillation loss. Unlike continuation-based estimates, our learnability requires no additional generation and can be computed once from stored trajectories and model checkpoints. Across mathematical reasoning and code generation, our method improves an offline OPD baseline by up to 2.7 percentage points and matches or outperforms online OPD variants on multiple benchmarks. Despite the additional successful-only distillation stage, it uses 2 GPUs and about 22 GPU hours, compared with 3 GPUs and 36--48 GPU hours for representative online OPD methods.

</details>


### [231] [Reliable Virtual Sensing: A Multi-Domain Benchmark for Robustness Under Sensor Failures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18396)
*Jens U. Brandt,Noah C. Puetz,Alexander Windmann,Marc Hilbert,Elena Raponi,Thomas Bäck,Thomas Bartz-Beielstein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 MuViS-C，这是首个面向学习型虚拟传感（virtual sensing）的多领域鲁棒性基准，涵盖10种传感器故障模式、9个数据集（6个领域）、6种模型架构，系统评估传感器故障下预测器的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传感器在实际部署中会因漂移、噪声、饱和、卡死等故障导致输入分布偏移，使得学习型虚拟传感器产生物理上不合理的估计并引发系统级故障。然而现有评估仅关注标称（nominal）性能，缺乏类似计算机视觉中 ImageNet-C 那样的多领域鲁棒性基准，因此亟需一个标准化的多领域评估框架。

Method: MuViS-C 在 MuViS 基准上扩展，定义10种基于物理传感器故障分类法的失效模式（Bias、Noise、Scaling、Time-varying scaling、Linear drift、Non-linear drift、Outliers、Trimming 可变/常数、Hard fault），每种以严重程度 s∈[0,1] 参数化（k=3 锚定于 z-score 数据的 3σ 规则）。在 failure×channel×severity 网格上扰动单个通道，评估6种架构（XGBoost、CatBoost、ModernTCN、PatchTSMixer、xLSTM-Mixer、TST）及3种基于 TST 的鲁棒化策略（ISensD 输入 dropout、PGD 对抗训练、F2F 自监督预训练）。采用三种互补指标：mPC（平均腐蚀误差）、rPC（相对性能衰减）和新提出的 s_cross（首次劣于朴素均值预测器的严重程度）。

Result: （1）所有模型在腐蚀下均显著退化，至少在一种故障设置下劣于朴素预测器；（2）梯度提升树（XGBoost、CatBoost）在两种聚合统计上均处于排他性最优聚类，表现出隐式鲁棒性；（3）三种鲁棒化策略均使 TST 缩小与最鲁棒模型的差距，但都牺牲了标称性能；（4）模型排名跨数据集显著漂移，验证多领域评估的必要性；（5）当配备可靠故障检测时，ISensD 配合均值插补可将平均 rPC 降至 1.034，几乎无退化。故障难度排序：截断类最易、硬故障最难。

Conclusion: MuViS-C 确立了传感器故障下虚拟传感器可靠性的标准化评估方法论，证明了多领域评估是不可或缺的，发现梯度提升树是强鲁棒性基线且神经鲁棒化策略存在标称性能代价。基准已开源且可扩展至新数据集、故障模式、指标与模型，为虚拟传感器鲁棒性研究提供了可复现的测试平台。

Abstract: Virtual sensing, the estimation of hard-to-measure quantities from available sensor measurements, is a critical enabler for control and monitoring in cyber-physical systems. However, when sensors fail, learning-based predictors can produce physically implausible estimates that propagate to system-level failures. We argue that real-world deployment demands robustness and introduce MuViS-C, the first multi-domain benchmark of robustness against common sensor failures in learning-based virtual sensing. Building on an existing nominal-performance benchmark and established corruption taxonomies, it covers ten sensor failure modes, from subtle drifts to catastrophic signal dropouts, at multiple severities. These are paired with complementary robustness measures capturing average error under corruption, relative degradation, and worst-case fragility. Across nine datasets from six domains, we benchmark six architectures spanning gradient-boosted trees and the major inductive biases for sequence modeling: convolution, recurrence, attention, and MLP-mixing. On the attention-based architecture, we further probe three robustification strategies. We find that (i) every model degrades substantially under corruption, becoming worse than a naïve predictor on at least one corruption setting, (ii) gradient-boosted tree ensembles achieve strong robustness, and (iii) dedicated robustification closes the gap between the attention-based architecture and the most robust models, though each strategy hurts nominal performance. The benchmark's multi-domain design proves essential, as model rankings shift across datasets, and no single domain captures the full robustness picture. MuViS-C is open-source and extensible to new datasets, failure modes, measures, and models.

</details>


### [232] [TERN: A Delta-rule Memory with a Seasonal Reference and Online Adaptation for Epidemic Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18407)
*Shunya Nagashima,Yuta Funayama*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TERN是一个用于流感周报预测的模型，通过引入delta-rule快权重记忆、显式季节参考和在线自适应机制，在三个Cola-GNN流感基准上超越了现有的疫情图模型和通用预测器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 周度流感监测数据因区域样本少、年度波形变化大、疫情阶段转换时历史信息相关性变化等问题难以预测。现有方法使用固定短窗口且平等对待所有历史信息，无法利用早期季节数据或在疫情阶段变化时丢弃过时关联。

Method: TERN模型包含三个核心组件：(1) 擦除-然后-增量（erase-then-delta）记忆混合器，具有通道级衰减和学习的可学习时间常数，擦除地址由局部疫情阶段特征驱动；(2) 显式季节参考（周度嵌入或气候学修正）；(3) 在线自适应（在线重新拟合或与季节朴素预测混合）。模型在两个机制下运行：20周窗口模式和全历史循环模式。

Result: 在三个Cola-GNN流感基准（日本都道府县、美国HHS区域、美国各州）上，TERN在所有数据集上均成为最佳无污染模型。窗口模式下日本数据集上表现优于已报告的EpiGNN（RMSE 1145 vs 1234）；全历史模式下在日本数据集上与季节朴素预测的RMSE相当（838 vs 839）但PCC更优（0.926 vs 0.913）。消融实验证实记忆机制本身贡献了3-22%的RMSE改进。

Conclusion: TERN通过将delta-rule记忆与疫情阶段条件化的擦除/写入机制、显式季节参考和在线自适应相结合，在流感预测任务上取得了竞争性或最先进的结果。擦除-然后-增量规则是最佳记忆变体，相对于softmax注意力提供了3-22%的RMSE改进。主要局限在于评估范围仅限于三个流感监测基准。

Abstract: Weekly influenza surveillance counts guide vaccine distribution and public-health alerts, yet they are hard to forecast. Each region offers only a few seasons, waves shift in timing and height every year, and information that helps while a wave grows misleads after its peak, whereas last season's shape stays informative for a year. Existing epidemic graph models and general forecasters read a short fixed window and treat all past information alike, so they neither exploit earlier seasons nor discard stale associations when the epidemic phase changes. To address these limitations, we propose TERN, a forecaster built around a delta-rule fast-weight memory that decays channel-wise and erases along a learned address under gates driven by local epidemic-phase features, combined with an explicit seasonal reference and online adaptation. On three Cola-GNN influenza benchmarks, TERN outperformed epidemic graph models and general forecasters, matched or exceeded seasonal references, and a controlled comparison confirmed the contribution of the memory itself.

</details>


### [233] [Interpretable Patch-Based Deep Learning for Wildfire Spread Prediction from Ensemble Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18555)
*Marcin Lawenda,Aleksandra Krasicka,David Caballero,Luis Torres,Łukasz Szustak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对地中海地区野火蔓延预测的高计算成本问题，构建了基于10,584次2米分辨率物理模拟的深度学习替代模型数据集，系统比较了四种架构（自定义U-Net、迁移学习ResNet-50、物理信息神经网络PINN、Swin-Unet Transformer）在野火蔓延预测中的精度、可解释性及跨区域泛化能力。研究发现轻量级U-Net与PINN显著优于大型模型，并阐明了不同架构对地表燃料载荷与火线距离的依赖差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于物理原理的野火蔓延模拟器（如FARSITE、FlamMap）虽具物理可解释性，但计算成本随集合成员数量线性增长，生成燃烧概率（BP）图需大量模拟。深度学习替代模型（surrogate）可在单次前向传播中复现模拟器输出，但其在精度、可解释性及跨区域迁移方面的表现尚未得到系统评估，尤其是在高分辨率、多架构对比的框架下。

Method: （1）数据：西班牙加泰罗尼亚Rectoret地区10,584次随机野火模拟集合（2m分辨率，3×8风速风向×21×21点火点网格），辅以La Pedriza地区作为跨区域测试集；（2）探索性分析：采用Pearson相关、Moran's I空间自相关及XGBoost特征重要性评估11个地形/燃料协变量；（3）四模型对比：自定义U-Net（108配置网格搜索择优，0.47M参数，BCE+Dice损失）、ImageNet预训练ResNet-50（34.6M参数，1×1卷积投射11通道至3通道）、PINN（在Custom U-Net基础上叠加风驱动平流方程∂u/∂t+v_x∂u/∂x+v_y∂u/∂y=0的物理惩罚项λ_1 L_smooth+λ_2 L_adv）、Swin-Unet Transformer（SwinV2-Tiny编码器+卷积解码器）；（4）可解释性：梯度显著性、遮挡敏感性、局部扰动及风向旋转实验；（5）评估指标：MAE、MSE、Dice损失、MCC及自定义加权误差；（6）跨区域迁移：在Pedriza零样本测试并进行50轮微调。

Result: （1）地表燃料载荷（surface fuel load）为燃烧概率最强单一预测因子（r=0.27），纳入XGBoost使MSE降低21%（386.19→305.32），其余植被连续性指标高度冗余（互相r>0.95）；（2）Custom U-Net与PINN表现无显著差异（Wilcoxon p=0.86，MCC≈0.945），且以约1/70的参数量（0.47M vs 34.6M/32.7M）全面优于ResNet-50（MCC=0.767）和Swin-Unet（MCC=0.499）；（3）物理惩罚项λ_2∈{0,0.05,0.1,0.2}对精度无显著影响（Friedman p=0.46）；（4）可解释性显示：卷积模型主要依赖距当前火线距离（遮挡重要性≈0.326）和火掩膜，Swin-Unet则显著偏向燃料与地形（cont10m=0.403、bio5x5n=0.331、fuel_load=0.299），此架构差异在另一独立野火数据集[29]中亦被观察到；（5）风向旋转实验表明所有模型均对风向敏感（Custom U-Net在180°旋转时预测变化0.066，PINN=0.069，Swin-Unet=0.123），先前认为风不重要的结论源于风作为空间常数编码的伪影；（6）输入消融证实距火线距离为近端蔓延因果信息（移除后MCC仅微降，去除全部几何特征则MCC骤降至0.424）；（7）Pedriza零样本迁移呈现系统性偏移而非崩溃（Custom/PINN Dice从0.469升至0.598–0.637），50轮微调后恢复至0.481，ResNet-50零样本表现最优但微调后性能退化。

Conclusion: 轻量级自定义U-Net在精度与效率间取得最优平衡，物理信息约束在本任务规模下未带来显著增益；Swin-Unet与卷积模型在学得表征上呈系统性差异（前者重地形燃料，后者重火线距离），该差异具有跨数据集一致性；地表燃料载荷是燃烧概率的主导驱动因素，但其与模拟器共享BEHAVE-Anderson燃料分类体系，需以独立燃料产品验证；模型跨区域迁移表现为稳定偏移而非崩溃，展现初步应用前景，但受2m与10m分辨率差异限制，区域与尺度效应未能解耦，未来需引入独立燃料产品与概率生成式替代模型（如去噪扩散模型）以进一步提升物理真实性与不确定性量化能力。

Abstract: Wildfire spread is traditionally predicted using physics-based simulators, which are physically interpretable but whose cost increases with each additional ensemble member. We ask how well deep learning surrogates can reproduce these simulations at a fraction of this cost, training them on 10,584 fire spread simulations at 2m resolution for the Rectoret region in Catalonia, Spain. Four architectures are compared: a patch-based U-Net, a transfer-learned ResNet-50, a physics-informed network constrained by the wind-driven advection equation and a Swin-Unet transformer. Among the terrain and vegetation variables, only surface fuel load predicts burn probability with any strength (r = 0.27) and including it lowers prediction error by 21%. The remaining variables correlate weakly and are highly duplicative. Next, an experiment with saliency, occlusion and rotation demonstrates the models' learning. Convolutional models rely primarily on distance from the current fire front, while Swin-Unet assigns more weight to fuel and terrain, a finding also noted in an unrelated wildfire dataset. When applied without retraining to the second region, Pedriza, all three convolutional models still predict fire spread, losing accuracy by a small but systematic margin.

</details>


### [234] [Label-free steering: Compressing test-time reinforcement learning into bias-only subspaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18587)
*Naveen Vakada,Mingyuan Li,Shaoxiong Ji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出标签自由的偏置仅测试时强化学习方法（label-free bias-only TTRL），将多数投票伪标签作为奖励，仅优化约100K个偏置参数，同时冻结预训练骨干网络，在MATH-500上达到76.67%准确率（Qwen2.5-7B），并可迁移至视觉语言和音频推理任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时强化学习（TTRL）方法优化模型大量参数且依赖大量计算资源，同时标注奖励在多模态推理场景中难以获取。本文旨在探究在奖励信号（无标签）和优化空间（仅偏置参数）均严重受限的情况下，是否仍能实现有效的测试时自适应。

Method: 结合TTRL的多数投票伪标签奖励机制与GRPO优化器，将梯度限制传播到每个解码器层的加性偏置向量（down_proj.bias，约28×3584=100,352个参数），冻结预训练骨干网络所有其他参数。理论分析包括命题1（伪标签可靠性随投票数G指数衰减）和定理1（受限子空间的可训练性取决于可达梯度能量而非子空间维度）。

Result: 在MATH-500上，Qwen2.5-Math-7B达79.50%，Qwen2.5-7B达76.67%，均略超同参数预算的标签偏置引导复现版本。方法迁移至MathVista、AI2D、LogicVista和MMAU多模态基准均有提升，且学习到的偏置向量可迁移到4500个未见过的MATH问题。参数匹配实验表明偏置子空间优于LoRA和ReFT变体，主要因为可达梯度能量更大。

Conclusion: 研究表明，仅优化约100K偏置参数并使用完全无标签的多数投票奖励，可在文本、视觉语言和音频推理任务上实现显著的测试时自适应。子空间的选择（而非其规模）是标签自由测试时RL成功的关键决定因素，但需注意MMAU增益主要来自单一问题模板，凸显了标签自由测试时自适应中审计任务特定混杂因素的必要性。

Abstract: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) enables models to improve their reasoning without relying on labeled training data, but existing approaches typically optimize a large fraction of the model parameters. This raises a natural question: can effective test-time adaptation emerge when both the reward signal and the optimization space are severely restricted? We answer this question with label-free bias-only TTRL, which uses majority-vote pseudo-labels as rewards and optimizes only approximately 100K bias parameters while keeping the pretrained backbone frozen. On MATH-500, our approach reaches 76.67% accuracy, slightly exceeding our own labeled bias-steering reproduction while optimizing 76,000x fewer parameters than full-parameter TTRL. The same training procedure improves performance across vision-language and audio reasoning tasks, including MathVista, AI2D, LogicVista, and MMAU. We further show that the learned steering vectors transfer to 4,500 held-out MATH problems, indicating that the adaptation is not limited to the problems used during test-time optimization. Finally, we analyze why this highly restricted adaptation can work, showing that majority-vote reliability improves with rollout consensus and that bias subspaces with greater accessible gradient energy exhibit stronger downstream trainability. These results demonstrate that substantial test-time adaptation can emerge from optimizing a tiny bias-only subspace using entirely label-free rewards.

</details>


### [235] [Online Robust Reinforcement Learning Through Monte-Carlo Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18599)
*Tuan Dam,Kishan Panaganti,Brahim Driss,Adam Wierman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种鲁棒的蒙特卡洛树搜索算法（Robust-Power-UCT），通过引入幂均值备份算子和针对鲁棒优化的探索奖励机制，解决仿真器与真实环境之间的模型失配问题（同时涵盖转移动态和奖励分布的模糊性）。理论上证明了该算法在根节点处的值估计达到 $\mathcal{O}(n^{-1/2})$ 的有限样本收敛速度，与标准MCTS相当；在Gambler's Problem、Frozen Lake和American Option Pricing三个环境中验证了其优于标准Stochastic-Power-UCT的鲁棒性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）在博弈等领域取得了巨大成功，但其在现实世界部署中面临一个核心挑战：仿真器与真实环境动力学之间不可避免的差异（即simulation-to-reality gap）。现有鲁棒强化学习方法主要基于动态规划或策略迭代，尚无将MCTS搜索机制与鲁棒性相结合的工作。如何在保持MCTS搜索效率的同时获得对模型不确定性的鲁棒性，是本文要解决的核心问题。

Method: 提出Robust-Power-UCT算法，关键技术包括：(1) 引入幂均值（power mean）备份算子替代传统平均备份，通过参数 $p \geq 1$ 控制对高价值动作的偏向程度；(2) 在RMDP框架下定义模糊集合（ambiguity set），支持总变差、卡方、KL散度、Wasserstein等多种距离度量；(3) 设计新颖的探索奖励机制 $C \cdot T_{s_h}(t)^{b_{h+1}/\beta_{h+1}} / T_{s_h,a}(t)^{\alpha_{h+1}/\beta_{h+1}}$，在非平稳多臂老虎机视角下满足特定参数约束；(4) 利用对偶重构等技术，使鲁棒Bellman算子的计算复杂度仅略高于标准算子。

Result: 理论结果：(1) 证明在节点深度为 $h$ 处，$V̂_n(s_h)$ 以速率 $(\alpha_h, \beta_h)$ 集中于鲁棒最优值 $\tilde{V}(s_h)$；(2) 在合适参数选择下，根节点期望收益估计误差满足 $|\mathbb{E}[\hat{V}_n(s_0)] - \tilde{V}(s_0)| \leq \mathcal{O}(n^{-1/2})$，与标准MCTS收敛率一致。实验结果：在Gambler's Problem（不同规划概率 $p_h \in \{0.4, 0.6, 0.8\}$）、Frozen Lake（多种规划/执行 $p_{\text{slip}}$ 组合）和American Option Pricing（不同 $p_u$ 设置）三个环境下，Wasserstein和卡方模糊集合下的鲁棒变体均显著优于Stochastic-Power-UCT基线；在 $p_{\text{slip}}^{\text{plan}}=0.3$ 条件下，Wasserstein变体在 $p_{\text{exec}}=0.1$ 极端失配情况下达到58%成功率，远高于基线15%；不确定预算 $\rho=0.5$ 提供了性能与鲁棒性的良好折中。

Conclusion: 本文是首个将鲁棒性引入MCTS的工作，通过Robust-Power-UCT算法桥接了基于仿真的规划与现实部署之间的差距。关键意义在于证明引入鲁棒性并不以牺牲收敛速度为代价，$\mathcal{O}(n^{-1/2})$ 的收敛速率与标准MCTS的最优速率相匹配。未来工作方向包括：(1) 探索对参数（状态数、动作数、搜索深度）依赖性更精细的有限样本分析；(2) 设计不那么保守的鲁棒公式，以更好地平衡名义性能与鲁棒性；(3) 为实验中观察到的Wasserstein集合优越性能提供理论解释。

Abstract: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) is a powerful framework for solving complex decision-making problems, yet it often relies on the assumption that the simulator and the real-world dynamics are identical. Although this assumption helps achieve the success of MCTS in games like Chess, Go, and Shogi, the real-world scenarios incur ambiguity due to their modeling mismatches in low-fidelity simulators. In this work, we present a new robust variant of MCTS that mitigates dynamical model ambiguities. Our algorithm addresses transition dynamics and reward distribution ambiguities to bridge the gap between simulation-based planning and real-world deployment. We incorporate a robust power mean backup operator and carefully designed exploration bonuses to ensure finite-sample convergence at every node in the search tree. We show that our algorithm achieves a convergence rate of $\mathcal{O}(n^{-1/2})$ for the value estimation at the root node, comparable to that of standard MCTS. Finally, we provide empirical evidence that our method achieves robust performance in planning problems even under significant ambiguity in the underlying reward distribution and transition dynamics.

</details>


### [236] [CoRe-MARL: Cooperative Redistribution Under Unknown Dynamics Using Recurrent Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18639)
*Naimur Rahman Chowdhury,Shatabdi Sen Prapti,Md. Salehin Seyam,Limon Bin Hossain*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CoRe-MARL框架，将救灾物资再分配建模为Dec-POMDP，采用循环MAPPO实现集中训练分散执行，在未知动态条件下改善服务公平性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有救灾物资再分配研究多假设集中式决策或完全信息，无法应对实际分散式网络中信息有限、运输中断和动态变化的挑战，导致区域间服务不均衡。

Method: 1. 将每个救援中心建模为Dec-POMDP中的智能体，动作空间为分配本地服务、持有储备和向其他中心转运的单纯形；2. 采用GRU构建循环信念状态捕捉未知演化动态；3. 共享奖励结合最差中心服务、服务差距和网络服务阈值保护；4. 使用循环MAPPO（CTDE框架）训练，Dirichlet策略分布确保动作单纯形约束。

Result: 在6中心、20时段合成环境（5种隐藏轨迹族）中训练30000回合：MAPPO在保留测试集上将最差中心服务从0.2369提升至0.3562（+50.4%），服务差距降低33.2%，网络服务0.6276显著优于IPPO（0.5602），且在5种轨迹族上均表现稳健。

Conclusion: 循环MAPPO的协作学习能在部分观测和未知动态下有效平衡本地服务与再分配，显著改善公平性而不严重损害网络整体性能，验证了CTDE合作机制在分散式救灾再分配中的优势。

Abstract: Emergency management assistance programs, such as relief distribution, are essential for delivering necessary supplies to affected communities. However, these programs operate in a decentralized network of local centers that face uncertain local demand and supply dynamics, resulting in inconsistent avail- ability of local services. Redistribution of supplies among these local centers reduces these imbalances, but the centers often make decisions independently, with limited information and disrupted transportation. This study develops CoRe-MARL, a cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework, by formulating a decentralized partially observable Markov decision process (Dec-POMDP). We treat each center as an agent that learns a redistribution policy to improve the service in the worst-case region and reduce the service gap across regions while protecting network-wide service. We incorporate a recurrent network that captures evolving supply and demand dynamics without direct observation, while multi-agent proximal policy optimization (MAPPO) enables centralized training and decentralized execution (CTDE). We evaluate the framework in a simulated environment with diverse trajectories, where exact dynamics are not observed by actors and the MAPPO critic. We compare the recurrent MAPPO with the recurrent independent PPO (IPPO) and a local only heuristic, and find that MAPPO reduces the service gap across local centers and enhances service for the worst-served center while maintaining competitive network-wide service. The recurrent MAPPO also shows consistent performance across diverse trajectory patterns, demonstrating its ability to adapt to evolving dynamics. The findings demonstrate the capability of cooperative learning for decentralized redistribution and improving equitable service under uncertain and evolving dynamics.

</details>


### [237] [Rethinking Critic Learning in PPO: Understanding and Mitigating Value Flattening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18708)
*Yizhuo Li,Jianhao Yan,Yun Luo,Zhi Wang,Futing Wang,Rong-Xi Tan,Kanghui Tian,Ganqu Cui,Ning Ding,Peilin Zhao,Yafu Li,Yu Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现PPO中critic学习的一个系统性失败模式——Value Flattening（价值平坦化），即在终端奖励设置下，密集的token级监督导致critic预测在响应内部呈现平坦状态，无法捕捉策略条件状态价值的局部转变。为此提出SP³O方法，仅在每个响应中选择少量间隔较远的状态施加价值监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在LLM推理的强化学习中，PPO的critic本应在长轨迹内提供细粒度的信用分配和每步优势估计。然而，作者发现critic预测在单个响应内部呈现平坦化现象，与基于蒙特卡洛续采样的真实状态价值变化严重不匹配，这一系统性问题在标准PPO中被忽视，且可能损害actor的策略学习效果。

Method: 方法包含分析与解决方案两部分。分析：(1) 通过LLM（Qwen3-Base）和FrozenLake环境实证Value Flattening现象；(2) 理论分解critic MSE损失，揭示存在隐式方差惩罚项惩罚响应内价值差异；(3) 分析时间相关性，发现相邻token状态表征相似、梯度对齐，造成冗余更新。解决方案SP³O：将critic损失仅应用于响应中少量间隔良好的状态（如相对位置0.3/0.6/0.9，长响应增加0.95尾部锚点），以同时缓解方差惩罚和冗余更新。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B-Base和Qwen3-8B-Base上的实验显示，SP³O显著优于标准PPO和GRPO：数学推理平均提升7.97个百分点（4B），OOD推理提升7.33个百分点；隐藏表征有效秩从4.33提升至5.63；critic profile MSE在30%/60%/90%进度分别降低36%/11%/21%；仅用K=3个监督锚点即可达到最佳性能，而K=16/64反而恶化；尾部锚点显著降低重复生成（18.33%→1.12%）。

Conclusion: Value Flattening是LLM PPO critic学习中被忽视的重要失败模式，由终端奖励下密集监督引入的隐式方差惩罚和相邻状态的时间相关性冗余更新共同导致。简单的稀疏监督策略（SP³O）能有效缓解该问题，并在数学及分布外推理基准上稳定提升策略性能，为critic设计提供了新思路。

Abstract: In reinforcement learning for large language models, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) commonly uses a critic to estimate state values and reduce the variance of policy updates. However, we uncover a systematic failure mode in PPO critics, which we call Value Flattening: state values, estimated from multiple Monte Carlo continuations, change sharply across intermediate states while critic predictions remain comparatively flat. We further observe this phenomenon in a controlled FrozenLake environment and find that it becomes more pronounced as the state space grows. Our theoretical and empirical analyses relate Value Flattening to an implicit variance penalty in the critic loss and redundant updates from temporally correlated states with similar gradients. Motivated by these findings, we introduce SParse Proximal Policy Optimization (SP$^3$O), which applies the value loss to only a few well-separated states in each response to mitigate both effects. Experiments on Qwen3-Base show that SP$^3$O with only three states supervised per response can mitigate Value Flattening and consistently improve the learned policy across model sizes and evaluation suites. Together, our results identify Value Flattening as an important yet overlooked failure mode of critic learning in standard PPO and show that a simple sparse supervision strategy can mitigate it.

</details>


### [238] [NeuroECG: ECGFounder-Based Deep ECG Representation for EEG-Free Neurological Prognostication After Cardiac Arrest](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18891)
*Jiaju Gao,Yi Zhao,Chenyang Xu,Yuxi Zhou,Hao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出NeuroECG框架，基于ECGFounder预训练基础模型，结合逐步解冻策略、分位数池化和PCA压缩，从床旁ECG信号中提取深度表示，用于心脏骤停后无EEG的神经预后辅助预测，并在I-CARE多中心数据库上验证了其优于静态临床基线和多种ECG骨干网络的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心脏骤停后神经预后通常依赖EEG，但EEG需要专业设备和人员，资源受限场景难以开展。床旁ECG虽常规采集且成本低，但其预后价值未被充分挖掘。传统ECG特征预测能力弱，从头训练深度模型又受限于小样本、易过拟合，因此需要借助预训练ECG基础模型和迁移学习来挖掘床旁ECG的辅助预后信息。

Method: 1）ECG预处理与质控：对I-CARE数据库单通道床旁ECG进行通道选择、带通滤波、归一化、10秒分段和基于标准差的平直噪声掩膜；2）ECGFounder微调：采用逐步解冻策略（仅头→最后两阶段→深四阶段→全骨干），配合分层判别学习率和每患者最多256段的动态采样；3）患者级表示：分段嵌入经特征维度分位数池化（q=0.24）聚合，再由训练集PCA压缩至64维；4）融合预测：将64维深度ECG特征与6项静态临床变量拼接，输入CatBoost分类器预测不良神经结局（CPC 3-5），并以CatBoost回归器辅助预测CPC分数。

Result: 在I-CARE数据库412例患者（训练288/验证61/测试63）上：ECGFounder在ECG-only骨干中表现最佳（AUROC 0.7333，AUPRC 0.8540）；融合静态变量后NeuroECG测试AUROC达0.8077、AUPRC 0.8970、CPC-MAE 1.5156，优于静态基线（AUROC 0.7689）和ConvNeXt1D、SE-ResNet、ECG-JEPA、ECG-FM、ST-MEM等骨干；消融实验证实分位数池化（q=0.24）优于均值/最大池化，PCA压缩虽略降ECG单独性能但显著提升融合效果，逐步解冻优于仅头微调和立即全解冻；SHAP分析显示静态变量贡献41.96%、深度ECG贡献58.04%的特征重要性。

Conclusion: NeuroECG证明床旁ECG的深度表示可作为EEG-free场景下心脏骤停后神经预后的有效辅助信息来源；将预训练ECG基础模型与逐步解冻、分位数池化和PCA压缩结合，可在有限标注数据上稳定提取患者级ECG表示，并与静态临床变量互补提升预测性能。未来需外部验证、更完整的ECG覆盖以及更具可解释性的潜在ECG模式分析。

Abstract: Neurological prognostication after cardiac arrest commonly relies on electroencephalography (EEG). However, EEG demands high clinical resources. Bedside electrocardiography (ECG) is standard and low-cost. Yet, its value for predicting neurological outcomes remains underexplored. In this study, we propose NeuroECG, an ECGFounder-based deep representation framework for EEG-free auxiliary prognostication. NeuroECG adapts a pretrained ECG foundation model via task-specific fine-tuning. We implement a gradual unfreezing strategy on single-channel bedside monitoring ECG. Multiple ECG segments per patient are encoded into segment-level deep features. These embeddings are aggregated via quantile pooling ($q = 0.24$) and compressed using principal component analysis (PCA). Experiments on 412 ECG-available patients from the multicenter I-CARE database show that the adapted ECGFounder backbone achieves the best performance among ECG-only backbone baselines, with a test AUROC of 0.7333. We further combine the learned deep ECG representation with static clinical covariates. The proposed NeuroECG model achieves a test AUROC of 0.8077 and an AUPRC of 0.8970. These results support deep bedside ECG representations as a useful source of auxiliary prognostic information. Their integration with static clinical covariates improves prediction in an EEG-free setting. The source code is available at this https URL

</details>


### [239] [Higher-order pruning of experts in mixture-of-experts language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18916)
*Alex M. Tseng,Prannay Kaul,Luca Zancato,Wei Xia,Stefano Soatto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HOPE（Higher-Order Pruning of Experts），一种针对MoE语言模型的二阶专家剪枝方法，通过考虑专家间的成对交互信息来做出更好的剪枝决策。HOPE将剪枝问题转化为基于交互矩阵的二次规划，理论上证明REAP是其忽略交互项的特殊情况。实验表明HOPE在高剪枝率（40-50%）下显著优于现有方法，尤其在智能体编码任务上优势明显。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MoE专家剪枝方法（如REAP、EAN、MAN、Frequency）均为“一阶”方法，独立评估每个专家的重要性，忽略了MoE推理中专家固有的协同合作特性。当高剪枝率（40-50%）下大量协同专家对被同时移除时，一阶方法无法预测或防止性能损失，而这些高剪枝率恰恰是部署中最有价值的场景。

Method: 1. 理论推导：将MoE剪枝误差分解为替换误差（substitution error）和重归一化误差（renormalization error），证明后者通常较小。<br>2. 提出可处理的代理目标Z：Z为被剪枝专家的门控加权输出范数的平方和，展开后包含专家间的成对交互项。<br>3. 理论上界（定理1）：平方替换误差 ≤ (1+ρ)²·Z，其中ρ为专家输出范数的最大最小比值，与剪枝集P无关。<br>4. 校准阶段：对每层收集E×E的交互矩阵F，其中F_{i,j}编码专家i与专家j同时激活时的联合贡献。<br>5. 优化：将最小化E[Z]转化为二进制二次规划：min p^T F p，约束p∈{0,1}^E且Σp_k=|P|。<br>6. 求解：使用连续松弛+SLSQP求解器，取前|P|大值。<br>7. REAP联系：当F的非对角项置零时，HOPE退化为REAP（Spearman相关系数0.988）。<br>8. 附录还推导了跨层扩展CHOPE，通过雅可比传播算子Φ_{L,j}联合优化所有层的剪枝预算。

Result: 1. 在3个前沿MoE模型（Qwen3.5-122B-A10B、Qwen3.5-35B-A3B、GLM-4.5-Air，最大122B参数）、2个校准集（Evol-CodeAlpaca、SWE-Bench verified）、6个剪枝率（10%-50%）、多个基准测试（数学、指令遵循、编码、智能体）上共54个配置。<br>2. 50%剪枝时，HOPE平均排名1.58/5（REAP为2.42），智能体编码任务上对REAP的优势最高达+6.1%。<br>3. 整体上，HOPE在39%的条件下排名第一，67%进入前二，对每个基线的胜率平均73%。<br>4. HOPE在54个条件中仅1次垫底（差距仅-1.7%），而REAP有5次，Freq有43次。<br>5. 结构性分析：F矩阵的非对角项平均幅值为对角项的33%，呈现明显的专家聚类结构；HOPE倾向于保留与其他存活专家交互更强的专家。<br>6. HOPE与REAP在剪枝集上有显著差异（Jaccard相似度较低），且差异分布于所有层。<br>7. 稳定性：跨试验Jaccard>0.95，跨校准集Jaccard=0.60（与REAP相当）。<br>8. 下游兼容性：在SFT后HOPE仍优于REAP。<br>9. 附加成本：HOPE校准比REAP慢约6-7%，收敛需10k提示（REAP为8k）。<br>10. CHOPE初步结果不稳定，易过度剪枝早期层。

Conclusion: HOPE是首个理论上考虑专家成对交互的MoE剪枝目标，通过二次规划公式保留了专家间的协同结构。在高剪枝率和复杂任务（尤其是智能体编码）上，HOPE持续优于所有一阶基线方法。其优势源于保留了具有强合作结构的专家——正是一阶方法忽略的关键信号。该方法使激进的MoE压缩成为可能，对实际部署具有重要价值。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models suffer from large parameter counts, which create a significant memory bottleneck. Expert pruning is the most direct approach for reducing this parameter count, yet existing methods make pruning decisions for each expert independently, and assume experts' contributions are purely additive. In reality, expert usage in MoEs is inherently cooperative. We derive HOPE (Higher-Order Pruning of Experts), a second-order pruning objective which provably minimizes an upper bound on the error resulting from pruning. We show that REAP (a state-of-the-art first-order pruning method) is a special case of HOPE where interaction terms are ignored. Across three frontier MoE models (up to 122B parameters), two distinct calibration sets, and multiple benchmarks (including math, instruction following, coding, and an agentic suite), we demonstrate that HOPE produces better pruning decisions than existing methods, and its advantage is most pronounced at high pruning rates and on challenging agentic workloads. At 50% pruning, HOPE outperforms all baselines and achieves an average rank of 1.58 out of 5 methods (versus 2.42 for the next-best method, REAP), with gains of up to +6.1% on agentic coding. Over all conditions, HOPE again achieves the best average rank and surpasses every other method in the majority of head-to-head comparisons. By preserving cooperative expert structure that first-order methods ignore, HOPE enables aggressive compression with minimal degradation, particularly on complex tasks where diverse expert combinations are invoked over long sequences.

</details>


### [240] [StableEval Arena: A Cost-Aware Agentic Benchmark for Stablecoin Price Stability Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18949)
*Sean Wan,Dongping Liu,Luyao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出StableEval Arena，一个面向稳定币挂钩风险预测的成本感知代理基准框架，通过120例压力增强验证块和507例自然分布完整评估块，对基于LLM的代理系统在预测准确性、校准行为、结构化输出可靠性、延迟、token消耗和推理成本等多维度进行评估，发现代理在协议遵循可靠性与金融风险可靠性之间存在差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稳定币是数字金融基础设施的核心，其价值依赖于维持与美元挂钩的承诺，但现有研究缺乏针对代理式AI系统在稳定币风险评估场景下的标准化基准评测，且需同时考虑成本、协议合规性、输出有效性和可靠性等多维度信任属性。

Method: 构建基于历史回放的无泄漏基准框架StableEval Arena：每个案例提供30天回溯窗口，要求代理对未来7天输出结构化风险评估（稳定/观察/压力标签、脱钩概率、最大偏差估计、方向、置信度和理由）；采用120例压力增强验证块和507例自然分布完整评估块；评估六种LLM代理系统和基线在预测质量、压力召回率、校准性、有效输出率、延迟、token使用和推理成本等指标。

Result: 研究发现协议遵循可靠性与金融风险可靠性之间存在差距：代理能够以适中的成本可靠地产生有效的结构化输出，但在压力增强验证块中校准代理改善了Macro-F1，而在507例自然分布块中简单基线表现强劲；在两种设置下，罕见严重压力和持续脱钩事件的检测仍然薄弱。

Conclusion: StableEval Arena是一个诊断性而非代理推广性的基准；代理在共享协议下能产生有效结构化输出，但并不持续优于简单基线；该基准强调信任度是预测质量、运营可靠性和计算成本的联合属性，并发布在HuggingFace和GitHub上以支持审计和复现。

Abstract: We introduce StableEval Arena, a cost-aware benchmark framework for evaluating agentic AI systems on stablecoin peg-risk prediction. StableEval Arena evaluates LLM-backed agentic systems on diagnosing peg stress and forecasting deviations from the one-dollar peg over a hidden seven-day horizon, using leakage-safe historical replay with exchange price-volume data and market-context features. We report two complementary experiment blocks: a 120-case stress-enriched validation block and a 507-case natural-distribution full-arena evaluation block. Across six LLM-backed agent configurations and baselines, StableEval Arena measures prediction quality, calibrated-label behavior, structured-output reliability, latency, token consumption, and estimated inference cost. Rather than ranking agents by accuracy alone, the framework treats trustworthiness as a joint property of forecast quality, operational reliability, and computational cost. The results show a gap between protocol-following reliability and financial-risk reliability: agents reliably produce valid structured outputs at modest measured cost, but still miss most rare severe-stress and sustained-depeg cases. To support auditing and replication, we release the benchmark dataset on Hugging Face and the source code on GitHub.

</details>


### [241] [Tabular Deep Learning vs Classical Machine Learning for Urban Land Cover Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19010)
*Muntasir Tabasum,Tanpia Tasnim,Md. Ekramul Islam,Al Zadid Sultan Bin Habib*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文在UCI ULC数据集上系统对比了16种经典机器学习模型与表格深度学习（TDL）模型用于九类城市土地覆盖分类，结果显示CatBoost/RF等树集成模型仍为主导基线，但TabTransformer/TabSeq等TDL模型在加权交叉熵下具有竞争力，可作为互补方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献对表格深度学习（TDL）在何时能超越树集成模型存在混合证据；遥感领域表格描述子具有高维、异构、类别不平衡等典型挑战，因此需要一个统一可复现的基准来回答TDL在ULC任务中是否值得使用。

Method: 使用UCI ULC数据集（n_train=168, n_test=507, d=147, K=9），z-score标准化并按10%分层划分验证集；对比LR、DT、RF、SVM、KNN、NB、GBM、AdaBoost、XGBoost、CatBoost、MLP以及TabNet、TabTransformer、FT-Transformer、1D CNN、TabSeq五种TDL模型；TDL使用Adam+加权交叉熵（w_k=N/(KN_k)），通过Optuna调参；评估指标包括Accuracy、macro-Precision/Recall/F1及one-vs-rest macro AUC-ROC，附带ROC曲线与混淆矩阵，并报告95%二项置信区间。

Result: CatBoost以82.25%测试准确率领先，RF（81.66%）与NB（77.51%）次之；TDL中TabTransformer（74.75%）与TabSeq（73.96%）表现最佳，加权CE后TabSeq/1D CNN/TabTransformer达到约73%；类加权损失整体提升Recall/F1；树集成模型在macro指标上普遍高且均衡，而TDL模型在加权训练后能缩小差距。

Conclusion: 树集成（尤其CatBoost、RF）仍是异构、不平衡表格ULC任务的稳健默认基线；TDL模型（TabTransformer、TabSeq）在有效的类别不平衡处理下具有竞争力，可作为非线性特征交互和少数类敏感场景的补充；建议在ULC流程中以集成模型为基线、TDL为补充，并拓展到更多城市与遥感基准以进一步验证。

Abstract: Urban Land Cover (ULC) classification plays a crucial role in urban planning, environmental monitoring, and sustainable development. We study this task using the ULC dataset from the UCI Machine Learning Repository, which includes tabular features derived from high-resolution aerial imagery across nine classes (e.g., roads, trees, grass, water). The dataset presents typical remote sensing challenges, including high dimensionality, heterogeneous features, and class imbalance. In a unified, reproducible pipeline, we benchmark classical machine learning models (e.g., Logistic Regression, SVM, Random Forest, XGBoost, CatBoost) against Tabular Deep Learning (TDL) models (TabNet, FT-Transformer, TabTransformer, TabSeq, and 1D CNNs). To address class imbalance, we employ weighted cross-entropy loss for TDL models and evaluate performance using accuracy, macro-precision, macro-recall, macro-F1, AUC-ROC, and confusion matrices. Our results show that while tree ensembles remain strong general baselines, TDL models can match or exceed their performance when non-linear interactions are significant and imbalance handling is effective, providing complementary advantages for urban land cover mapping. See code: this https URL

</details>


### [242] [RLLBC-Lib: An Educational Code Library for Reinforcement Learning and Learning-Based Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19074)
*Bernd Frauenknecht,Emma Cramer,Artur Eisele,Paul Kruse,Lukas Kesper,Jonas Hertrampf,Ramil Sabirov,Jyotirmaya Patra,Johannes Berger,Paul Brunzema,Friedrich Solowjow,Sebastian Trimpe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RLLBC-Lib是一个面向RL和基于学习的控制(LBC)的教育性代码库，旨在降低学生的学习门槛。它提供从表格RL到深度RL的完整实现，统一采用Jupyter notebook设计，附有详细理论解释，并支持自动化评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL虽应用广泛且概念优雅，但存在较高的学习门槛：算法行为源于数据收集、价值估计与策略改进之间的迭代反馈，仅凭公式难以直观理解。此外，RL应置于更广泛的基于学习的控制(LBC)语境中讨论，以便学生理解何时该用RL、何时该用其他方法。同时，RL教学需兼顾计算机科学与工程两类学生群体的不同需求。

Method: 设计原则：(1)采用自包含的单文件Python实现+Jupyter notebook，依赖pixi-env管理环境，通过gymnasium标准接口处理智能体-环境交互；(2)统一notebook结构：智能体与环境配置→超参数设置→训练循环→评估，配合markdown详细注释连接理论与代码；(3)内容涵盖：动态规划与表格RL（policy/value iteration、MC、Q-learning/SARSA/Dyna-Q）、深度RL（DQN、REINFORCE、A2C、DDPG、TRPO、SAC、TD3，基于CleanRL/PyTorch）、LBC方法（LQR、系统辨识、贝叶斯优化、MPC）以及配套编程作业（基于nbgrader自动化评分）。

Result: 提供了一个GitHub开源的综合教学库，包含表格与深度RL的统一Jupyter实现、概念示例（tic-tac-toe等）、LBC对比实现（如图4(b)的MPC），以及三个支持自动评分的编程作业（含一个开放式的赛车竞速挑战，配套排行榜）。已在课堂和在线课程中验证有效。

Conclusion: RLLBC-Lib通过一致的notebook设计、详尽的理论解释、标准RL实验工具（tensorboard/W&B）以及与LBC方法的对比，有效降低了RL学习门槛，并支持大规模自动化教学，可作为RL教材的有力补充。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is an exciting concept as well as a remarkable success story worth sharing. However, RL builds on rather complex interactions between different objects that play out over several cycles. Such dynamics are often best explained with an easily accessible implementation. We present RLLBC-Lib, a carefully crafted code library with the goal of lowering the entry barrier for students and other learners of RL in the context of learning-based control. At its heart, RLLBC-Lib comprises a comprehensive library of tabular RL approaches to enforce a clear understanding of the theoretical foundations. A deep RL library follows the same design principles, underscoring the parallels between simple tabular and state-of-the-art deep RL approaches. Additionally, RLLBC-Lib provides a collection of implementations illustrating core RL principles and contrasting RL to other learning-based control approaches. Finally, RLLBC-Lib provides an ideal basis for creating programming assignments with automated grading.

</details>


### [243] [Double descent is the principle of least action](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19076)
*Congzhou M Sha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文用统计力学框架解释深度学习中模型复杂度（参数数量 d）与测试误差之间的"双下降"现象：将训练过程视为粒子在损失景观中的随机游走，通过基础假设（每个等能微观态等概率）与玻尔兹曼分布、能量均分定理，论证增加参数维度在固定训练损失下有效降低温度、增强权重正则化，从而越过插值阈值后测试误差再次下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双下降现象（double descent）在 d = n（插值阈值）处出现测试误差峰值，但现有精确分析主要集中在线性与随机特征模型，缺乏对一般非线性模型的物理直觉解释。本文旨在以本科可读的方式，从统计力学出发提供补充性的直觉理解。

Method: 1) 建立统计力学类比：微观态 = 参数向量 θ；宏观观测量 = 训练损失 L；宏观态 = 固定损失的水平集；基础假设给出玻尔兹曼分布 P(θ|y) ∝ exp(-L_λ(θ)/T)，其中 L_λ 含权重衰减；2) 有限训练时间 ↔ 权重衰减 λ ∝ 1/t（Theorem 1）；3) 在二次损失下，均分定理给出 E[L] = E_min + Td/2，故固定 ΔE 下增加 d 使"看见数据方向"的温度 T_eff ∝ ΔE/d 降低；4) 路径积分视角下 T → 0 时主导贡献为稳态路径（最小作用量原理）；5) Theorem 2 证明最小范数插值解的能量 ‖θ*‖² 随 d 单调非增。

Result: 通过 Legendre 多项式拟合带噪立方函数 n=20 个样本的数值实验（Fig.1），复现了 U 形 → 峰值 (d=n) → 长下降尾的双下降曲线。理论给出三条结论：(a) 增加 d 在固定训练损失下等价于降低温度，使玻尔兹曼权重集中到稳态路径；(b) 稳态路径的 L² 范数随 d 单调非增（Theorem 2），即增加参数等价于更强权重正则化；(c) 数据条件数 σ_min(A)² 在 d=n 处崩溃解释峰值形成。所有定理用 Lean 4 + Mathlib 形式化验证。

Conclusion: 在二次损失近似下，从统计力学视角看，增加参数维度 d 既通过均分定理降低"看见方向"的等效温度（驱动分布向稳态路径集中），又通过最小范数单调递减定理增强隐式权重正则化，二者共同解释双下降现象 d > n 区域测试误差的下降。该框架将优化算法（梯度下降 + 有限时间）、隐式正则化与经典统计力学概念（基础假设、玻尔兹曼分布、均分、最小作用量）统一起来。

Abstract: The test error of a model plotted against its number of parameters $d$ falls, peaks when the model can just fit the training data, and falls again, exhibiting the double descent phenomenon. We explain the phenomenon with statistical mechanics. The training trajectory of a stochastic gradient-based method is a particle wandering over the energy landscape of the training loss at an induced temperature $T$, and a run that has equilibrated visits every parameter vector of a given training loss equally often, the fundamental postulate of statistical mechanics, with probability given by the Boltzmann distribution. Because training starts at an initial point and has only finite time to diffuse, it carries an effective weight decay, which makes every parameter a quadratic degree of freedom. The equipartition theorem then distributes the energy among the $d$ degrees of freedom in shares of $T/2$, so at a fixed training loss adding parameters lowers the temperature and drives the Boltzmann distribution toward the stationary path. Finally, adding parameters can only lower the $L^2$ norm of the stationary path, so a solution sampled at fixed loss is less likely to be large with increasing $d$, effectively increasing weight regularization.

</details>


### [244] [Probabilistic Linear Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19077)
*Frederic Koriche,Jean-Marie Lagniez,Chi Tran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于稀疏锚定线性模型的统一概率可解释性框架,通过将实例映射到布尔超立方体,推广了传统的子集解释方法,适用于二分类和连续回归任务。框架证明了相关误差最小化问题的NP^PP-hard复杂度,提出了相关误差与可处理的保真度误差之间的理论联系,并通过混合整数规划(MIP)和迭代硬阈值(IHT)两种算法实现,均具有样本复杂度保证。实验表明,所提方法在满足锚定和稀疏性约束的同时,相比LIME和MAPLE等基线方法实现了更低的相关误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的形式化可解释性方法存在两大局限:1)演绎式(abductive)解释往往超出人类认知极限,涉及太多特征;2)概率松弛方法主要局限于分类任务,无法处理连续回归问题。此外,现有的模型无关解释方法(如LIME、MAPLE)虽然灵活,但缺乏严格的理论保证,且常常违反锚定条件,无法准确再现黑盒模型在待解释实例处的预测。

Method: 方法核心包括三个层面:1)问题形式化——将解释定义为满足锚定条件w·x=f(x)和稀疏性约束||w||_0≤k的线性函数w,目标是最小化相关误差(条件期望下的预测差异);2)理论桥梁——证明在参数化的邻域分布族下,任意k-稀疏解释的相关误差被其保真度误差以(1+e^(-σ))^k倍上界,实现从难以处理的PP问题到可处理的经验优化问题的转化;3)算法实现——提出基于SOS1约束的混合整数规划(MIP)获得精确解,以及通过精确投影到锚定稀疏约束交集的迭代硬阈值(IHT)算法(时间复杂度O(d log d + k^2))提供多项式时间近似。

Result: 在16个OpenML基准数据集(8个分类、8个回归)上的实验结果表明:1)MIP和IHT的经验保真度误差在统计上不可区分,且在12/16基准上精确到三位小数;2)LIME的保真度优势源于系统性违反锚定条件(160个任务中全部违反),其相对优势与锚定违反程度高度相关(r=0.92);3)IHT保持近恒定运行时间(0.055-0.141秒),而MIP在d≥180时难以在120秒内证明最优性;4)在相关误差上,IHT和MIP一致优于LIME(中位数高1.3倍,Nomao上高达2倍,Credit Approval上高达6倍);5)稀疏度、局部性和样本量的参数扫描证实了相关误差与保真度误差的理论比值(1+e^(-σ))^k在实际认知相关范围内是保守的(IHT最大比值1.95,MIP最大1.90,均低于理论界4.79)。

Conclusion: 本文建立了一个统一的概率可解释性形式框架,通过稀疏锚定线性模型统一处理分类和回归任务,严格推广了基于子集的解释方法。理论上将NP^PP-hard的相关误差最小化问题分解为可处理的保真度误差优化,通过MIP和IHT两种互补算法提供具有多项式样本复杂度的解决方案。实证结果表明,违反假设空间的解释可能在保真度上表现更好,但其相关性显著下降——锚定不是装饰性的可读性要求,而是使廉价标准成为严格标准代理的必要条件。未来工作可向三个方向拓展:丰富解释类别(如低阶多项式捕捉特征交互)、直接优化相关误差、以及超越二值化域处理有限属性域或数据流形。

Abstract: Formal explainability provides mathematically grounded justifications for individual predictions. However, abductive explanations often exceed human cognitive limits by involving too many features, while probabilistic relaxations have remained largely limited to categorical classification. We present a unified framework for probabilistic explainability based on sparse, anchored linear models, applicable to both binary classification and continuous regression. By mapping instances to the Boolean hypercube, our linear explanations strictly generalize subset-based approaches: they capture both the magnitude and direction of feature contributions while enforcing a prescribed sparsity budget $k$. We show that minimizing the relevance error for such explanations is \ClassNPPP-hard when the underlying model is a neural network, and we relate this intractable objective to a tractable surrogate---the fidelity error. For a parameterized family of local distributions, the relevance error of any $k$-sparse explanation is bounded by its fidelity error up to a multiplicative factor that remains small locally. We address the resulting empirical problem using two complementary approaches: a Mixed Integer Programming (MIP) formulation that yields provably optimal empirical solutions while maintaining polynomial sample complexity, and a polynomial-time Iterative Hard Thresholding (IHT) algorithm with provable approximation guarantees. Empirical evaluations show that, unlike state-of-the-art baselines such as LIME and MAPLE, our explanations satisfy both the anchoring and sparsity constraints by construction, while consistently achieving lower relevance error.

</details>


### [245] [Fathom: Per-Query Read Depth for Sparse Decoding over Offloaded KV Caches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17652)
*Vivek Kalyanarangan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Fathom是面向卸载KV缓存的稀疏解码关键扫描方法，通过按查询/按通道自适应读取位平面深度，在主机内存索引场景下显著降低扫描带宽并提升解码速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文智能体会话中，KV缓存及索引必须驻留在主机内存；当上下文达百万token且多会话并存时，扫描所有n个键进行top-k排序的字节传输成为解码瓶颈。固定深度扫描方法（Loki、Double Sparsity、SparQ）无论查询和通道重要性如何都读取相同比特数，浪费了带宽。

Method: 1) 将4-bit K缓存按通道主序存储为位平面（bit planes），使得读取t个平面恰好等于该通道的t-bit中点上升量化器；2) 定义通道重要性权重g_j = Σ_h (q_j^(h))²·Var(k_j)，量化误差方差按g_j·4^(-t_j)递减；3) 在比特预算B下，通过反向注水（reverse water-filling）分配各通道读取深度t_j ∈ [0,4]；4) 提出基选择规则：QK-norm模型（如Qwen3）使用原始通道，非QK-norm模型（Llama-3.1、Qwen2.5）使用键的KLT旋转基。

Result: 在Qwen3-8B百万token、KV与索引驻留主机内存场景下：56-bit读取比136-bit扫描（Double Sparsity/Loki/SparQ r=32）快1.67×；与SparQ r=16（68-bit）同GPU时间下少读18%字节且注意力误差低1.1-5.3×；在RULER任务上与精确top-k oracle持平；在真实编码智能体会话中以92-bit达到136-bit扫描的步骤一致性（0.60）。等误差下对比Double Sparsity 136-bit实现1.8-2.9×字节节省。当索引位于HBM时方法无加速优势（算术密集型）。

Conclusion: Fathom将4-bit K缓存变为多分辨率索引，每查询按反向注水决定通道读取深度。在卸载KV缓存的百万token解码场景中显著降低PCIe带宽与解码时间，性能优势随上下文长度增长；但仅当索引本身位于慢速存储层时有效，HBM驻留场景下不具备加速优势。该机制适合已采用4-bit K缓存且将其置于慢速层的服务堆栈。

Abstract: When agentic sessions run to a million tokens with many sessions resident at once, the KV cache and the index that ranks it live in host memory, and the scan that ranks all n keys for a top-k step becomes the traffic that bounds decoding. We present Fathom, a key scan in which each query decides how many bits of each key channel to read. The 4-bit K cache is stored channel-major as bit planes, so a prefix of t planes is exactly the channel's t-bit quantizer, and the query spends its bit budget by reverse water-filling over the variance-weighted importance of its channels. At one million tokens on Qwen3-8B a decode step is 1.67x faster in GPU time than with the 136-bit scans of Double Sparsity, Loki and SparQ r=32, and in the same GPU time as SparQ's 68-bit read (r=16) Fathom reads 18% fewer bytes with lower attention error on six of seven model and context settings. On RULER-style tasks every per-token scan matches exact top-k decoding, and on real coding-agent sessions Fathom reaches the step agreement of the most accurate 136-bit scan at 92 bits. The store is the 4-bit K copy a quantized serving stack already holds, and the method is not faster when the index is resident in GPU memory.

</details>


### [246] [ASPIRE: Asynchronous Batched Self-Speculative Decoding for Long-Context LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17943)
*Amir Ziashahabi,Hossein Entezari Zarch,Lei Gao,Murali Annavaram,Salman Avestimehr*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ASPIRE提出了一种用于长上下文LLM推理的非同步批处理自推测解码框架，通过统一混合前向、在线推测调度器和草稿内刷新层三个组件，使同一批次内的不同请求可独立选择草稿或验证时机，在三个模型和五个基准上实现了1.70–4.58×的吞吐量加速，比现有最佳自推测基线平均提升约27%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文LLM推理受限于注意力机制对KV缓存的反复读取，呈现内存受限特征。自推测解码（稀疏注意力草稿+全注意力验证）可缓解此问题，但现有批处理方法仍采用同步调度：批次内所有请求共享同一草稿-验证计划，而最优草稿长度在不同请求间及同一请求的不同生成阶段差异巨大，导致部分请求欠草稿、部分请求过草稿，限制了加速效果。

Method: ASPIRE包含三个核心组件：(1) 统一混合前向（Unified Mixed Forward）——允许同一批次内的请求在单次前向传播中分别处于草稿状态（稀疏注意力）或验证状态（全注意力），消除全局草稿-验证阶段；(2) 在线推测调度器（Online Speculation Scheduler）——基于每请求的接受率估计和批次感知的成本模型（区分MLP的FLOPs成本与注意力的KV读取成本），独立计算各请求的目标草稿长度γ_i，最大化预测的每单位时间令牌产出；(3) 草稿内刷新层（Intra-Draft Refresh Layer）——在草稿阶段对单一指定层（倒数第二层ℓ_r=N−2）执行全注意力，利用其注意力分数更新稀疏上下文S_i，缓解草稿过程中的上下文陈旧问题。稀疏上下文以页面粒度选择，预算k_i=max(k_min, ⌈ρP_i⌉)，其中最近L=8页强制保留以维持局部连续性。

Result: 在Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-8B和DS-Llama-8B三个模型上，针对AIME25、CodeElo、LongBench（16k–18k）、LongBench-v2（30k–40k和80k–100k）五个基准进行评估。ASPIRE实现1.70–4.58×的自回归加速（Qwen3-1.7B在LB-v2[80k-100k]上达4.58×），平均加速比最强自推测基线高约27%。消融实验表明：(1) ASPIRE-Fixed（同步批处理+固定草稿长度+刷新层）随上下文增长性能差距扩大；(2) ASPIRE-FSM（反馈控制器）作为强基线但不如完整调度器稳定。与事后oracle相比，ASPIRE差距在4.7–20.2%之间（平均10.4%）。刷新层在16k上下文下每周期仅增加1.03%开销，在Q=10时将接受率从60.3%提升至76.6%（+16.4个百分点）。

Conclusion: ASPIRE通过解耦批次内不同请求的草稿-验证同步性，并结合草稿内上下文刷新机制，有效提升了长上下文LLM推理的推测利用率和吞吐量。实验证明非同步批处理推测解码在内存受限的长上下文场景中优势显著。输出质量在LongBench-v1上与自回归基线几乎一致（宏平均差−0.20分），验证了精确解码保证。调度器的时间模型需针对不同部署配置（如张量并行度）重新校准系数，但模型结构具备可迁移性。

Abstract: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by attention, whose repeated KV-cache reads make decoding memory-bound. Self-speculative decoding alleviates this by drafting tokens with sparse attention and verifying them with full attention, but existing batched methods remain synchronized: all requests in a batch share a single draft-verify schedule, even though the optimal draft length varies widely across requests and changes dynamically within each request. We propose ASPIRE, a non-synchronized batched self-speculative decoding framework built on three components. First, a unified mixed forward allows drafting and verifying requests to coexist in the same batched forward pass, removing the need for global draft-verify phases. Second, a lightweight online speculation scheduler uses per-request acceptance-rate estimates and a batch-aware cost model to let each request independently choose when to verify. Third, an intra-draft refresh layer performs full attention at a single designated layer during drafting, updating the sparse context at every draft step to reduce staleness during drafting. Across three models and five reasoning and long-context benchmarks, ASPIRE achieves $1.70$-$4.58\times$ speedup in decoding throughput over autoregressive baselines and improves average speedup by approximately $27\%$ over the strongest prior self-speculative baselines.

</details>


### [247] [Beyond Static RAG: An Adaptive, Tri-Metric Routing Framework for Efficient Long-Context Inference on Commodity GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17564)
*Saipraveen Vabbilisetty,Ajay Kumar Boddepalli,Deep Narayan Mishra,Shashank Kapadia,Haoan Wang,Anupriya Sharma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种名为"Tri-Metric Router"的训练免费路由框架，用于在NVIDIA T4（16GB VRAM）等受限商品级GPU上自适应地为RAG管道选择最优的压缩策略（Raw、Neural或Lexical），以解决"压缩悖论"（Compression Paradox）问题——即神经提示压缩引入的KV缓存争用和预处理延迟可能超过其节省的生成时间，并在长上下文场景下引发OOM故障。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在商品级GPU（如16GB的T4）上部署RAG系统时，存在两个相互冲突的失败模式：1）总是使用神经压缩器（如LLMLingua-2）会因vLLM与PyTorch的跨进程VRAM争用和编码器延迟反演而导致OOM或变慢；2）绕过压缩器则会在长上下文上因vLLM的CacheEngine块池耗尽而崩溃。先前的自适应RAG方法主要基于语义信号在资源充足环境（如A100）下工作，未考虑硬件物理约束作为一阶调度信号。

Method: 1) **VRAM分区框架**：通过严格的初始化层次（vLLM以gpu_memory_utilization=0.55首先原子化占用8.8GB，再加载LLMLingua-2的2.5GB静态切片），在T4上实现稳定的vLLM+PyTorch压缩器共驻，确定"金发姑娘区" u∈[0.50, 0.80]；2) **Tri-Metric Router**：一种确定性、无训练的决策树策略，根据三个CPU端信号（空间复杂度L、句法密度ρ_key、Type-Token Ratio TTR）将每个检索到的上下文分配到Raw、Neural (LLMLingua-2) 或 Lexical (BM25) 三条管道；3) **校准方法论**：通过对LongBench qasper的N=21长文档进行剖面分析，拟合幂律 t_c^neural(L) ≈ 3.39×10⁻⁵ L^1.31 (R²=0.94)，求解得出T4上的延迟交叉点 L*=4,332 词（95% CI ±185），并设置 L_low=1,500、θ_k=0.05、θ_t=0.45；4) **三规则调度**：Fast Pass (L<1,500 → Raw)、Sweet Spot (L_low ≤ L ≤ L* 且低ρ_key/TTR → Neural)、T4 Wall (L > L* → BM25截断至4,096 token)及Else分支（高ρ_key/高TTR → Raw以保护结构化内容）。

Result: 在LongBench qasper（100文档，分布内）上：Tri-Metric Router实现0% OOM、7.91±0.3s E2E延迟、51.7±1.2% Combined F1（崩溃文档F1记为0），相对Always-Lexical的47.8% Combined F1提升3.9分，相对Always-Neural（34.6%）提升17.1分，in-distribution oracle对齐率99.0%；在LongBench multifieldqa_en（50文档，分布外）上：路由保持0% OOM、49.3±1.4% Combined F1（相对Always-Lexical 44.1%提升5.2分，bootstrap置换检验 p=0.014）、88.5±4.4% oracle对齐率；Always-Raw和Always-Neural分别仍崩溃65%/19%（分布内）和64%/19%（分布外），确认失败模式具有结构性；3,100词中段输入下LLMLingua-2耗时1.33s带来6.9%净增益。

Conclusion: 该工作贡献包括：1) 表征"压缩悖论"——在受限商品级GPU上vLLM与PyTorch压缩器共部署引发的两种机制性OOM失败模式（CacheEngine块池耗尽 vs 跨进程PyTorch CUDA OOM）；2) 引入"硬件物理"适应信号（VRAM余量和延迟交叉点）作为对纯语义路由的补充维度；3) VRAM分区框架配合经验验证的金发姑娘区，实现16GB硬件上多组件代理式RAG的可靠共驻；4) 校准方法论（而非具体常数4,332词）可迁移到其他GPU。论文诚实地承认了若干局限：L*估计基于仅N=21个长文档、95% CI仅为样本内bootstrap稳定性而非总体推断（真实不确定度估计为±500–1,000词）；ρ_key/TTR守卫的消融研究N=6不足以支持正式显著性声明；仅在T4单卡、Llama-3-8B-Instruct-AWQ单模型、LLMLingua-2单压缩器、LongBench英文QA单基准、B=1批大小下验证；KV缓存管理方法因需修改注意力循环内逻辑而无法在预调度时调用。未来工作包括跨硬件校准、路由曲面(L*, r)联合优化、在线阈值适配、多语种扩展及与KV缓存驱逐方法的集成。

Abstract: Deploying retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) on commodity GPUs such as the NVIDIA T4 (16 GB VRAM) exposes a practical failure mode we call the Compression Paradox: neural prompt compression can add key-value (KV) cache contention and preprocessing latency that outweigh generation-time savings, while skipping compression can cause out-of-memory (OOM) failures on long contexts. We identify two distinct failure mechanisms when a vLLM-served LLM and a PyTorch-based compressor are co-deployed under tight memory budgets, and introduce the Tri-Metric Router, a deterministic, training-free policy that selects among Raw, Neural (LLMLingua-2), and Lexical (BM25) pipelines.
