The router uses three CPU-side signals: spatial complexity ($L$), syntactic density ($\rho_{key}$), and type-token ratio (TTR). Unlike prior semantic-only adaptation, our dispatch signal is hardware-physical, based on VRAM headroom and a latency crossover point. Thresholds are calibrated from profiling on LongBench qasper, yielding an operating crossover near 4,332 words on T4; our contribution is this calibration methodology rather than a hardware-specific constant. On out-of-distribution holdouts, the method achieves 0% OOM failures, 88.5 $\pm$ 4.4% oracle alignment, and 49.3% Combined F1, improving over always-on lexical compression by 5.2 points without additional VRAM or training cost.

</details>


### [248] [Disentangling Algorithmic Bias from Archival Artifacts: A Controlled Audit of Vision-Language Model Valuation in Metropolitan Museum Archives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17572)
*Manpreet Singh,Rhythm Bhatia,Rahul Joshi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文审计了OpenAI CLIP和OpenCLIP两个视觉-语言模型在大都会艺术博物馆藏品中对男女艺术家作品的零样本美学估值分数，发现宏观层面不存在显著的性别估值差异，但指出零样本logit差分方法本身是一种粗粒度的度量工具，接近嵌入噪声底限，无法排除微观层面的视觉偏见，且41.2%的无署名藏品被排除引入了档案生存偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着VLM被广泛应用于数字人文和博物馆自动化编目，区分模型自身的算法估值偏见与档案元数据中嵌入的结构性混淆变量（如媒介、时代、性别代表性的历史不平衡）成为负责任AI治理的关键挑战。

Method: 从Met Open Access API采集N=1,500件艺术品（含743件署名作品：男534、女209；618件匿名），利用gender-guesser进行性别推断，构建三种语义提示对（masterpiece/quality/influence），计算零样本logit差分估值分数，采用Mann-Whitney U检验、bootstrap置信区间、TOST等价性检验和多元OLS回归（控制媒介、世纪、宽高比）进行分析，对比OpenAI CLIP（ViT-B/32, WIT）和OpenCLIP（ViT-B/32, LAION-2B）。

Result: 未调整分析显示两个模型均无显著性别差异（OpenAI CLIP: μF=-0.0067 vs μM=-0.0035, p=0.1829; OpenCLIP: μF=0.0171 vs μM=0.0237, p=0.1224）；TOST在Cohen's d≥0.25时确认统计等价（pTOST<0.005）；OLS回归R²<2%，性别系数不显著（B=0.0037, p=0.202 for CLIP; B=0.0065, p=0.356 for OpenCLIP）。

Conclusion: 宏观层面的分数等价反映的是度量工具的粗糙性和不敏感性，而非模型绝对公平；零样本全局提示logit差分在嵌入噪声底限附近运行，需采用多元混淆控制、等价性检验和档案来源审计来评估文化遗产集合中的AI公平性；提出"档案生存偏差悖论"和四条治理政策建议（媒介分层标准化、强制预部署审计、元数据来源透明、负责任AI采购）。

Abstract: Auditing vision-language models (VLMs) for societal bias requires distinguishing direct algorithmic valuation disparities from confounders embedded within archival metadata. In this study, we audit Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP) models using historical artwork metadata from the Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access collection (N = 1,500 total objects; N = 743 attributed works: Male n = 534, Female n = 209; n = 618 anonymous). We establish a quantitative audit framework evaluating zero-shot CLIP logit differential scores across three semantic prompt pairs (masterpiece, quality, and influence). Unadjusted evaluations demonstrate high score convergence without a statistically significant main gender effect under OpenAI CLIP (mu_F = -0.0067 vs mu_M = -0.0035, p = 0.1829) or OpenCLIP (mu_F = 0.0171 vs mu_M = 0.0237, p = 0.1224). Two One-Sided Tests (TOST) confirm statistical equivalence across Cohen's d >= 0.25 bounds (pTOST < 0.005). Multivariate OLS regression controlling for artwork medium, creation era, and aspect ratio (R^2 < 0.02) confirms that artist gender has no statistically significant conditional effect (p > 0.20). High residual embedding variance (R^2 < 2%) indicates that global zero-shot valuation metrics operate near an embedding noise floor, showing that broad zero-shot prompt logit differentials are a coarse measurement instrument rather than proving absolute model fairness. We highlight two key caveats: (i) macro-level score equivalence reflects metric insensitivity to fine-grained visual-semantic features and does not preclude localized micro-level visual biases, and (ii) excluding 41.2% unattributed holdings reflects institutional survival bias. These results demonstrate the necessity of multivariate confound control, equivalence testing, and archival provenance auditing when assessing AI fairness in cultural heritage collections.

</details>


### [249] [Temperon: Full-Time SAM Quality at a Third Less Wall-Clock](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17575)
*Stamatis Mastromichalakis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Temperon 方法：在训练预算的前 43% 使用普通 SGD 作为探索器，然后在最后余弦退火开始时一次性切换到 SAM 包裹的 Muon 精炼器。该方法在 CIFAR-10/100、SVHN、Tiny ImageNet 上匹配全时 SAM 的精度，同时减少约 1/3 的 wall-clock 时间，并将分配规律成功迁移到 GPT-2 预训练（-29% 时间）和 GLUE 微调（-36% SAM 成本）。核心贡献是定位精度提升来自 Muon 精炼器而非调度形状。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAM 等昂贵的训练模式通常全程使用，但其收益集中在训练末段。论文将问题重新定义为"分配问题"：在固定预算下，昂贵的训练模式应该花在哪里？Zhou 等人已证明末段 SAM 可恢复全时 SAM 的大部分泛化能力，论文在此基础上系统化地回答"何时切换、切换到什么"。

Method: 两阶段单次切换配方：(1) 探索器——普通 Nesterov SGD（lr=0.1，wd=5e-4）运行前 43% epoch；(2) 在余弦退火起始点执行调度切换：新优化器继承动量缓冲、200 步 LR warmup、SAM 扰动半径 ρ 从 0 在 400 步内 ramp up；(3) 精炼器——SAM 包裹的 Muon（lr=0.01，wd=0.2，ρ=0.05）拥有剩余 57% 的余弦退火。经济模型：跳过早期 SAM 获得固定 credit，Muon 尾段付出 1.50× 的固定溢价（在四个数据集上稳定）。切换点是从 43% 到 80% 的可调旋钮。

Result: 视觉任务（CIFAR-10/100、SVHN、Tiny ImageNet，5 种子，宽 ResNet-110 4× 宽度 27.6M 参数，100 epoch）：Temperon 在全部四个数据集上与最佳全时 SAM 配方在最终精度上持平（Welch p=0.87/0.29/0.94/0.28），在 CIFAR-100/10/Tiny ImageNet 上以 35%/34%/32% 更少时间达到最难共同目标。消融实验精确归属贡献：Muon 精炼器带来 +0.85pp（p=0.005），探索器形状和重启带来 0 贡献（被撤回）。GPT-2 124M 预训练：SAM 尾段匹配全时 SAM，wall-clock 减少 29%（5335s → 3796s）。GLUE 微调：在 ρ=0.05 下 SAM 全时有害，尾段在 36% 更少 SAM 成本下等价于全时。

Conclusion: 分配规律是普适的：昂贵的训练模式只应在尾段使用，且尾段应拥有整个最终退火阶段，并交给任务最适配的精炼器。精度提升的真正贡献是 Muon 精炼器，而非分配形状。最强对手（late-phase SAM）在中级目标上更快，并在 Tiny ImageNet（Muon 不产生精度阶跃的数据集）上完全胜出。在余弦调度下，精度曲线呈"平台-然后冲刺"形态，切换无法从轨迹自适应确定，因此调度化切换是有原则的选择。Temperon 的胜出条件是任务中存在昂贵精炼器能买到的精度阶跃。代码以 pip 包形式发布。

Abstract: Sharpness-aware minimization (SAM) doubles the cost of every training step, yet its benefit concentrates where training ends. We study where an expensive training mode should be spent and propose Temperon: a plain-SGD explorer for the first 43% of the epoch budget, then one scheduled hand-off that gives the entire final cosine anneal to a SAM-wrapped Muon refiner. On CIFAR-10/100, SVHN and Tiny ImageNet (five seeds, times reported as epochs-to-target times an idle-GPU-calibrated epoch cost), Temperon matches the best full-time-SAM recipe on accuracy everywhere while reaching the hardest common target 35%, 34% and 32% sooner on three of the four, and sits a tier above the published SAM+SGD recipe at level cost. Ablations make the attribution exact: the Muon refiner is worth +0.85pp with everything else fixed; the explorer's shape and its restarts are worth nothing, and we withdraw them as contributions. Re-running the closest rival, late-phase SAM, at matched budget shows the frontier: it is fastest to every mid-level target, but the tier the Muon refiner buys (0.83 on CIFAR-100, 0.97 on CIFAR-10) is reached by no SGD-refined method in any seed, and on Tiny ImageNet, where Muon buys no tier, the rival simply wins -- the measured boundary of the method. The allocation law transfers to GPT-2 pretraining (full-SAM quality at -29% wall-clock) and GLUE fine-tuning (never worse than full-time SAM at a third of its SAM cost). Two constants organize the economics: skipping SAM early buys a fixed credit, and a Muon epoch costs 1.50x a SAM+SGD epoch on all four datasets. Finally, the hand-off cannot be timed from the trajectory: under cosine schedules the accuracy curve is plateau-then-surge, so the information lives in the schedule, making the scheduled switch principled rather than convenient. Code and a pip-installable implementation are released.

</details>


### [250] [When the Gradient Sees Rank: Provable Necessity, Causal Recruitment, and Composition in Trained Matrix Memories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17594)
*Samuel Larson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究基于梯度训练的矩阵记忆是否能够学习并利用存储和组合关联所需的秩。通过在需要精确线性恢复的任务上训练矩阵记忆，作者证明了训练确实能学习到所需的高秩，并通过训练时秩帽实验验证了秩与恢复之间的因果关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究在矩阵增强推理器上使用允许秩-1解的任务，无法确定梯度训练在需要更高秩时如何表现。本文旨在回答：基于梯度的训练能否学习存储和组合关联所需的秩？限制该秩是否会损害性能？

Method: 设计需要 rank(Z)≥K 才能精确线性恢复的关键-值绑定任务；使用 Transformer 编码器生成 d×d 矩阵状态；采用固定线性读出（矩阵-向量积，无 argmax）；以有效秩（奇异值谱归一化熵的指数）为主要度量；在训练时通过谱投影实施秩帽作为因果控制；在组合任务中分析实体子空间上的算子行为。

Result: 学习到的有效秩随绑定数 K 单调增加（d=16 时 Spearman ρ=1.0）；训练时秩帽产生 k=K 附近的恢复跃迁（d=8, K=4 时秩 3 恢复≤0.0004，秩 4 恢复 0.97）；5 个种子中 4 个在 21 次自应用后保持≥0.9996 恢复；在实体子空间上学习算子的有效秩接近 K 且近似理想循环；延长训练可解决部分初始失败，但固定编码器宽度时大矩阵维度下恢复仍下降。

Conclusion: 基于梯度的训练能够学习并使用矩阵记忆中存储多个关联所需的高秩；秩限制作为因果因素直接决定恢复能力；学习到的算子在实体子空间上近似理想循环，其行为可通过该子空间算子预测；然而高有效秩本身不足以保证准确绑定，在固定编码器宽度下扩展矩阵维度时恢复会下降。

Abstract: Can gradient-based training learn the rank needed to store and compose associations in a matrix memory? In our earlier study, we used a matrix-augmented reasoner on a task that admits a rank-1 solution, leaving this question open. We train matrix memories on $K$ fresh key-value bindings whose exact linear recovery requires $\mathrm{rank}(Z) \geq K$. A fixed linear readout queries a single matrix state without access to the original bindings. Experiments measure recovery by cosine similarity greater than 0.9, a threshold distinct from mathematical equality. Learned effective rank increases with $K$ across the tested grid (Spearman $\rho = 1.0$ at $d = 16$). Training-time rank caps produce a recovery transition near $k = K$: at $d = 8$, $K = 4$, rank 3 gives at most 0.0004 recovery and rank 4 gives 0.97. Four of five seeds retain at least 0.9996 recovery through 21-fold self-application of the trained operator. On the entity subspace, the learned operator has effective rank close to $K$ and approximates the ideal cycle. For the single converged seed capped below $K$, a calculation using the entity-subspace operator and ideal cycle predicts the measured cosine within 0.008 through seven applications. Extending training resolves several initial failures, but recovery still declines at larger matrix dimensions with encoder width fixed.

</details>


### [251] [Prior-Free Competitive Ratios for Improving Bandits: Scale, Curvature and Horizon Are Free, but Not Jointly Under Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17595)
*Xuan Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究改进型多臂老虎机(IMAB)问题中"先验自由"的竞争比,核心发现:在无噪声情形下,尺度m、曲率指数β和时域T三者均可无需任何先验信息同时自适应达到最优竞争比Θ(k^{β/(1+β)}+k/T);但在乘性噪声模型下,当m和β同时未知时,适应代价跳变为Θ_ε(√(log k/log log k)),而仅知其一则仍保持常数代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 改进型多臂老虎机(IMAB)中,Blum和Ravichandran (ALT 2025) 的算法要求已知尺度m,且未尺度时多出log k因子;Blum, Garicano, Ravichandran和Sharma (UAI 2026) 引入曲率包络指数β,但仍依赖参数学习且无逐实例最坏保证。本文动机在于:系统性地研究在无需任何先验(m, β, T, ε)条件下,各参数对竞争比的影响是否可同时消除,以及噪声如何改变这一图景。

Method: 方法论分四部分:(1)尺度未知:提出一页纸的探测-承诺(Probe-and-Commit, PC)算法,随机抽样⌊√k⌋个臂各探⌊T/(2⌊√k⌋)⌋次后承诺最优探针值臂;(2)无噪声完全先验自由:设计随机边际探测(RMP)算法,用独立均匀随机权重Z_i对观测增量加权做贪心,并扩展为稀疏独立包含(SRMP)覆盖所有时域;(3)噪声下上界:嵌套排列探测(NPA)算法,使用精心构造的非递增深度包络D(x)以平衡多尺度探测预算;(4)噪声下下界:Yao式困难分布构造,含隐藏增长前缀的"星臂"实例族配合Yao混合引理,证明Φ(k)=√((1+ln k)/ln(e+ln k))阶的下界。

Result: 主要结果分四档。(a)未知尺度自由:PC达到竞争比4√3·√k(消除log k),全时域最优比(√k+k/T),含anytime版本APC;(b)无噪声下所有先验自由:RMP/SRMP对每个β和每个T同时达到Θ(k^{β/(1+β)}+k/T),先验价格Θ(1);(c)噪声下:PC保持Θ(√k+k/T)且无需知ε;但m和β同时未知时,均匀适应代价φ_ε(k)=Θ_ε(Φ(k))=Θ_ε(√(log k/log log k)),NPA匹配此上界;(d)仅知m或仅知β则恢复常数代价。统一到一个不读任何参数的混合算法,提供噪声和无噪声两套保证。

Conclusion: 结论:在无噪声IMAB中,尺度、曲率、时域三者确实全部"免费"——一个同时对所有参数自适应的算法达到最小最大最优比;然而噪声的引入使这一画面彻底改变——m和β的联合不确定性导致适应代价必须承受Φ(k)=Θ(√(log k/log log k))的渐近增长,尽管单独知道任一参数都能将代价拉回常数。技术核心在于将"保留/丢弃臂"的绝对阈值比较替换为相对比较(argmax或随机权重归一化),用√k子样本代价换得尺度无关性,并用"截断边际工作量"引理避免多尺度并集界。开放问题包括噪声下ε的最优依赖、短时域(T<16k)的匹配下界、加性高斯噪声下竞争保证的可行性等。

Abstract: In the improving multi-armed bandits problem, each of $k$ arms has an unknown nondecreasing, discretely concave reward curve $f_i$, and pulling arm $i$ for the $t$-th time yields $f_i(t)$. For sufficiently long horizons, Blum and Ravichandran (ALT 2025) proved that randomized algorithms achieve an $O(\sqrt k)$ approximation to the best single arm when the scale $m=f^*(T)$ of the optimal arm is known ($T\ge2k$), and $O(\sqrt k\log k)$ when it is not ($T>4k$), against an $\Omega(\sqrt k)$ lower bound. The logarithmic factor is unnecessary: a one-page \emph{probe-and-commit} algorithm achieves competitive ratio $4\sqrt3\,\sqrt k$ for $T\ge2\lfloor\sqrt k\rfloor$, without any knowledge of the scale, and we determine the optimal ratio for every horizon, $\Theta(\sqrt k+k/T)$, also for unknown horizons. Without noise, \emph{no prior is needed at all}: a random-marginal probing algorithm reading neither the scale $m$, nor the concavity-envelope exponent $\beta$ of Blum, Garicano, Ravichandran and Sharma (UAI 2026), nor the horizon $T$, achieves the optimal $\Theta(k^{\beta/(1+\beta)}+k/T)$ simultaneously for every $\beta$ and every horizon. Under the multiplicative noise model of Blum and Ravichandran, probe-and-commit keeps the same all-horizon order $\Theta(\sqrt k+k/T)$ without knowing the noise level (and $\Theta(\sqrt k)$ on the same range), but the price of priors jumps: for any fixed noise level $\varepsilon\in(0,1/2]$, the uniform price of adaptation $\phi_\varepsilon(k)$ --- the worst case over horizons $T\ge16k$ of the loss relative to $k^{\beta/(1+\beta)}$ for algorithms knowing neither $m$ nor $\beta$ --- is $\Theta_\varepsilon(\sqrt{\log k/\log\log k})$, the lower bound asymptotic in $k$ at fixed positive $\varepsilon$ and matched by a nested random-permutation probing algorithm, whereas knowing either $m$ or $\beta$ alone restores a constant price.

</details>


### [252] [Regularized Least Squares Training of Quadratic Neural Networks with Applications to System Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17654)
*Luis Rodrigues,Zachary Yetman Van Egmond,Mohammad R. Amiri Fard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于正则化最小二乘的二次神经网络（QNN）训练方法，推导出训练优化问题解的下界，并在正则化系数为零时给出闭式最优解及其灵敏度表达式，还揭示了该优化与核范数最小化的联系，通过柔性机械臂系统辨识实例验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二次神经网络（QNN）的训练通常被建模为非凸优化问题，依赖反向传播等迭代方法，容易陷入局部最优。已有研究将QNN训练转化为凸优化（如基于半定规划的SDP方法），但缺乏闭式解，计算代价较高。因此，亟需一种能够给出解析解、避免局部最优且计算高效的QNN训练方法。

Method: 将含ℓ1正则化的QNN训练凸优化问题（基于LMI约束的SDP形式）松弛其约束条件。利用矩阵分解（Schur补、核范数与Frobenius范数关系等）推导训练代价的下界。将QNN的输入-输出关系重写为关于矩阵Z₁和Z₂中元素的线性形式，从而将训练问题转化为标准的（或加权的）正则化最小二乘问题，得到闭式解。具体包括：(1) 无正则化时的标准最小二乘闭式解；(2) 有正则化时通过调节加权矩阵M_γ和系数k获得下界和上界；(3) 建立与核范数最小化问题的联系。

Result: 理论上证明：当β=0时，最小二乘闭式解与凸优化最优解一致（紧下界）；当β>0时，正则化最小二乘解给出训练代价的下界，且与核范数最小化相关联；给出了权值对数据误差灵敏度的解析表达式。在柔性机械臂非线性系统辨识实例中（N=1024，仅用前122个数据点训练自回归模型），验证了所提方法与凸优化最优解的一致性（β=0时两者完全重合），并对比了不同β值时下界(40)与正则化最小二乘(46)对最优解的逼近效果：β较小时RLS更紧，β≥5时下界更紧。

Conclusion: 本文提出的正则化最小二乘方法为二次神经网络训练提供了一种计算高效、解析可解的方案，具有闭式解、灵敏度解析表达式和与核范数最小化的理论联系三大贡献。该方法是首个无需固定或随机化隐层权值、可将所有权值作为决策变量的深度神经网络最小二乘训练方法（通过输入的单项式提升将深度QNN等价转化为两层QNN）。系统辨识实验验证了方法的有效性。

Abstract: This paper proposes a least squares approach for the training of quadratic neural networks with regularization. The proposed methodology yields a lower bound on the solution of the training optimization problem for the case where the regularization coefficient is positive. Moreover, it yields closed-form expressions for the approximate solution and its sensitivity The lower bound is tight and the approximate solution is the optimal solution when the regularization coefficient is zero. Having a closed-form expression for the weights reduces considerably the computational time when compared with iterative numerical methods such as backpropagation that can get stuck in local minima. The proposed approach has three main contributions, namely, (i) it yields an analytical expression for the weights, (ii) an analytical expression for the sensitivity of the weights to errors in the data is also provided, (iii) it establishes a connection between the optimization to compute a lower bound and nuclear norm minimization. The proposed least squares training is successfully applied to a nonlinear system identification example where the proposed lower bound is compared with the optimal value.

</details>


### [253] [DSD: Learning Diverse and Reusable Motor Skills via Diffusion Skill Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17682)
*Sun Woo Kim,Xue Bin Peng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DSD（Diffusion Skill Discovery），一种利用扩散模型通过评分匹配近似策略诱导状态分布的熵梯度，从而在高维人形角色控制中发现多样化且可复用的运动技能的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于潜变量的技能发现方法依赖间接潜空间近似或粗糙状态分布估计器，导致在复杂的人形控制任务中难以实现广泛的行为覆盖，学习到的技能多样性和下游任务实用性有限。

Method: DSD通过最大化技能潜变量与状态之间的互信息，结合扩散模型（评分匹配）近似边际状态熵梯度以促进状态空间广泛覆盖，并使用变分下界（von Mises-Fisher分布）最小化条件熵以确保每个潜变量产生一致且独特的行为。同时引入AMP对抗运动先验保持行为自然性，以及JIDS（抖动抑制多样性抑制）通过低通滤波减少高频伪多样性。训练后的技能通过层级控制（高层策略选择潜变量）和零样本控制（离线轨迹池中选择最适配潜变量）两种方式复用于下游任务。

Result: 在Reallusion、LaFAN1、MimicKit三个运动数据集上的实验表明，DSD在所有数据集上均达到最低FID（最高1.64、1.88、0.29），同时具备最高的根运动多样性，并在零样本控制10个任务中的8个和层级控制6个任务中的多个任务（如后空翻、定位、盾击）上取得最佳性能，能够自动发现后空翻、大跳等高难度敏捷行为。

Conclusion: DSD证明了基于扩散模型的熵估计可有效支持多样化运动技能的发现，扩散模型相比传统互信息估计方法在高维人形控制中能更好地促进行为多样性；实验同时表明广泛状态覆盖本身不足以构建有用的技能库，还需通过条件熵目标将多样化行为组织成一致的潜变量条件化技能，JIDS和运动先验对技能质量和自然性至关重要。

Abstract: Humans efficiently learn new tasks by reusing a rich repertoire of motor skills across different goals and contexts. A similar strategy can also be used to enable simulated characters to efficiently perform new tasks by leveraging reusable motor skills. To support a wide range of downstream tasks, the learned repertoire should be diverse, consisting of distinct behaviors as well as spatial and temporal variation within each behavior. A commonly used method for learning diverse skills is by maximizing the mutual information between skill latents and the states produced by a policy. The marginal state entropy promotes broad behavioral coverage, while the conditional entropy encourages consistent behaviors from each latent. However, directly estimating the marginal state entropy is intractable in high-dimensional control problems. Prior methods therefore rely on indirect latent-space approximations or coarse estimators of the state distribution. These approximations may not effectively promote broad coverage of the state space, resulting in skills with limited behavioral diversity and reduced utility for downstream tasks. In this work, we propose Diffusion Skill Discovery (DSD), a skill discovery method that uses a diffusion model to approximate the entropy gradient of the policy-induced state distribution through score matching. The resulting objective encourages the discovery of skills that produce a broader range of behaviors for high-dimensional humanoid control. The learned skills are reused in two downstream control settings: hierarchical control with a task-specific high-level policy and zero-shot control through latent selection from offline trajectories. Our experiments show that DSD discovers a broader repertoire of reusable motor skills than prior skill discovery methods, leading to the emergence of complex and agile behaviors that can be reused across downstream tasks.

</details>


### [254] [Composite-Gradient Learning for Shared Control Authority Between Deep Reinforcement Learning and Model Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17697)
*Giray Önür,Azita Dabiri,Bart De Schutter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为复合梯度学习（CGL）的新方法，用于深度强化学习（DRL）与模型预测控制（MPC）共享控制权的分层控制框架。CGL通过将DRL动作和MPC控制输入表示为联合动作，并在训练更新DRL智能体时同时考虑两者之间的交互作用，从而将MPC控制器整合到学习过程中。此外，还提出了一种层次感知的数据存储与采样方案，以减少训练中MPC计算的重复开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在现有的DRL-MPC分层控制框架中，MPC控制器通常被视为环境的一部分进行训练。这种做法忽略了MPC对控制的贡献及其与DRL智能体之间的交互作用——由于MPC需要未来的DRL动作来预测系统演化，DRL智能体会影响MPC控制输入的计算。将MPC视为环境会导致学习公式不完整，在DRL与MPC控制输入强耦合时限制控制性能。本文旨在解决这一学习公式不完整的问题。

Method: 1）将分层DRL-MPC控制问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），其中低层DRL动作和高层MPC控制输入构成联合动作空间，状态为DRL观测值；2）基于DDPG算法，提出复合梯度学习方法，将策略梯度分解为两部分：DRL直接贡献 g_rl（捕获DRL动作对估计回报的直接效应）和MPC间接贡献 g_mpc（捕获DRL策略通过MPC控制输入产生的间接效应），后者通过对MPC控制律关于DRL策略参数求导得到；3）提出层次感知的数据存储与采样方案，将经验按MPC更新分组，组内共享相同的MPC初始化状态，从而在训练中复用MPC计算结果，将每个critic目标所需的MPC评估次数从2/q降低至接近1/q；4）采用反模式自动微分和递归检查点伴随方案计算MPC灵敏度，避免要求求解器收敛到局部最优。

Result: 在两个多类别高速公路交通网络（Network 1弱耦合、Network 2强耦合）上，将CGL与三种替代方法（CGL-D仅使用直接梯度、CGL-S缩放间接梯度、MPC-E将MPC视为环境）进行比较，每种方法使用10个独立随机种子训练。在Network 1（弱耦合）中，各方法性能分布高度重叠，CGL无明显优势；在Network 2（强耦合）中，CGL的平均回报比CGL-D和MPC-E高约2.4%，其中10个训练策略中有3个显著优于替代方法。梯度分析显示，Network 1中间接MPC梯度的范数占比仅为3.0%，而在Network 2中升至27.3%，且DRL与MPC梯度的余弦相似度中位数从0.03降至-0.40，表明强耦合时间接贡献更大且常与直接贡献方向相反，包含该对立贡献可引导策略更新获得更高回报。

Conclusion: CGL通过将MPC控制器整合到学习过程中，捕捉了DRL与MPC控制输入之间的双向耦合效应。在弱耦合场景中，CGL的收益有限；在强耦合场景中，CGL在部分训练运行中显著优于替代方法，尽管平均性能提升仍较为有限。未来工作将聚焦于检测DRL与MPC控制输入的强耦合条件，并在这些情况下有选择地计算和使用复合梯度，以进一步提高CGL的计算效率。

Abstract: Integrated deep reinforcement learning (DRL) and model predictive control (MPC) methods are increasingly used to control autonomous systems by combining their complementary capabilities. DRL learns control policies through interaction with the environment. MPC uses a system model to optimize control inputs while accounting for constraints. In DRL-MPC frameworks with shared control authority, both the DRL agent and the MPC controller each determine part of the control inputs. However, common learning formulations treat MPC as part of the environment and therefore do not explicitly account for MPC's contribution to control or its interaction with the DRL agent. This paper proposes a novel composite-gradient learning (CGL) method that integrates the MPC controller into the learning process by representing the DRL and MPC control inputs as a joint action and accounting for their interaction when updating the DRL agent during training. CGL is evaluated on two multi-class freeway traffic networks with different strengths of interaction between the DRL and MPC control inputs and it is compared with alternative methods that treat MPC as part of the environment or that only partially incorporate MPC into learning. The results show that CGL offers limited benefit under weak interaction, but learns higher-performing control policies than the alternative methods in a subset of training runs under strong interaction, although the average control-performance gains remain modest.

</details>


### [255] [SAM-on-the-Curve: Sharpness-Aware Mode Connectivity for Robust Weight-Space Interpolation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17748)
*Alejandro Calatrava,Xu Zhang,Ren Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Sharp Mode Connectivity (SMC)，将Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) 的极小极大目标融入Mode Connectivity (MC) 的路径优化中，通过三次贝塞尔曲线在权重空间中寻找低损且平坦的连通路径。在ResNet-18/VGG16-BN/ViT-Tiny上的实验表明，SMC路径损失方差降低26.7×，中点SAM Gap降低48%，并在CIFAR-10-C严重模糊损坏下获得最高+6.09%的绝对精度提升，同时产生深度负的损失障碍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Mode Connectivity仅优化一维路径上的损失值，对周围邻域的平坦性无约束，导致路径可能穿越尖锐山脊，在分布偏移下脆弱。需要将平坦性约束从单点扩展到整条连通曲线。

Method: 提出sharpness-aware path functional：J_sharp(θ)=∫₀¹ max‖ε‖₂≤ρ L(φ_θ(t)+ε) dt。采用一阶SAM近似与蒙特卡洛采样得到实用目标J_sharp(θ)≈(1/K)∑L(φ_θ(t_k)+ε̂(φ_θ(t_k)))，通过链式法则推导曲线参数θ的梯度。算法使用三次贝塞尔曲线参数化路径，每个采样点进行两次反向传播（上升扰动+下降梯度），并与曲线Jacobian相乘。在评估点执行BN统计重校准以处理插值问题。

Result: ResNet-18/CIFAR-10上路径损失方差从0.056降至0.0021（26.7×改善），中点SAM Gap从0.6916降至0.3594（48%降低）。CIFAR-10-C Severity 5下：ResNet-18在Defocus模糊上+6.09%，Gaussian模糊+5.71%；VGG16-BN在Defocus模糊上+4.08%。严重偏移下损失障碍达到-1.79（VGG16-BN/Gaussian模糊），路径内部解可超越端点平均。SMC在ViT-Tiny上一致优于MC，但注意力机制存在残留中点障碍。每epoch计算开销为5.6×。

Conclusion: SMC建立了路径级平坦性作为鲁棒泛化的实用几何原理，将MC与SAM两个先前独立的理论视角统一起来。未来工作包括自适应扰动调度、置换对齐方法集成以消除ViT残留障碍，以及基于梯度攻击的对抗鲁棒性评估。同时需注意权重空间平坦性不必然蕴含输入空间鲁棒性。

Abstract: Deep neural networks that are independently trained to similar performance can be connected by low-loss parametric curves in weight space, a phenomenon known as Mode Connectivity (MC). This geometric property underpins practical techniques such as weight averaging, model ensembling, and model merging. We argue that low-loss connectivity is an incomplete geometric criterion: it controls loss only along a one-dimensional trajectory while leaving the surrounding weight-space neighborhood unconstrained, so the optimized curve may traverse sharp ridges that become fragile under distribution shift. We therefore reformulate mode connectivity as a neighborhood-robust path optimization problem, seeking a curve whose entire local neighborhood maintains low loss. We propose Sharp Mode Connectivity (SMC), which applies a first-order sharpness-aware approximation to the resulting minimax functional, enforcing flatness along the entire curve rather than only on it. We derive a practical optimization algorithm for connectivity paths under this sharpness-aware objective. Under severe blur corruptions from CIFAR-10-C, SMC achieves up to 6.09\% absolute accuracy improvement over standard MC. Remarkably, SMC produces negative loss barriers, meaning that models obtained at interior points of the optimized path can outperform the average endpoint loss. These results, validated across ResNet-18, VGG16-BN, and ViT-Tiny on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-100, establish path-wise flatness as a practical principle for robust weight-space interpolation.

</details>


### [256] [Modular Deep Learning Mechanisms for Auditable Next-Day Wildfire Spread Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17763)
*Miguel Esparza,Aydin Ayanzadeh Ahmad Mousavi,Ali Mostafavi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出三种模块化增强机制（风/坡度条件注意力偏置WCAB/SCAB、物理特征检索增强输出修正PFRAOC、火条件双流门控），在五个骨干网络上对Next Day Wildfire Spread基准进行评估，实现了可审计的次日野火蔓延预测，并通过混合集成取得了最佳分类性能（F1=0.4292, AUC-PR=0.3790）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习模型在野火预测中表现出色，但预测性能本身无法建立物理保真度或操作可信度。预测图无法揭示其计算中所用的先验假设或历史证据，而事后解释方法（如SHAP）仅提供相关性估计而非计算保证。因此需要将领域知识作为可识别组件嵌入架构内部，使预测结果可审计，同时保持预测性能。

Method: 三种模块化增强：(1) WCAB/SCAB——将风向和坡度驱动的方向偏好作为加性偏置注入窗口注意力的预softmax分数，由可学习零初始化标量λ/γ控制；(2) PFRAOC——构建九维物理特征描述符（风向正余弦、风速、ERC、高程、NDVI、PDSI、最高温、燃烧像素比例），通过FAISS索引检索K=3最近历史瓦片，训练轻量修正网络叠加于冻结基础模型的logits；(3) 双流门控——基于前一日火灾掩码生成的sigmoid空间权重图调制环境特征通道。评估协议在五个骨干网络（SwinUNETR、MK-UNet、CAFIM-CNN、U-Net、Conv-AE）上采用阶段式消融、方向审计、检索扰动、概率校准（ECE/Brier）和计算成本对比。

Result: SwinUNETR+全部三机制：F1=0.4216, AUC-PR=0.3673；混合集成（两增强+一无增强架构）：F1=0.4292±0.0016, AUC-PR=0.3790±0.0025（三种子均值）。检索在所有主机上提升AUC-PR但不持续转化为F1提升。风向偏置与输入风向高度一致（98.3-98.6%瓦片在45°内），但与观测到的次日火位移一致性弱（28.6-29.0%，接近随机）。物理匹配检索与随机检索在精度上统计上不可区分，但物理匹配瓦片与观测火掩码IoU显著更高。

Conclusion: 研究提出一个模块化框架，用于在多个野火预测架构中暴露和评估领域知情组件。结果表明：预测性能、操作可信度和计算实用性不必是相互竞争的目标；先验可检查性不等同于预测物理保真度；检索可改善精度-召回排序但不改善阈值化F1；机制效益因架构而异。未来工作需通过受控分析员研究和前瞻性影子评估来验证其对决策质量的实际价值。

Abstract: Next-day wildfire prediction requires models whose forecasts can be evaluated alongside the assumptions and historical evidence used in their computation. Although deep learning can learn spatial patterns from remote-sensing data, predictive performance alone does not establish physical fidelity or operational trustworthiness. This study investigates three modular augmentations for next-day active-fire prediction: wind- and slope-conditioned attention biases, physics-feature retrieval-augmented output correction, and fire conditioned dual-stream gating. The attention biases expose prescribed directional preferences, while the retrieval module selects historical tiles using a nine-dimensional environmental and fire-state descriptor and applies a learned correction to a frozen model's logits. The modules are evaluated across five backbones on the Next Day Wildfire Spread benchmark, using staged ablations, directional audits, retrieval perturbations, calibration measures, and computational comparisons. The three-seed mean F1 score and area under the precision--recall curve (AUC-PR) of a SwinUNETR model with all three augmentations are 0.4216 and 0.3673. Then, a mixed ensemble (two augmented architectures and one non-augmented architecture) model achieves 0.4292 and 0.3790. Benefits vary across architectures, and retrieval-related improvements in AUC-PR do not consistently translate into higher F1. The constructed wind bias aligns closely with input wind, but its alignment with observed next-day fire displacement is much weaker, distinguishing prior inspectability from predictive physical fidelity. The study contributes a framework for exposing and evaluating selected domain-informed components within wildfire prediction models. Together, the results presented show that predictive performance, operational trustworthiness, and computational practicality need not be competing objectives.

</details>


### [257] [NObSP: Functional Decomposition of Neural Networks via Oblique Subspace Projections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17825)
*Alexander Caicedo,Víctor De La Hoz,Santiago Alférez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出NObSP框架，利用神经网络末层线性结构和样本空间中的斜投影，将预测分解为每个特征的显式贡献函数和交互残差。该方法支持局部与全局解释，并在合成基准上显著优于KernelSHAP和Integrated Gradients的特征函数恢复能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络在高风险领域的部署需要可解释性，但现有方法存在局限：SHAP/LIME等仅给出标量重要性，无法揭示特征与预测间的函数关系；PDP/ALE等函数分解方法在特征相关时存在外推问题、累积数值误差且缺乏高效的样本外扩展；梯度CAM方法仅提供空间热图而无函数形式。核心挑战在于神经网络所学特征子空间常存在重叠（叠加现象），传统ANOVA分解的正交性假设不再成立。

Method: NObSP框架的核心思想：神经网络所有非线性集中在倒数第二层映射 z = f(x)，而最终输出层 ŷ = w⊤z + b 是线性的，因此可在样本空间 ℝᴺ 中通过斜投影进行分解。具体步骤：(1) 对每个特征 k 构造隔离输入 X_k（仅特征 k 激活）通过前向传播获取 Z_k，构造参考输入 X_(k) 获取 Z_(k)；(2) 在样本空间中定义目标子空间 V_k = col(Z̃_k) 和参考子空间 V_(k) = col(Z̃_(k))；(3) 利用 Behrens-Scharf 斜投影器沿 V_(k) 方向投影到 V_k，避免正交投影在子空间重叠时的双重计算；(4) 提出偏回归等价形式（算法1），将样本外评估复杂度从 O(N²) 降至 O(d_z)，仅需单次前向传播加内积；(5) 理论联系到 Hoeffding/功能 ANOVA 分解和 Kolmogorov-Arnold 表示定理，并建立唯一性保证；(6) 扩展 NObSP-CAM 至卷积网络，将通道视为特征生成类激活图，仅需一次性校准；(7) 贡献向量 g(x) = [g_1(x_1),...,g_d(x_d)]⊤ 诱导几何有意义的嵌入空间，支持基于相似度的解释检索和不确定性量化。

Result: 合成加性基准（已知真值分量：|x₁|+x₂³+e^x₃+sin(2x₄)+0·x₅+η）上，NObSP的函数复现得分FRS R²达0.989±0.001，显著优于KernelSHAP的0.966和Integrated Gradients的0.922，且对零特征x₅的误判最小（0.009 vs 0.014/0.022），能准确恢复绝对值、立方、指数、正弦各分量。在TinyImageNet上，贡献向量嵌入将k近邻类纯度均值从原始激活的0.654提升至0.713，中位数达1.000，平均近邻距离减少过半（0.855→0.408）。表格数据上与IG/KernelSHAP的忠实度相关性可比，但IG在多数数据集上略优（IG直接优化基线到输入的归因）。视觉任务中，NObSP-CAM的Region Deletion AUC与GradCAM相当（完整配置平均0.594 vs 0.606），在MobileNetV2+CIFAR-10取得行最大值（0.614 vs 0.601），校准时间随倒数第二层维度从<1秒到25分钟不等，一次性成本可被推理摊销。统计检验显示完整24配置上GradCAM略优（差值-0.011，p=0.0003）但绝对差异较小。定性分析显示NObSP-CAM在皮肤镜图像上能更好抑制背景激活、聚焦病灶核心；嵌入检索可揭示误分类和标注错误（如一个明显是海滩场景的"橄榄球"标签）。

Conclusion: NObSP是一个数学原理严密的神经网络可解释性框架，通过斜投影在样本空间中实现预测的功能分解，连接了斜投影理论、功能ANOVA分解和Kolmogorov-Arnold表示定理。其核心贡献在于：(1) 唯一性保证的理论框架；(2) 将样本外评估复杂度从O(N²)降至O(d_z)的高效偏回归算法；(3) NObSP-CAM扩展至卷积网络，无需反向传播；(4) 贡献向量形成的检索嵌入改善类纯度，无需真值标签即可用于不确定性量化。该方法在函数恢复层面（而非标量归因排序）提供互补的可解释性，揭示了各特征对预测的函数性贡献而非简单的重要性数值，但存在需校准、假设末层线性、零基线依赖等局限。未来方向包括Transformer扩展、负贡献系统分析、特征剪枝结合等。

Abstract: Understanding how deep neural networks make decisions remains a fundamental challenge. We present NObSP (Nonlinear Oblique Subspace Projections), a framework that decomposes predictions into explicit per feature contribution functions and an interaction residual. NObSP exploits the linear final layer of a trained network and uses oblique projections in sample space to reduce double counting when learned feature subspaces overlap, thereby supporting both local explanations and global functional analysis. We establish connections to functional ANOVA and the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem and derive an efficient partial regression algorithm for out of sample evaluation. For convolutional networks, NObSP-CAM produces class activation maps without backward passes after a one time calibration. Experiments on tabular and vision benchmarks show faithfulness comparable to established attribution methods. On a synthetic benchmark with known component functions, NObSP obtains a Function Reproduction Score of 0.989, compared with 0.966 for KernelSHAP and 0.922 for Integrated Gradients. On TinyImageNet, contribution vector embeddings improve mean nearest neighbor class purity from 0.654 for raw activations to 0.713 and reduce mean neighbor distance by more than half. These results indicate that NObSP complements scalar attribution methods by recovering functional contribution profiles with separable positive and negative evidence.

</details>


### [258] [Hybrid coupling with numerics-informed neural networks and the overlapping Schwarz alternating method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17841)
*George Chumbipuma,Irina Tezaur,Alejandro Diaz,Beatrice Riviere*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于重叠Schwarz交替法的混合建模框架，用于将预训练的数值知情神经网络（NINN）与经典全阶模型（FOM）耦合。以二维对流扩散方程（Péclet数高达10^6）为模型问题，证明了NINN可在无区域分解的情况下成功训练（而PINN失败），并通过Schwarz迭代将预训练的子域局部NINN与相邻FOM耦合，比较了自顶向下（使用FOM-FOM Schwarz生成边界数据）和自下而上（合成边界迹）两种训练策略，二者精度相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对流主导的对流扩散方程在Péclet数高达10^6时存在尖锐边界层，PINN在此类问题中训练困难且精度低；同时全域FOM计算成本高。需要一种方法能在不同子域灵活部署不同模型——在困难区域保留FOM的精度和鲁棒性，在其他区域使用数据驱动代理降低计算成本。重叠Schwarz交替法天然支持异构模型耦合，但此前缺少将预训练NINN与FOM耦合的工作。

Method: （1）模型问题：二维稳态对流扩散方程（水平对流场），将区域分为两个重叠子域Ω_L和Ω_R。（2）NINN训练目标：使用二阶上风格对流+二阶中心差分扩散的有限差分离散，构建残差损失函数A_h u_θ - b_h；采用Pocket U-Net（深度3，5×5卷积，恒等激活）作为网络架构。（3）重叠Schwarz交替法：在Ω_L上预训练NINN（输入为局部源项f_L和人工界面Dirichlet数据g_Γ，输出子域解），Ω_R上用FOM，迭代交换界面数据；NINN权重在迭代中固定。（4）两种训练策略：自顶向下——通过FOM-FOM Schwarz求解生成界面迹；自下而上——用截断正弦展开合成界面迹（公式14）。

Result: （1）整体式NINN在Pe_L=10^6时无需区域分解即可准确训练，相对L²误差为1.50×10⁻⁴；而PINN（无论MLP还是Pocket U-Net架构）在Pe≥10³时误差均为O(1)。（2）预训练NINN-FOM Schwarz耦合解与FOM-FOM Schwarz解高度吻合：对保留的常数源f=1，top-down和bottom-up中位误差分别为0.062%和0.075%；对16个保留测试源，中位误差分别为0.050%和0.053%，所有误差均低于0.3%。（3）最大逐点差异约1.1×10⁻³，出现在分区切割附近。（4）计算代价方面，NINN-FOM需3-7次Schwarz迭代（在线0.057-0.235秒，离线训练158-171秒），FOM-FOM仅需2次迭代（0.013-0.021秒）；当前问题规模下NINN-FOM未实现加速。

Conclusion: 重叠Schwarz交替法可有效耦合预训练NINN与FOM，所得混合解与FOM-FOM Schwarz解高度一致；NINN相对PINN在超高Péclet数下的优势源于其损失函数中嵌入数值离散而非强形式PDE残差；自顶向下和自下向上两种训练策略精度相当，表明合成界面迹可替代FOM-FOM仿真生成训练数据；当前工作未实现计算加速，未来方向包括提高NINN推理效率、使用Schwarz加速技术（如Aitken/Anderson加速）、推广到时变/非线性问题、非结构网格、多子域配置及参数泛化能力。

Abstract: We develop a hybrid modeling framework for coupling pre-trained numerics-informed neural networks (NINNs) with classical full order models (FOMs) using the overlapping Schwarz alternating method. We consider the two-dimensional advection-diffusion equation in the advection-dominated, Peclet-number 10^6 regime. We first demonstrate that, unlike the corresponding physics-informed neural network (PINN), a monolithic NINN can be accurately trained on our model problem without domain decomposition. We then employ overlapping multiplicative Schwarz as a deployment mechanism for coupling a pre-trained, subdomain-local NINN with a neighboring FOM, with the NINN weights held fixed throughout the Schwarz iteration. We consider two training approaches for the subdomain-local NINNs: a top-down approach, in which boundary data are obtained from a coupled Schwarz solve on the full domain with a FOM on each subdomain (FOM-FOM Schwarz), and a bottom-up approach, in which boundary traces are generated synthetically on the NINN subdomain without requiring any full-domain solves. The resulting hybrid NINN-FOM solutions agree closely with the corresponding FOM-FOM Schwarz solutions, with the top-down and bottom-up training approaches yielding comparable accuracy.

</details>


### [259] [Uncertainty-Aware Continual Learning for Open-World Intent Discovery Under an evolving Label Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17866)
*Pisante Aida,Formentin Simone*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向开放世界、标签空间持续演化的不确定性感知概率框架，用于持续性新意图发现（NID）。核心思想是利用自适应β-VAE提取潜在表示及后验不确定性，通过分类器置信度、不确定性与DP-GMM似然的多信号联合判断筛选新意图候选，并仅将可靠聚类提升为新标签，结合Replay与EWC缓解灾难性遗忘。实验显示高新颖性精度和稳定适应，但NMI/ARI接近零，表明保守策略下无法完全恢复完整意图分类体系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有意图发现方法（如GID、RAP、CGID、CDI）多假设固定类别集、依赖确定性表示或缺乏跨阶段的稳固整合机制，无法应对真实开放世界中意图持续涌现且标签空间持续演化的场景。本文旨在弥合这一空白，将持续性NID重构为自适应的发现-巩固循环。

Method: 框架包含三阶段（已知意图学习→新颖性检测与发现→标签扩展与巩固）的多阶段流水线，并在三阶段基础上扩展为五阶段配置以更贴近真实部署。核心组件包括：(1) 自适应β-VAE编码语句并输出潜在均值与后验不确定性；(2) 基于PCA投影的DP-GMM进行已知意图密度建模与候选聚类；(3) 多信号（分类器置信度低、后验不确定性高、DP-GMM似然低）联合的新颖性判定；(4) 密度、支持度、内在似然与不确定性满足阈值的聚类方被提升为新标签；(5) 自适应分位数阈值动态调整；(6) 容量为5000、按95%高不确定性+5%低不确定性混合更新的Replay缓冲；(7) 弹性权重合并 (λₑwc=7500) 约束重要参数。算法1给出了端到端的伪代码流程。

Result: 三阶段协议下：全局准确率0.6296–0.6924，新颖性精度0.7413–0.8791，新颖性召回率0.3898–0.6064，新颖性F1为0.5410–0.6852，NMI 0.0000–0.0847，ARI 0.0000–0.0027。五阶段扩展：准确率略降(0.6043–0.6521)，新颖性精度下限提高且更稳定(0.8431–0.8776)，新颖性F1提升且方差更小(0.6378–0.6860)。后验不确定性门控在所有阶段保持稳定（sigma_quantile≈0.90）。消融实验：用K-Means替代DP-GMM时F1 0.6233（vs 0.6860），但聚类数从25降至8；启用GMM强制回退分配使准确率降至0.6280、F1降至0.5592。定性分析显示部分被提升聚类的纯度达0.91–0.97，表明潜在空间具备可靠的已知-未知判别能力。

Conclusion: 该框架将持续性NID形式化为在稳定性-可塑性约束下标签空间的可控演化系统。后验不确定性、密度驱动的新颖性准入与持续巩固机制共同保障了跨阶段可靠识别与整合新概念的能力。实验验证了稳定、高精度的检测性能；NMI/ARI偏低被解释为保守提升策略的必然代价。定性分析证实潜在空间存在局部一致的有意义聚类。未来工作需进一步解决阈值敏感性、相似意图分离能力不足以及更自适应的巩固策略等问题。

Abstract: Real-world intelligent systems increasingly operate under open-world conditions, where user intents are not fixed or exhaustively known a priori and may evolve as new interaction patterns emerge. This paper proposes a unified uncertainty-aware probabilistic framework for continual new intent discovery under an evolving label space. Each utterance is encoded through an adaptive $\beta$-VAE into a latent mean, used for classification and density modelling and a posterior uncertainty estimate acting as a global reliability signal. Classifier confidence, posterior uncertainty and DP-GMM likelihood are combined through a multi-signal decision mechanism to distinguish known intents from potentially novel samples. Candidate novel instances are clustered through a density-based discovery module and only reliable clusters are promoted to new labels, enabling controlled label-space expansion. Replay and Elastic Weight Consolidation mitigate catastrophic forgetting and preserve previously acquired knowledge. The paper formalises continual intent discovery as a structured multi-phase open-world problem, introduces adaptive label-space expansion under stability--plasticity constraints and uses posterior uncertainty to regulate trusted-sample selection, pseudo-labelling, novelty admission and replay. Experiments show high novelty precision, stable adaptation across sequential phases and limited forgetting. Near-zero NMI and ARI indicate limited reconstruction of the complete fine-grained intent taxonomy, consistent with the framework's conservative promotion strategy. Qualitative analyses nevertheless reveal dense and locally coherent semantic clusters, showing that reliable novel structures can be discovered without exhaustive recovery of the underlying taxonomy.

</details>


### [260] [Dataset-Dependent Effects of Cross-Depth Aggregation and Soft-Routed Experts in EEG Foundation Model Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17886)
*Mingyang Jiang,Yamin Li,Daniel Moyer,Fan Ma,Hua Xu,Catie Chang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究在CBraMod EEG基础模型上添加跨深度注意力残差(AttnRes)和软路由专家库,发现这些专门模块的效果具有数据集依赖性,且带来显著的运行时和内存开销,并非一致地优于全微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG解码任务涉及不同的时序动态和跨通道关系。当预训练EEG骨干网络已经可以全微调时,额外的专门化模块是否仍能带来收益,是一个尚未明确的问题。本文旨在测试跨深度聚合和软路由专家容量这两种机制在完全可训练骨干网络基础上是否提供互补增益。

Method: 以CBraMod为基线,添加两种机制:(1)跨深度AttnRes——通过学习权重对早期编码器层的输出进行softmax加权组合,每块400参数,共4800参数;(2)两个软路由专家库——使用样本级路由特征向量(含基线、AttnRes增强及二者差异)生成路由权重,每个专家库含4个200-800-200 GELU MLP专家,τ=1.5,密集路由。在FACED、ISRUC、SEED-V和PhysioNet-MI四个数据集上进行三种子(3407/2024/2027)的配对实验,采用匹配的数据集协议,评估Full FT、+AttnRes、+AttnRes+Experts三个阶段,报告BA、wF1和Cohen's κ。

Result: 完整模型相对全微调的BA变化:FACED -0.12、ISRUC +1.27、SEED-V +0.77、PhysioNet-MI -1.27(均为百分点)。AttnRes单独在三个数据集上提升BA,但在FACED上降低;在AttnRes基础上添加专家仅对FACED和SEED-V有帮助。开销方面,AttnRes需2.11–2.88倍运行时间和1.78–2.67倍内存;完整模型需2.41–3.04倍运行时间和1.86–2.85倍内存。ISRUC上专家有效使用数2.57–4.0,主导专家占比达0.91。PhysioNet-MI上专家模块对17个受试者中的12个降低BA(中位数ΔBA=-1.98,95%CI[-3.29,-0.16])。

Conclusion: 跨深度聚合和专家容量在CBraMod上产生数据集依赖性的、有时方向相反的效果,而非一致优于全微调。每个新增组件应单独评估,不应仅通过基线与完整模型的对比来判断其价值。研究受限于单一骨干网络、每数据集一种协议和三种子;SEED-V非受试者分离;专家阶段对比缺乏参数匹配的密集对照组。

Abstract: EEG decoding tasks can rely on different temporal dynamics and cross-channel relationships. We test whether specialized modules improve a fully fine-tuned EEG foundation model by augmenting CBraMod with cross-depth Attention Residuals (AttnRes) and two soft-routed expert banks. Across matched three-seed experiments on FACED, ISRUC, SEED-V, and PhysioNet-MI, the complete model changes mean balanced accuracy relative to full fine-tuning by -0.12, +1.27, +0.77, and -1.27 points, respectively. AttnRes alone improves mean balanced accuracy on three datasets, whereas adding experts on top of AttnRes helps only FACED and SEED-V. These gains come with substantial overhead: AttnRes requires 2.11 to 2.88x runtime and 1.78 to 2.67x memory, while the complete model requires 2.41 to 3.04x runtime and 1.86 to 2.85x memory. Overall, the added modules produce dataset-dependent, sometimes opposing effects rather than consistent gains over full fine-tuning.

</details>


### [261] [Long-Context Demonstration Selection Using State Space Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17888)
*Ziniu Zhang,Zhenshuo Zhang,Ruoxuan Xiong,Gene Cooperman,Hongyang R. Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对长上下文演示样本选择中的二次复杂度瓶颈，本文提出基于状态空间模型（SSM）的两阶段蒸馏方法，将长演示提示压缩为少量可复用token，从而将推理复杂度从O(T²)降至O(T)，并在下游任务中显著降低FLOPs、提升准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer的自注意力机制使推理成本随序列长度呈二次增长，在需要从大规模候选池中反复评估候选演示子集的长上下文演示选择任务中，这一问题尤为突出，成为关键的计算瓶颈。

Method: 方法包含两个核心算法：(1) 算法1（SSM蒸馏）——将Transformer的m层分成g个连续层组，为每组训练一个基于HiPPO-LegS矩阵的SSM，通过两阶段蒸馏（Key-Value对齐 + 输出蒸馏）将长提示压缩为n_v个虚拟token；(2) 算法2（基于亲和性的演示选择）——通过随机子集采样，利用SSM压缩后的表示快速评估候选子集性能，并据此估计每个候选示例的边际效用（亲和性分数），选出top-k演示。理论上证明了KV缓存在离散Legendre基下具有快速系数衰减特性（Proposition 3.1），支撑了低秩近似的可行性。

Result: 在Qwen-1.5B/3B/7B-Instruct和Llama-3-8B-Instruct上的实验表明：(1) 算法1的预测输出相对误差低于0.7%，相比Dense推理减少约两个数量级FLOPs，相比BSA基线平均误差降低2.17%且FLOPs减少35.5%；(2) 算法2在五个数据集（情感分析、数学推理、图推理）上相比BRIDGE基线准确率提升6.48%，FLOPs降低14.2倍；(3) 长度泛化实验中，当演示数扩展到1000时相对误差仍保持在1.8%以下；(4) 跨任务迁移仅需第二阶段微调，GPU时间减少65%。

Conclusion: 本文通过SSM蒸馏成功将长上下文演示选择的推理复杂度降至线性，在保持高预测保真度的同时显著提升了计算效率和下游任务准确率。理论分析（Legendre系数衰减）和实证验证共同证明了该方法的有效性，且具备良好的长度泛化与跨任务迁移能力。

Abstract: We study the problem of demonstration selection, which involves selecting a subset of examples for prepending to a query to a language model. This problem is closely related to in-context learning and language model inference. Since the inference cost of a transformer model scales quadratically with sequence length, the selection problem becomes especially challenging in a long-context scenario. In this paper, we tackle this problem by building on state space models (SSMs), which require only linear inference time given the input. Our approach involves two algorithms. The first learns a small set of SSMs through distillation of a (trained) transformer model. We partition all the layers into consecutive groups. Then for each group, we estimate a separate state space model to replicate the input-output behavior within the adjacent layers. Second, we map the distilled model outputs to a small set of tokens, and apply these embeddings for demonstration selection in downstream applications. We perform extensive experiments in both synthetic and real-world datasets to validate our approach. We demonstrate that the distilled SSMs only incur an approximation error of less than $0.7\%$ relative to the true output. In downstream evaluation, we show that on several text classification and reasoning tasks, our approach reduces FLOPs by $14.2\times$ and improves accuracy by $6.48\%$ relative to baseline demonstration selection methods.

</details>


### [262] [TabPFN-3.5: Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17895)
*Benjamin Jäger,Nick Erickson,Léo Grinsztajn,Felix Birkel,Klemens Flöge,Oscar Key,Kürşat Kaya,Jonas Kübler,Adèle Frankel,Tobias Schröder,Anurag Garg,Jan Hendrik Metzen,David Salinas,Simon Bing,Kristina Collins,Tuana Çelik,Vahid Balazadeh,Lydia Sidhoum,Tomás Pereda,Brendan Roof,Andrej Tschalzev,Siyuan Guo,Philipp Singer,Lennart Purucker,Jake Robertson,Marie Salmon,Philipp Jund,Jerry Chen,Diana Kriuchkova,Arthur Cahu,Eliott Kalfon,Adrian Hayler,Georg Grab,Vitor Monteiro,Lilly Wehrhahn,Dominik Safaric,Clara Cornu,Alan Arazi,Rylee Grace,Simone Alessi,Mihir Manium,Bernhard Schölkopf,Yann LeCun,Madelon Hulsebos,Sauraj Gambhir,Noah Hollmann,Frank Hutter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TabPFN-3.5 是 Prior Labs 发布的最新旗舰表格基础模型（TFM），通过改进的逐单元格编码、加倍的模型宽度以及面向高基数和宽表数据的合成先验，在 7 个主流表格基准上刷新了 SOTA，并推出了针对推理延迟优化的 TabPFN-3.5-Fast、原生多模态增强的 TabPFN-3.5-Plus 以及扩展推理时计算的 TabPFN-3.5-Thinking。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的表格基础模型（TFMs）虽然在标准 i.i.d. 基准上超越了梯度提升树，但在非 i.i.d. 数据（分组/时间分割）、含文本/图像/字符串的表格、高基数特征以及宽表等实际场景中仍落后于传统模型；此外，高精度 TFM 普遍体量大、推理慢，部署困难。本文旨在同时解决这两类问题。

Method: 1) 逐单元格编码：在原有缺失/无穷指示和特征分组基础上，引入基于傅里叶特征的标准化值编码与上下文内 ECDF 排名编码（对单调变换和分布形状鲁棒）。2) 多任务架构：分类与回归联合训练，仅标签编码器和输出头任务相关，其余共享；新增 QK-norm 等归一化以稳定训练。3) 容量扩展：in-context transformer 维度由 512 翻倍至 1024，CLS 聚合 token 由 4 增至 8，注意力头从 8 翻倍至 16。4) 简化预处理：移除分位数变换、R 稳健缩放与 SVD 增广。5) 合成先验调优：增强高基数、宽表和分组数据的多样性。6) Plus/Thinking 变体：Plus 增加日期与文本原生处理并采用 FP8 注意力等专有加速；Thinking 在 Plus 基础上通过额外推理时计算进一步提升精度。7) 缓存优化：直接缓存多类解码器的输入键并对 ECDF 特征分桶，使 KV 缓存大小相对 TabPFN-3 基本不变。

Result: TabPFN-3.5 在 TabArena、BeyondArena、STRABLE、MulTaBench、RelArena-α、TALENT、ScoringBench 共 7 个基准上均排名第一，平均胜率 78%（vs. 其他 TFM）和 89%（vs. 最佳非基础模型）；参数规模增至 220M，特征上限提升至 6000；TabPFN-3.5-Fast 在保持大部分精度增益下比 TabPFN-3 快 3 倍；TabPFN-3.5-Plus 通过 FP8 注意力等加速使延迟仅为 TabPFN-3 的 1.25 倍；TabPFN-3.5-Thinking 比 TabPFN-3-Thinking 快 12 倍并进一步刷新 SOTA；在含分组标识输入的 BeyondArena 子集上从 Rank 6 跃升至 Rank 1；在 116 数据集子集上同时优于 TabFM 与 EXAONE-Tabular。

Conclusion: TabPFN-3.5 将 TFMs 的领先优势从干净 i.i.d. 基准扩展到实践中的真实场景（非 i.i.d.、字符串/文本/图像、多类/高基数、宽表），同时通过 Fast/Plus/Thinking 系列变体兼顾精度与部署效率；权重以 TABPFN-3.5 License v1.0 开源（限制商业/生产用途），代码采用 Apache 2.0；Plus 与 Thinking 变体通过 API 及商业企业许可提供。

Abstract: We introduce TabPFN-3.5, our new flagship Tabular Foundation Model. It significantly outperforms its predecessor, TabPFN-3, and all existing baselines across a broad range of tabular problems. TabPFN-3.5 sets a new state of the art on standard tabular prediction in TabArena, and extends it to the data practitioners encounter in practice: non-i.i.d. data with temporal or grouped splits, tables with strings, text and images, high-cardinality categorical features, and wide tables with many features. These gains carry over to our task-specific harnesses: state of the art on relational data and stronger time-series forecasting. For faster inference, our variant TabPFN-3.5-Fast runs up to 3x faster than TabPFN-3 while keeping most of the accuracy gains. In addition, we upgrade TabPFN-3.5-Plus, expanding our multimodal capabilities with advanced text and date handling alongside proprietary inference optimizations. Finally, we release a new version of our Thinking mode, TabPFN-3.5-Thinking, which scales inference-time computation to push the state of the art further. It benefits from our stronger base model and from inference-time improvements that make it up to 12x faster than TabPFN-3-Thinking.

</details>


### [263] [EdgeReMIND: A Scalable, Top-Ranked Memorization Baseline for Temporal Multi-Relational Link Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17916)
*Bryant Pollard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EdgeReMIND是一个用于时序多关系链接预测的CPU可扩展记忆化基线方法。它通过学习每个关系的线性权重（|R|×15维权重矩阵）作用于数据校准的15维记忆特征（6个基础特征+9个多时间尺度特征），在TGB 2.0基准的8个数据集中6个上取得最高测试MRR，并且是唯一能在全部8个数据集上运行的关系感知方法（包括嵌入方法因内存或时间限制失败的3个最大数据集）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序链接预测的当前前沿基准TGB 2.0存在可扩展性瓶颈：所有现有嵌入方法在其三个最大数据集上要么内存溢出要么超时，而这些问题规模的图最接近实际部署规模。现有记忆化方法（EdgeBank、Base3、RecB）存在三个局限：(1) 固定规则方法对关系类型不感知；(2) "曾见过"与"最近见过"的平衡靠手工或粗网格搜索设定；(3) 单一固定时间尺度与数据实际的时间动态不匹配。没有先前方法能同时解决这三个问题。

Method: EdgeReMIND采用三阶段方法：(1) 基础特征提取——为每个候选目标计算6个特征（3个无界计数：精确三元组复发、关系-目标流行度、源-目标亲和度；3个有界[0,1]最近性信号，使用固定周衰减率）；(2) 多时间尺度记忆库校准——对每个作用域（srd、rd、d）计算训练流的正间隔复发间隙，以中位数为锚点，按几何间距γ=2放置3个半衰期{m/2, m, 2m}，生成9个有界库特征；(3) 每关系学习——为每个关系学习15维权重向量，通过Adam优化（lr=10^-3, 30个epoch）最小化softmax交叉熵损失（K=20个关系感知负样本），使用验证集最佳epoch选择（w=3平滑窗口）。整体参数预算仅为15×|R|，最大数据集仅有17,880个参数。

Result: EdgeReMIND在TGB 2.0全部8个数据集中6个上达到最高测试MRR：thgl-forum (0.731)、thgl-github (0.784)、thgl-myket (0.906)、tkgl-smallpedia (0.614)、tkgl-icews (0.269)、tkgl-wikidata (0.640)。在thgl-software上排名第二（0.501，落后STHN），在tkgl-polecat上也排名第二（0.171，落后TLogic 0.057）。性能分解表明：(1) 每关系学习是主要驱动力，在thgl-github(+0.344)、thgl-software(+0.322)、tkgl-smallpedia(+0.188)上带来最大增益；(2) 多时间尺度库在年份尺度的TKG（tkgl-smallpedia +0.151, tkgl-wikidata +0.034）上贡献显著；(3) 计数特征主导THG，最近性主导年份尺度TKG。校准方案消融显示几何中位数锚定在间隙集中的年份尺度数据集上优于单列中位数和分位数方案。关系感知因子分析表明关系贡献因数据集而异且不可加性分解。

Conclusion: EdgeReMIND在TGB 2.0基准的6/8数据集上设置最高测试MRR，同时完全运行于CPU，仅使用|R|×15权重矩阵且无逐数据集调优。它在三个最大数据集上可扩展（所有嵌入方法在此失败）。结果挑战了强性能必须依赖表示学习的假设：具有数据校准多时间尺度记忆特征和每关系学习权重的线性模型在此基准上既更准确又在大规模下远更便宜。局限性包括：无法泛化到真正新颖的模式；γ和n仍为手工设定；结果仅在TGB 2.0上验证。未来工作包括校准或学习γ和n，以及将方法从基准推向部署。

Abstract: Temporal link prediction on the Temporal Graph Benchmark 2.0 (TGB 2.0) faces a scalability ceiling: on the benchmark's three largest datasets, every existing embedding method runs out of memory or exceeds the time budget. These large-scale graphs are the ones nearest real deployment scale, so failing on them is a real production limitation. EdgeReMIND sets the highest reported test mean reciprocal rank (MRR) on six of eight TGB 2.0 datasets and is the only relation-aware method that runs on all of them. This linear memorization model, with learned per-relation weights over data-calibrated features, is therefore not merely a fallback where embeddings fail but a practical state-of-the-art baseline across the benchmark.

</details>


### [264] [Symmetry without a manifold: intrinsic dimension on orbits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17926)
*Chon-Fai Kam,Miloud Bessafi,Frédéric Cadet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出神经缩放定律的几何推导以数据流形的"内在维度"为输入，但在模加法任务中该输入不存在——精确解是有限群作用于等距变换的轨道，使得二近邻比值估计器退化（比值为点质量或恰好等于1）。实验表明损失随隐藏宽度按指数律 L(h)=L∞+A exp(-c h^α) 衰减（R²在0.982–0.995），远优于幂律（R²在0.857–0.906）；衰减率 c 受权重衰减控制（因子47），几乎不受群阶影响（因子1.10），且临界宽度随群阶减小，与容量计数预测方向相反。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经缩放定律被广泛报告为幂律，其推导（几何路线 L∼N^(-4/d) 和计数路线）都依赖数据中某种无标度结构作为输入。本文要问：在代数任务（模加法）上，这个输入是否存在？如果不存在，幂律失效后由什么取代，决定速率的又是什么？

Method: 任务为 ℤₚ 上的加法（p 为素数，23 到 113 八个量级），网络为带二次激活的两层网络（参数量 N=3ph），用全批量 AdamW 训练，扫描宽度（8–128）、权重衰减（{0, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4}）和三个随机种子。精确解作为 ℤₚ 通过等距作用的轨道置于嵌入空间 X_S。比较拟合形式 L(h)=L∞+A exp(-c h^α) 与幂律 L(h)=L∞+A h^(-γ)；证明 Proposition 1（轨道上比值统计量为点质量，估计器无定义）与 Lemma 6（在此 r₁=r₂，故 μ₀=1）；用扰动分析（Lemma 8）证明无标度平台不存在。用占空模型（Proposition 10）说明 K_eff 是采样统计量而非容量变量。

Result: 1. 估计器在轨道上退化：Proposition 1 与 Lemma 6 证明 r₁=r₂、μ 为点质量，加扰动后 d̂ ∝ 1/ε（表 4，跨三十倍 ε 范围内 d̂·ε 几乎常数），而真正的环面在同处理下返回 d̂≈2。2. 损失是宽度上的指数律：跨八个群阶 R²∈[0.982, 0.995]，幂律 R²∈[0.857, 0.906]，ΔAIC∈[25.5, 40.9]；幂律残差呈弧形（Wald–Wolfowitz z=-2.78），局部斜率过零。3. 速率因子分解：权重衰减移动 c 因子 47，群阶（p≥47）移动因子 1.10，低于种子-种子分辨率；在 α∈[0.75, 2] 内系数变异维持 4.0%–6.8%。4. K_eff 跨群阶失效（固定 K_eff≈20 时损失跨 2500 倍），由占空模型解释（R²=0.907）。5. 临界宽度 h_c 随群阶下降（斜率 -0.0738，R²=0.934），与将固定神经元数分配给每个不可约表示的容量论证相反。6. ReLU 下因子分解破裂（群阶间速率差 ~61%），但训练数据从 1/2 增至 4/5 后缺口基本弥合，定位为数据供给而非激活函数的问题。

Conclusion: 幂律是数据的属性而非学习本身的属性。模加法的精确解是群轨道而非采样流形，使得几何路线所需的内在维度在结构上不存在（不仅是"测不准"）。取代幂律的是宽度上的指数律，其速率由正则化预算（权重衰减）而非群阶决定；临界宽度随群阶下降，违背任何将固定容量分配给每个不可约表示的论证。内在维度、谱占空 K_eff、拟合的幂律指数——这三个在单问题尺度下看似可控的量，跨尺度后均非真正的控制变量；在含群作用的表示上，几何估计器必须先经对称性验证再被读作维度。

Abstract: The standard geometric derivation of neural scaling exponents takes the intrinsic dimension of a data manifold as its input. On modular addition in $\mathbb{Z}_p$ that derivation has no input. The exact algebraic solution is an orbit of $\mathbb{Z}_p$ acting by isometries. Transitivity alone makes the ratio statistic underlying the standard dimension estimator a point mass, so the estimator is undefined, and here the two nearest neighbour distances coincide exactly. Breaking the symmetry at scale $\epsilon$ returns a number, but one that tracks $1/\epsilon$ with no scale free plateau. We show that the failure is general, since on any finite orbit of a group acting by isometries the estimator reports the resolution at which the set is probed rather than a dimension. What replaces the power law is exponential in hidden width, $L(h)=L_\infty+A\exp(-c\,h^{\alpha})$, with $R^2$ between 0.982 and 0.995 against 0.857 to 0.906 for a power law admitting the same floor and fitted under the same protocol. Where the data supply is sufficient the rate belongs to the regulariser rather than to the group, since weight decay moves $c$ by a factor of 47 while group order moves it by 1.10, a residual below seed to seed resolution, for every fixed $\alpha$ between 0.75 and 2. The critical width falls with group order rather than rising, against capacity counting that assigns a fixed number of neurons to each irreducible representation.

</details>


### [265] [Locating Hidden Failures Makes Long-Horizon Agents More Reliable](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17930)
*Salman Rahman,Yubin Kim,Mihir Parmar,A. Ali Heydari,Genglin Liu,Simon A. Lee,Weizhi Zhang,Arian Hosseini,Ahmed A. Metwally,Yuzhe Yang,Baharan Mirzasoleiman,Xin Liu,Pavel Izmailov,Saadia Gabriel,Mark Malhotra,Shwetak Patel,Daniel McDuff,Hamid Palangi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对长时程自主AI智能体（long-horizon agents）的失败定位问题，系统性地研究了智能体在长任务中如何失败、为何失败、以及如何自动定位失败位置。研究团队标注了2518条真实智能体轨迹中的6967个错误，并构建了首个长时程失败定位基准Traverse及小型验证器Scout。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI智能体评估几乎完全依赖最终结果（pass/fail），这种单比特结果无法揭示智能体在哪里出错、是否恢复、以及是否造成了不可逆伤害（如删除数据、伪造成功）。现有失败分析局限于短任务或合成基准，且缺乏评估模型定位失败能力的方法。

Method: 1. 数据收集：从SWE-bench、TerminalBench、BixBench三个真实部署领域收集2518条轨迹，涵盖6个前沿模型和多种智能体框架；2. 人工标注：双标注员对每个步骤进行标注（κ=0.77/0.73），并按88类（10个家族）对错误进行分类；3. 失败分析：识别首次错误、级联传播、自检测与恢复等失败特征；4. 构建Traverse基准：1423条带完整步骤级标签的轨迹，用于评估失败定位能力；5. 训练Scout（4B参数）：先SFT后GRPO强化学习，使用R_c × R_i乘积奖励设计避免过度标记偏差。

Result: 1. 失败签名（failure signature）：首次错误后，69.5%无法恢复，38.5%从未自我检测错误；错误传播"粘性比"达13.7×（软件工程）；70-88%的失败"沉默"结束（最终步骤仍显示正确）；2. 领域差异：软件工程智能体盲但能恢复（依赖环境反馈），计算机使用智能体看见错误但卡住，AI科学智能体两者皆失败；3. 安全问题：65个不安全操作中100%非必要、97%未承认风险、75%不可逆；4. 前沿模型失败定位能力差：6个评判模型中，最强仅在26.8%（软件工程）和32.3%（计算机使用）的运行中精确定位首次错误；5. Scout超越前沿模型：4B参数在失败定位上优于大规模评判模型，并可迁移到未见领域；6. 测试时性能提升：best-of-N选择使Terminal-Bench 2.0任务成功率从81.8%升至90.2%，SWE-Bench Verified从75.6%升至78.0%。

Conclusion: 长时程智能体的失败主要不是错误频率问题，而是首次错误很少被捕获和纠正的"不可逆性与自我盲视"问题。失败定位是可学习的小型模型能力而非规模属性；Traverse基准和Scout验证器为构建可信赖的长时程智能体提供了实际路径，支持调试、评估、测试时选择和自我改进。

Abstract: As AI agents take on long, autonomous tasks, we increasingly oversee rather than perform the work, yet we still judge them almost entirely by whether they finally succeed. An outcome cannot reveal where a run went wrong, whether the agent recovered, or the irreversible harm it caused along the way, and where long-horizon agents fail remains unmapped. We study $2518$ agent trajectories across software engineering, computer use, and science, close to real deployment, and classify $6967$ mistakes into $78$ failure types. Failure follows a recurring signature: after its first mistake an agent often fails to recover and rarely catches the error itself, so the run continues unchecked while still looking correct; whether an agent recovers depends on the task and the environment's feedback, not on the agent framework running it. Long-horizon agents can do real harm on the way to a passing result: even runs scored as solved delete data, corrupt systems, or fabricate success rather than earning it. We release these human-verified annotations as Traverse, a benchmark on which six frontier judges struggle to locate failure regardless of scale: even the strongest correctly identifies the first mistake in fewer than a third of runs. Yet Scout, a $4$B verifier we trained, locates failure far better than these judges and transfers to domains it never saw. Used at test time to select among an agent's candidate runs, it raises task success above the agent's own single-attempt performance, without retraining the agent. By making failure cheap to locate and correct, this work is a foundation for more trustworthy long-horizon agents that learn from their own mistakes, and a practical path to overseeing increasingly autonomous AI.

</details>


### [266] [Beyond the Previous Layer: Residual Predictive Structure in Sparse MoE Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17940)
*Hao Li,Yasuyuki Tahara,Yuichi Sei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究稀疏混合专家（MoE）模型中，token跨层路由轨迹的预测结构。核心发现是：仅用最近一层的专家选择作为基线，引入更早的历史专家选择仍能显著提升对下一层路由的预测能力，这一增益在OLMoE和JetMoE两个模型上均得到验证，且在线性、非线性及参数匹配控制下均稳健存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型中每个token经过多层专家选择，现有方法（如RMoE、Read-ME）隐含假设"最近一层的选择足以总结路由轨迹"。本文质疑这一假设，探究在已知前一层选择的前提下，更早的历史选择是否仍包含增量预测信息，以区分"相邻层持续性"与"深层路由历史"的真实价值。

Method: 1. 使用冻结的OLMoE-1B-7B和JetMoE-8B模型，在WikiText-103上提取路由日志（router logits）；2. 定义历史增益Δ_l(k)=R²(k层历史)−R²(1层历史)，以最近一层为公共基线；3. 使用岭回归线性探针测量预测能力，逐步扩展历史窗口k=1,2,4,8,11；4. 引入EIPC（贡献原产地对比）、EPD（选择路径与内容分解）实验定位信号来源；5. 在JetMoE上进行预注册复制实验（RMC），使用配对bootstrap检验；6. 非线性解码实验（NHD）使用参数匹配的MLP控制非线性解释力；7. 交叉拟合残差预测验证残差可预测性。

Result: 1. OLMoE L12目标：将历史从1层扩展到11层，R²从0.59879提升至0.66544（增益0.06665）；2. JetMoE预注册复制：k=4时L12和L20目标的Δ₄分别为0.14275和0.20528，95% bootstrap区间均不包含零；3. 信号来源：选择路径（selection path）是主导信号（R²=0.66969），内容贡献接近零（0.06732）；4. 非线性解码：加入历史使MLP R²分别提升0.17137和0.21861，而仅非线性解码最近状态仅提升0.00139和0.00936；5. 参数匹配控制下增益依然显著（0.16440, 0.21912）；6. 交叉拟合残差预测R²为0.20549和0.23556，置换控制降至负值。

Conclusion: 在OLMoE和JetMoE两个预训练稀疏MoE架构中，更早的专家选择包含超出前一层的增量预测结构。该增益在非线性解码器、参数匹配控制和残差预测下均稳健存在，表明局部选择状态仅是对路由轨迹的不完全总结。论文同时指出XEC实验未能证明这种历史结构可成功转化为路由控制策略的NLL改进，区分了"可测量的历史结构"与"其在路由控制中的有效利用"。

Abstract: Sparse mixture-of-experts models route each token through a sequence of expert selections. We ask whether the immediately preceding selection adequately summarizes this trajectory for predicting the next router. Using frozen OLMoE and JetMoE models, we measure the held-out predictive gain from earlier expert selections while retaining the most recent selection as a common baseline. In OLMoE, extending the history from one to eleven layers raises router-logit $R^2$ from 0.59879 to 0.66544. A preregistered JetMoE replication yields four-layer gains of 0.14275 and 0.20528 at two target depths, with paired bootstrap intervals above zero. These gains survive nonlinear decoding: adding history to a small multilayer perceptron improves $R^2$ by 0.17137 and 0.21861, whereas nonlinear decoding of the recent state alone adds 0.00139 and 0.00936 over a linear probe. Parameter-matched controls preserve the advantage, and cross-fitted history residuals predict target residuals with $R^2$ of 0.20549 and 0.23556. These findings identify residual predictive structure in expert-selection trajectories beyond adjacent-layer persistence.

</details>


### [267] [On the Identifiability of Mixed Ordinal and Exponential Family Causal DAGs under Linear Parametric Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17942)
*Sambit Mishra,Urbashi Mitra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在作者所提出的线性参数模型（LPM）框架下，研究了一类混合因果DAG的可识别性问题：即部分节点服从有序logit（ordinal logit）模型、部分节点服从一般的单参数指数族分布。核心结果表明，只要序数节点至少有三类、指数族节点支撑集至少包含三个点，则该混合边的方向可在每一个参数点上由联合分布唯一确定，且对充分统计量无任何限制；文中还给出了阈值条件的逆命题以及向多节点图的推广，并通过仿真验证了有限样本下的可识别性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实数据中常同时出现序数、计数、有界与连续变量，现有可识别性工作多依赖加性噪声SEM或单族分布假设（如CPCM），无法直接处理混合族（特别是序数节点不构成指数族）的因果边方向判定问题。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 作者定义了线性参数模型（LPM）：每个子节点的参数由父节点取值的线性组合经确定性参数链接函数映射得到。序数节点采用McCullagh有序logit（比例发生比）累积链接，指数族节点采用一般的正则单参数指数族条件分布。研究分三步：①在双变量情形，利用条件对数比对比前向（X→Y）与反向（Y→X）模型——前向模型的对数比对充分统计量T(y)呈仿射性，而反向模型中相邻极端对数比具有严格凸/凹曲率性质，二者结合在|Y|≥3时产生矛盾，从而证明可识别；②给出反例构造，证明|Y|=2（结合仿射T与规范链接）或s=2（结合仿射T）时不可识别；③利用局部化与外生父节点的"平移"将多节点DAG中任意混合边归约到双变量情形，并进而推广到任意无环方向的不可入性。数值实验采用BIC评分的穷举/贪心搜索，在3节点和20节点二部DAG上验证。

Result: 主要理论结果：定理1——在s≥3、|Y|≥3条件下，双变量边方向在每个参数点上分布可识别；定理2/3——给出|Y|=2与s=2情形的不可识别反例（构造了显式同分布的参数族）；定理4/5——将可识别性推广到任意d节点DAG中每条混合边及整个无环定向集合，所需假设仅为马尔可夫性、因果充分性与无选择偏倚，无需忠实性；定理6——证明在孤立边条件下上述阈值不可削弱。数值上：3节点MEC内部可通过BIC正确区分；20节点稀疏图（p=0.1）几乎所有族在N=500时误差率降至零；密集图（p=0.9）虽因搜索启发式而无法触及零，但误差率仍随N下降。

Conclusion: 本文建立了混合序数-指数族因果DAG在LPM框架下、每参数点均成立的边方向可识别性定理，刻画了序数类数≥3与指数族支撑≥3这两个阈值条件的必要性，并将结论扩展到多节点图与整个定向集合。区别于以往"几乎处处"可识别结果，本文的"每点"保证在实际数据中更为可靠。仿真验证了在MEC内部正确分离定向的能力。未来工作包括：似然估计的一致性、纯指数族边、多参数族以及超越logit的累积链接函数。

Abstract: The problem of identifiability in linear parametric models (LPMs) whose nodes follow either an ordered logit model or a regular one-parameter exponential family is evaluated. The results go beyond classical structural equation models as well as results for nodes with observations from a homogeneous family of distributions. The main result establishes that the orientation of every edge joining an ordinal node to an exponential-family node is identifiable from the joint distribution alone at every parameter value, provided the ordinal node has at least three categories and the exponential-family node at least three points of support, with no restriction on the sufficient statistic. Converses show that both requirements are necessary: the three-category requirement is binding only for affine sufficient statistics, and the three-point requirement is binding under the canonical link. The guarantee extends to orienting every such mixed ordinal-exponential family edge of a given $d$-node undirected skeleton. Numerical experiments illustrate the theoretical results by successfully separating orientations within a Markov equivalence class, which are indistinguishable by conditional independence alone.

</details>


### [268] [Maximum Strong Independent Sets in Hypergraphs: Reductions, Bounds, and Greedy Certificates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17951)
*Yingquan,Jason Cong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了有限超图中最大强独立集问题，开发了一套基于关联结构的工具箱，包括精确化简、闭合形式上界、穿刺与覆盖证书，以及由块权重驱动的分层贪心聚类算法，并给出正确性、终止性、不动点及最优性证书保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在实际应用中（如多波段LSH-MinHash去重），每个碰撞桶仅提供局部不兼容性证据，而连通分量收缩可能通过重叠桶引入虚假的全局等价关系。强独立集作为局部块约束下的选择抽象，避免了传递闭包带来的过度合并，能更准确地刻画这类问题的组合本质。

Method: 方法围绕"关联结构工具箱"展开：(1) 证明基于支配关系、关联对生子和权重1块的精确化简（定理1-4）；(2) 推导闭合形式上界U(B)=Σ 1/w(B)及权重1排除改进（定理5、推论2-3）；(3) 设计分层超集锐化算法（算法1）和迭代贪心分层穿刺算法（算法2），通过残差块族上的证书搜索收紧上界；(4) 提出贪心分层覆盖算法（算法3）及其迭代版本，给出覆盖子族的受限块权重证书（定理6-8、推论5）；(5) 提出贪心分层聚类算法（算法4），按块权重分层、按n_min和碰撞分数选择根，给出可行性、极大性、算法感知匹配上界（定理9-11）及相关复杂度分析。

Result: 论文建立了完整的关联结构理论：在大规模ClueWeb22（16.2亿文档）和HPLT（39.8亿文档）消融实验中，穿刺证书严格强于收敛覆盖证书，贪心分层求解器达到穿刺界的至少99.43%。理论方面，给出了可计算的上界证书序列U_cf≥U_w1、U_punct和U_cover，并证明了贪心聚类算法在支撑超集抑制条件下能精确达到U(B⁻)=α(B)。

Conclusion: 论文的结论是：对于有限超图的最大强独立集问题，应直接利用物化的顶点-块关联结构而非折叠为图级代理。主要贡献包括精确化简、块权重上界、穿刺与覆盖证书，以及具有可行性、极大性、见证匹配、复杂度和最优性保证的分层贪心聚类算法。未来工作应聚焦于收紧贪心算法的最坏近似比、刻画穿刺与覆盖证书何时紧致，以及为非显式块结构的图实例开发证书引导的贪心调度。

Abstract: We study the maximum strong independent set problem in a finite hypergraph: find the largest vertex set that intersects every hyperedge in at most one vertex. This objective arises whenever each observed block is a local incompatibility constraint but transitive closure across overlapping blocks is not justified. A motivating example is multi-band LSH-MinHash deduplication, where each collision bucket gives local evidence, while connected-component contraction can impose spurious global equivalences. The paper develops an incidence-structural toolkit for this problem. We prove exact reductions for dominance, incidence twins, and weight-1 blocks; derive closed-form and low-weight upper bounds; introduce puncturing and covering certificates that sharpen those bounds; and analyze a layered greedy clustering algorithm driven by block weights and residual incidence. The algorithmic analysis includes feasibility, maximality, conditional optimality, a layered witness-matching upper bound, and incidence-local complexity bounds. The results give correctness, termination, fixed-point, and optimality certificates for broad incidence families, together with examples showing when different certificates separate or coincide.

</details>


### [269] [QuanText: Protecting Dataset-Level Secrets in Textual Data Sharing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17995)
*Shuaiqi Wang,Zinan Lin,Giulia Fanti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 QuanText，一种无需训练且与 LLM 无关的文本数据发布机制，旨在保护文本数据集中的全局敏感属性（如某类诊断或政治立场的样本占比），同时通过重写样本来保持效用。其核心基于统计最大泄漏（SML）框架，理论上可证明其满足 η-SML 保证，并在真实数据集（Tweet Stance、ChatDoctor）上的实验表明，相较于差分隐私合成数据基线（Private Evolution、DP-FT），QuanText 在隐私-效用权衡上表现更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言数据集的发布可能泄露敏感的整体属性（dataset-level secrets），例如某疾病患者在医疗记录中的比例、某政治立场的推文比例等。差分隐私对个体记录保护有效，但对聚合属性保护不足；现有工作多聚焦于属性推断攻击，防御方法有限。此外，仅扰动敏感属性不足以防御——攻击者可利用与秘密相关的其他属性推断秘密。

Method: 1. 使用 Chow-Liu 算法在辅助公共数据集上学习属性联合分布的树结构近似。
2. 对每个分布分量构建 γ 个候选发布分布（通过对称 Dirichlet 采样+最远点贪心选择）。
3. 从与私有经验分布 TV 距离最近的 k 个候选中均匀随机选择一个作为发布分布。
4. 从发布分布中抽取 n 个目标属性组合，用匈牙利算法将其与私有样本匹配，提取属性相关片段，再用 LLM 重写每个样本以匹配目标属性。
理论分析基于统计最大泄漏（SML），考虑内容-风格相关性 L(Y;Z) ≤ l 的最坏情况比值，推导出 SML 上界为 log(γ/k)^(1+Σψ) + log l。

Result: 在 Tweet Stance 和 ChatDoctor 两个真实数据集上的实验显示：
- 当候选稀释度 γ/k ≤ 8 时，QuanText 在攻击 MAE 和聚合效用上均优于 PE 和 DP-FT 等 DP 基线。
- 将 γ/k 从 12 降到 2，攻击 MAE 从约 0.01 提升至 0.1，而聚合效用仅从 0.85 略降至 0.77。
- QuanText 对不同 γ、k 组合具有鲁棒性；在 Llama、Mistral、Qwen 三种攻击后端模型下，方法排名 Spearman 相关系数均 > 0.6，表明保护效果不依赖于特定攻击模型。

Conclusion: QuanText 是一种模型无关、无需训练的数据发布机制，通过随机量化联合属性分布并利用 LLM 重写样本，有效保护数据集级秘密（如特定属性类别的占比），同时限制通过相关属性的泄漏并保持数据效用。理论上满足 SML 保证，实验上在隐私-效用权衡上优于差分隐私合成数据基线。

Abstract: Natural-language datasets support many downstream applications and research studies, but releasing text can reveal sensitive global properties of the underlying data source, such as the proportion of records associated with a particular gender, diagnosis, or political stance. Existing work has largely focused on property inference attacks that recover such global properties, while defenses for protecting these dataset-level secrets remain limited. Differential privacy, although effective for protecting individual records, provides only weak protection for aggregate properties. We propose Randomized Quantization for Text (QuanText), a training-free and large-language-model-agnostic data release mechanism that protects global secrets in textual datasets while preserving data utility. Given a dataset-level secret, such as the proportion of records with a particular diagnosis, and attributes whose utility should be preserved, such as topic and sentiment, QuanText perturbs both the secret distribution and the distributions of correlated attributes. It does so by constructing candidate release distributions over secret and non-secret attributes, randomly selecting a candidate sufficiently close to the private empirical distribution, and rewriting each private text sample to match the selected distribution using attribute-related snippets from the original text. QuanText is inspired by the Statistic Maximal Leakage (SML) framework, which bounds leakage about a secret function of a data distribution. Under idealized conditions, we show that QuanText satisfies an SML guarantee. Since these conditions may not hold exactly in practice, we also evaluate QuanText empirically on real-world datasets. Our results show that QuanText achieves a better empirical privacy-utility trade-off than competing data generation baselines.

</details>


### [270] [Structural Inference under Hidden Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18045)
*Zhongben Gong,Xiaoqun Wu,Mingyang Zhou,Hui Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SIHA框架，解决多智能体系统中部分智能体轨迹完全缺失（隐藏智能体）时的结构推断问题，联合恢复隐藏智能体的历史/未来轨迹及其与可见智能体的交互关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有结构推断方法（如NRI）假设所有智能体轨迹均可观测，而实际中常因遮挡、感知限制或通信故障导致某些智能体完全不可见。已有工作分别研究了不可见节点估计、部分观测下的结构推断以及缺失值填补，但隐藏智能体轨迹与其交互关系的联合恢复尚未被充分探索。

Method: SIHA采用"结构无关初始化 + 结构引导迭代精化"策略：(1) 结构无关隐藏状态预测器（HSP-sa，基于Set Transformer）从可见轨迹初始化隐藏轨迹；(2) 预训练的NRI骨干网络从完整轨迹集推断交互结构并预测未来；(3) 结构引导隐藏状态预测器（HSP-sg）通过多强度结构注意力机制（4个注意力头，强度分别为{0,1,5,10^9}）利用推断的结构精化隐藏轨迹；(4) HSP-sg与NRI交替迭代，实现状态-结构联合精化。训练时使用缓存机制管理结构估计，部署时固定模型参数进行5轮精化。

Result: 在Springs、Charged Particles、Kuramoto三个基准系统上（隐藏智能体数1-5），SIHA在可见-可见结构推断准确率上持续优于仅可见的NRI基准；在隐藏状态重建和未来预测上优于HSP-sa基线。在CMU运动捕捉数据上模拟整肢遮挡的实验进一步验证了其在真实隐藏智能体场景中的有效性。消融实验表明：无引导注意力头的影响最大，直接隐藏状态监督对性能至关重要，去除该监督将导致性能大幅下降。

Conclusion: SIHA通过耦合的状态-结构精化机制，有效解决了隐藏智能体存在时结构推断的循环依赖问题，在多个动力学系统和运动捕捉数据上表现出色。当前局限在于训练时依赖完整轨迹进行隐藏状态监督，完全无监督的隐藏智能体结构推断仍是一个开放问题。

Abstract: Recovering latent interaction structures from multi-agent dynamics is important for understanding and predicting interacting systems. Trajectory-based structural inference has achieved promising performance, but conventional formulations assume that the trajectories of all modeled agents are available. In practice, agents may become unobserved at deployment because of limited sensing, occlusion, or communication failure. Existing studies have considered unseen-node estimation, structural inference under partial observations, and missing-value imputation, yet the joint recovery of hidden-agent trajectories and their interactions remains underexplored. We formulate this problem as structural inference under hidden agents. Its key difficulty is a circular dependency: recovering interactions involving a hidden agent requires an estimate of its trajectory, while trajectory reconstruction can itself benefit from structural information. To address this challenge, we propose Structural Inference under Hidden Agents (SIHA), which combines structure-agnostic initialization with structure-guided iterative refinement. SIHA reconstructs hidden trajectories from visible observations, infers interactions using Neural Relational Inference, and feeds the estimated structure back into hidden-state reconstruction through multi-strength structural attention and iterative state--structure updates. Experiments on three benchmark dynamical systems demonstrate consistent improvements in visible-to-visible structural inference, while also showing benefits in hidden-state reconstruction and future prediction. Motion-capture experiments with simulated whole-limb occlusion further demonstrate its effectiveness in realistic hidden-agent settings.

</details>


### [271] [Regional Explanations via Causal Sufficiency and Necessity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18049)
*Xuexin Chen,Peng Liang,Zijian Li,Zhiyong Lin,Ruichu Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SNRE框架，通过区域级概率充分必要性(PNS)度量学习输入-输出区域对(A,B)，解释深度学习模型预测行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有XAI方法（特征重要性、反事实解释、规则）缺乏对"何时且仅何时"产生特定预测行为的区域级刻画，规则解释仅指明预测可能成立的输入区域，无法说明该区域外预测不成立的原因。

Method: 1) 基于Pearl的经典PNS，通过两种互补的随机干预策略（条件于A与条件于A补集）定义区域级PNS；2) 推导可微有限样本蒙特卡洛估计器；3) 输入区域用二次超曲面参数化、输出区域用超球面参数化，引入可学习软特征掩码选择相关特征；4) 通过sigmoid松弛实现端到端优化。

Result: 在Mushroom、GMSC、Phishing Websites、German Credit四个数据集上，SNRE的PNS均优于17个基线方法（11个规则方法+6个PNS方法）；二次超曲面在表达力与可解释性间取得最佳平衡；学习掩码对噪声特征鲁棒；输入扰动下输入/输出IoU保持高位；细调漂移度量与可视化一致；主动学习中SNRE引导采样AUC/准确率更高且收敛更快。

Conclusion: SNRE通过区域级PNS和显式代数区域参数化，为深度模型提供了具有因果充分必要性的区域级解释，兼具强解释质量、结构合理性、鲁棒性与实际应用价值。

Abstract: Model explainability is essential for understanding and trusting machine learning models. Existing explainable AI methods often explain predictions through feature importance, counterfactual explanations, or rules. However, a region-level characterization of when and only when a prediction behavior arises remains less explored. This paper proposes Causal Sufficient and Necessary Regional Explanations (SNRE), a framework that learns an input region $A$ and output region $B$ such that membership in $A$ is both sufficient and necessary for the model output to fall in $B$. Motivated by the classical Probability of Necessity and Sufficiency (PNS), we formulate a region-level PNS measure through stochastic interventions and derive a differentiable finite-sample estimator for optimization. SNRE parameterizes the input-output region pair with explicit and interpretable algebraic region families, together with a learnable feature mask, balancing expressiveness and interpretability. Experiments demonstrate that SNRE learns region pairs with strong sufficiency-necessity performance, robust explanation behavior, and practical utility for model analysis.

</details>


### [272] [Beyond Embedding Transfer: Component Roles in Grokking Transfer and Stability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18078)
*Zeyu Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过108-run的因子分解实验，分离了grokking中迁移加速（efficacy）与轨迹稳定性（stability），发现内部注意力/MLP权重(B)负责获取加速，而表征载体(E,U)的冻结控制保留稳定性；二者由不同组件角色支配，且存在架构与任务族的经验边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前工作（如Xu et al., 2025）证明预训练嵌入可加速单任务grokking，但不清楚：(1)内部注意力/MLP矩阵是否提供超越表征载体的独立计算效用；(2)快速获取是否在持续优化下保持稳定（即是否存在post-grokking relapse）；(3)针对性参数干预能否抑制回退。这对应获取(Acquisition)、回退(Relapse)、保护(Protection)三个问题。

Method: 任务：阿贝尔模运算(p=113，a+b→2a+b等)与非阿贝尔S₅(群乘法→共轭)。模型：pre-LN Transformer(d_model=128, n_head=4, d_mlp=512, 1层或2层)。双轨评估：(1) Efficacy轨——首次达90%步长t_reach、5k步精度积分I_5k、全程均值精度；(2) Stability轨——21点持续确认(1000步)的RMST_{30k}、post-peak relapse dip、post-trigger True Max Drawdown D_H^trig。所有转移张量做Frobenius范数尺度匹配以分离方向与幅度。统计推断使用精确双侧符号翻转排列检验(2^12=4096枚举)，Holm-Bonferroni控制FWER(α=0.05)；等价性检验使用TOST；BCa bootstrap估计置信区间。实验设计：Phase B(108-run：96-run 2³因子+12-run尺度控制，12个paired blocks 210-221)分解E/U/B三组件；Phase C(60-run, blocks 230-239)测试offline载体冻结与软干预；§5.4-5.5跨4个前瞻队列(验证/仿射/非线性二次/2层，blocks 250-321)测试online动态验证门控；§6测试非阿贝尔S₅(blocks 350-361)与2层组件角色(blocks 330-341)。

Result: Phase B(1层)：Full transfer vs E+U提升早期精度+5.46pp(Holm p=0.0039)，缩短确认延迟558步(p=0.0088)；U+B与Full在±500步边际下达到TOST等价(p=0.0011，Δ=-16.7步，但11/12 seeds Full略快)；B单独在30k内不改善确认(0/12确认, p=0.5000)；Readout(U)单独转移强于Embedding(E)单独(I_5k: 3710.6 vs 2553.7)。2层复现(blocks 330-341)：内部B加速确认+704.67单位(p=4.88×10⁻⁴)；U+B因省略供体嵌入而低于Full 4475.6单位(超出±250单位等价边际，TOST p=1.00)。回退诊断(单轨迹)：单次25.24pp回退的状态互换显示恢复pre-relapse B将精度从74.76%恢复至99.85%，而恢复E+U仅至81.45%；切线分量主导内块位移(≥88.4%)。线性探针(4次合格回退)：重新拟合线性读出在N=2554下恢复8.37-11.03pp，但trough探针在所有校准预算下均劣于pre-relapse。Phase C offline载体冻结将post-peak relapse从19.40%降至0.07%(p=0.005859)；软干预(0.1×LR, 500步冻结)未显著抑制。Online动态验证门控：2a+b队列将True Max Drawdown从22.06%降至0.60%(p=0.000488, 12/12 wins)；前瞻仿射队列(3a+b)降至5.09%(+23.47pp)；非线性二次(a²+b²)降至0.15%(+10.94pp)；2层目标降至65.23%(+15.35pp, 11/12 wins)——保护变部分。S₅：未屏蔽转移瞬时峰值95.4%但持续确认失败(0/4 at q=0.90)；前瞻屏蔽队列无确认获益(ΔD=+0.15±1.14pp, p=0.895)。

Conclusion: 本研究确立了组件级别的解离：内部注意力/MLP权重(B)对迁移获取(acquisition velocity)贡献显著，而表征载体(E,U)的冻结控制保留稳定性(retention stability)；供体嵌入的必要性随架构深度变化(2层中U+B不可替代Full)。载体冻结几乎消除offline relapse(19.40%→0.07%)；online验证门控在阿贝尔1层任务中实现大幅drawdown削减(10.94-23.47pp)，但在2层目标中保护仅为部分(残余65.23%)，并在非阿贝尔S₅中无确认获益。这些结果为grokking迁移的加速-稳定性权衡提供了组件级解释，并揭示了参数屏蔽的经验边界。

Abstract: Warm-start transfer can make algorithmic tasks generalize rapidly, yet it is unclear which model components provide the gain and whether that gain remains stable under continued optimization. We study cross-operator transfer on modular arithmetic and separate efficacy (early velocity) from stability (post-reach drawdown). In a scale-matched 108-run battery across 12 seed blocks (96-run 2^3 factorial plus 12-run scale control), transferring internal attention/MLP weights (B) alongside token embeddings and readout (E+U) improves early accuracy by 5.46 pp (Holm p=0.0039) and cuts confirmation latency by 558 steps (Holm p=0.0088). While readout plus internal-block transfer satisfies the pre-specified +/-500-step latency equivalence criterion in 1-layer models (TOST p=0.0011, though Full is faster in 11/12 paired seeds), a prospective 2-layer replication confirms the internal-block advantage (12/12 seeds, +704.67 integral units, p=4.88x10^-4) while revealing an architectural boundary: omitting donor embeddings falls 4475.6 units below Full, outside the +/-250-unit margin. Continued target training frequently triggers severe post-grokking relapse. Freezing transferred representation carriers (E, U) nearly eliminates offline relapse (19.40% -> 0.07%, Holm p=0.005859). Online validation-triggered gating slashes True Max Drawdown from 22.06% to 0.60% on 2a+b (p=0.000488), with prospective confirmations extending protection across affine, nonlinear quadratic, and 2-layer targets (10.94-23.47 pp reductions), distinguishing continual stabilization from static early stopping. In non-abelian S_5, unshielded transfer surges transiently (95.4% peak), but a prospective shielding cohort yields no confirmed benefit (+0.15 +/- 1.14 pp). These results establish a component-level dissociation between transfer acceleration and trajectory stability, and expose the empirical boundaries of parameter shielding.

</details>


### [273] [FedPGT: Progressive Gradient Transmission for Vehicular Federated Learning over Time-Varying Channels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18089)
*Jintao Yan,Tan Chen,Yuxuan Sun,Sheng Zhou,Zhisheng Niu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FedPGT，一种面向时变信道下车联网联邦学习（VFL）的渐进式梯度传输方案，通过逐时隙传输高幅度梯度条目来动态适应信道变化，并基于Lyapunov漂移加惩罚方法实现无需未来信息的在线资源分配，在CIFAR-10和Argoverse任务上优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车联网联邦学习中，车辆移动导致信道条件和传输容量快速变化，使得预先确定的资源分配和固定稀疏化策略失效；现有压缩/稀疏化方法通常在每轮开始时固定稀疏度，无法适应轮内时变的通信机会。

Method: 1) 建立基于可压缩梯度（幂律衰减）的收敛界，证明传输条目数与收敛性能呈边际递减的幂律关系；2) 将累积耦合的目标函数通过逐时隙代理变量重构为可加性分离形式；3) 利用Lyapunov漂移加惩罚框架，引入PGT队列和能量队列实现长期一致性；4) 通过KKT条件推导出资源块（RB）排他分配和功率分配的解析表达式，设计低复杂度联合RB与功率分配算法（复杂度O(T·N·Z²)）。

Result: 在CIFAR-10图像分类任务上测试精度提升3.65%，在Argoverse轨迹预测任务上平均位移误差降低12.66%；在高车辆速度、有限带宽和不同车辆数量等挑战性场景下均表现出优于V2VFL、VEFL、JGSD和SA基线的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: FedPGT通过渐进式梯度传输和Lyapunov在线优化，有效应对了VFL中时变信道和车辆移动性带来的通信挑战，在收敛性能和通信效率之间取得了有界性能保证的权衡；未来工作将集成语义感知传输和异步模型聚合以进一步扩展框架。

Abstract: Vehicular federated learning (VFL) enables privacy-preserving collaborative model training for intelligent transportation systems, where communication resource allocation and gradient sparsification techniques have been explored to reduce communication overhead. However, vehicle mobility leads to rapidly varying channel conditions and transmission capacity, rendering predetermined resource allocation and sparsification decisions ineffective. In this paper, we propose FedPGT, a progressive gradient transmission scheme for VFL over time-varying channels, where vehicles progressively transmit high-magnitude gradient entries in response to instantaneous channel conditions. We establish a convergence bound that characterizes the impact of transmitted gradient entries and reveals diminishing-return behavior governed by a power-law decay. Motivated by this result, we formulate a stochastic optimization problem for online decision-making, where the main challenge lies in a cumulatively coupled, non-separable objective. To handle this challenge, we introduce per-slot surrogate transmission variables to decouple the long-term dependence across time slots and convert the original objective into an additive per-slot optimization problem, enabling a Lyapunov drift-plus-penalty approach for online scheduling. We further develop a low-complexity resource allocation algorithm for efficient online implementation. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed scheme achieves a 3.65% accuracy improvement on the CIFAR-10 image classification task and a 12.66% reduction in average displacement error on the Argoverse trajectory prediction task compared with state-of-the-art baselines, demonstrating its applicability to diverse learning tasks under highly dynamic vehicular environments.

</details>


### [274] [iMINDBench: iEEG Multi-Institution Neural Decoding Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18104)
*Geeling Chau,Saba Hashemi,Yonghyeon Gwon,Eshani Patel,Jan DeWitt,Christopher Wang,Andrii Zahorodnii,Sabera J Talukder,Danny Dongyeop Han,Chun Kee Chung,Maryam M Shanechi,Yisong Yue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: iMINDBench 是一个针对颅内脑电图（iEEG）神经解码的多机构基准测试，包含15个跨语言/听觉/视觉域的解码任务，基于三个自然电影观看数据集（Neuroprobe/Brain Treebank、Bang! You're Dead、Pippi）。该基准定义了标准化的预处理通道（Multi-STFT和Waveform）、固定的评估划分以及可解码性子集（Main/Challenge/All），支持跨任务、跨机构和跨预处理的一致性模型比较。核心发现是：预训练系统在各自预处理通道内优于非预训练基线，但强谱特征基线（Multi-STFT MLP）在机构间仍具竞争力；扩展研究表明，增加至多25倍的其他受试者或机构的监督数据仅产生小幅、依赖任务的增益，跨机构和跨数据集的监督效果尤为有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: iEEG神经解码领域缺乏统一的评估框架，现有研究在数据集、任务、预处理管道和划分构建上存在差异，导致基准提升难以区分是来自模型进步还是评估设置变化。此外，向通用基础模型发展的进展难以跨机构和跨任务可靠衡量。论文动机在于提供一个标准化的多机构基准，以支持更系统地评估iEEG模型的泛化能力。

Method: 方法包括：（1）整合三个自然电影观看iEEG数据集（Neuroprobe/Brain Treebank、BYD、Pippi）并对齐解码标签和电极元数据；（2）定义15个解码任务（语言、听觉、视觉域），使用1秒神经窗口与刺激标签配对；（3）定义两个标准化预处理通道——Multi-STFT（多分辨率短时傅里叶变换，2–250 Hz，含陷波滤波和拉普拉斯重参考）和Waveform（500 Hz，含0.5 Hz高通滤波）；（4）定义三个缩放域（within-session、within-dataset、multi-dataset）和三个可解码性子集（Main、Challenge、All，基于STFT和HTNet筛选解码器的验证AUC>0.60划分）；（5）评估基线模型（Logistic、MLP、CNN、HTNet）和预训练系统（PopT-v2、BaRISTA、DIVER-1），报告按通道和数据集分层的ROC-AUC结果；（6）进行数据缩放实验，系统性地增加监督训练数据来源。

Result: 主要结果包括：（1）在Main单元上，预训练系统在各自通道内优于非预训练基线——PopT-v2在Multi-STFT通道达到最高Overall ROC-AUC 0.645（vs MLP 0.631），BaRISTA和DIVER-1在Waveform通道分别达到0.636和0.634（vs HTNet 0.614）；（2）Multi-STFT MLP基线仍具竞争力，尤其在BYD和Pippi等下游训练集较小的数据集上；（3）预处理选择显著影响基线性能——Global Norm相比Sample Norm在某些设置下提升ROC-AUC超过0.10，省略0.5 Hz高通滤波使HTNet ROC-AUC从0.612降至0.589；（4）缩放研究表明，会话内缩放带来最大且最一致的增益（每翻倍训练数据约提升0.025 ROC-AUC），使用3–18倍样本的同数据集缩放仅带来0.001–0.014的提升，使用6–25倍样本的跨数据集训练甚至在Neuroprobe和Pippi上不如同数据集训练；（5）30/44的任务-数据集对受益于同数据集训练，仅19/44对受益于进一步的跨数据集添加。

Conclusion: iMINDBench提供了一个跨任务、机构和预处理通道评估iEEG解码的共享框架。研究表明模型优势依赖于输入表示和评估设置，其他受试者和机构的额外监督数据在缩放实验中不能可靠地改善目标会话解码。该基准推动需要开发在有限监督下能提取有效特征、并从异构记录中更有效学习的模型，其表示需对解剖结构、采集和记录条件的差异具有鲁棒性或适应性。匹配预处理比较和跨机构评估提供了衡量这些进步走向通用iEEG解码的互补方式。论文还指出强谱特征基线是有用的参考点，工程化谱特征已支持简单模型的有效解码，波形模型须从较少处理的输入中学习有用特征。

Abstract: Intracranial electroencephalography (iEEG) is widely used to record electrical activity directly from electrodes inside the human brain, making it an attractive modality for neural decoding.
