*Gabriel Bénédict,Melanie Buechler,Gerard Riera-Solà,Chloé de Ancos,Yves Gaetan Nana Teukam,Moritz Freidank*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文复现了Edit Flows和EvoFlows两种基于编辑的蛋白质/抗体生成模型，指出二者本质相同——即在连续时间内以学习速率逐次触发编辑的纯跳跃过程（Generator Matching的纯跳跃特例），并发布了首个开源实现EditJumps，用1.66M OAS同源对训练了一个通用抗体编辑器，可零样本编辑未见靶点。研究发现：恢复发表结果需逆向工程一个未公开的"时钟归一化"超参数（控制实际编辑数），且6/10评价指标无法从原文确定性复现，频谱MMD等指标对参考集大小高度敏感，可导致方法排名反转。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 抗体先导优化需要在不固定编辑位置、数量和输出长度的前提下，对现有候选序列进行少量有界编辑（substitutions/insertions/deletions）。现有Edit Flows和EvoFlows虽具备这一能力，但未发布代码或完整训练规范，阻碍了领域采纳与可复现性。论文旨在从头复现这两个方法，揭示缺失的规格，并提供开源、可复现的基线。

Method: （1）理论层面：将Edit Flows和EvoFlows统一形式化为Generator Matching框架下、变长序列上的纯跳跃CTMC过程，明确了两个关键正则化条件：非爆炸条件（防止序列长度在有限时间内爆炸）和长度不变的时钟归一化（防止编辑率随序列长度偏移）。（2）实现层面：发布EditJumps开源PyTorch库，统一两种方法的跳跃核/速率抽象，基于预训练ESM-2编码器（35M参数），通过FiLM时间调制输出五个量（ins/del/sub三个位置速率头+ins/sub两个token分布头），采用线性κ_t调度、冻结holding-interval速率等。（3）训练层面：使用OAS配对VH.VL序列，经MMseqs2聚类（0.5 identity/0.8 coverage，每家族限20对），构造1,660,105对称同源对；Euler τ-leaping N=50步采样验证相对离散化误差<0.3%。（4）评估层面：在Ty1（VHH）和HER2-VH两家族上对比EditJumps、evotuning/evotuning(forced)、EvoDiff-MSA、BF-DiT/BF-ESM和随机突变基线，使用200个held-out同源参考集，并系统审计了发表指标的完整性及样本大小敏感性。

Result: （1）理论与方法论：成功将Edit Flows和EvoFlows统一为Generator Matching的纯跳跃特例，证明二者共享相同的跳跃核/速率抽象；识别出EvoFlows原文未给出的"时钟归一化"超参数是实际编辑数量的主导因素，在clock rate≈95时可复现发表0.43的编辑比率。（2）编辑效果：EditJumps在4.08–4.58 edits/seq预算下，序列多样性高于evotuning和EvoDiff-MMD，频谱MMD与evotuning相当（在Ty1上持平，HER2-VH上差3%）；在4项/10项发表指标上确定复现，但6/10指标无法从原文确定性复现。（3）指标审计：发现频谱MMD参考集从200→800扩大时，归一化比率在Ty1上偏移50%、HER2-VH上偏移26%，足以颠倒方法排名；谱协方差等协议对参考划分高度敏感（83.6%→85.1%）；Ty1参考集中113/200条曾出现在训练集。（4）生物物理特性：保留IMGT Cys23/Cys104二硫键100%（随机突变仅89.0%/93.8%）；CDR区域KL仅闭合随机突变与天然同源之间18.7–23.9%的距离差，表明框架区驱动大部分保真度。（5）发现了Edit Flows发表代码与Eq.23之间的监督错误（49.2%训练对受影响）。

Conclusion: 将序列编辑建模为连续时间纯跳跃过程，为可变长离散序列生成提供了原则性框架，弥合了连续流匹配与离散编辑之间的鸿沟。实证发现：（1）发表与复现间的编辑分布差异源于未公开的时钟归一化超参数；（2）离散生成生物学中的评估指标普遍欠规范，6/10指标无法从原文确定性复现，MMD等分布度量对参考集大小敏感，可导致排名反转；（3）连续时间跳跃模型优于均匀随机突变和forced evotuning，但仍低于天然同源基准，特别是在CDR高变区。建议：（i）在模型内部参数化运行时时钟速率或自适应停止准则，而非手动调整；（ii）采用标准化指标和固定参考集以消除样本大小伪影；（iv）在非强制和强制两种范式下评估生成基线，以区分主动设计与被动保守。论文以MIT许可在GitHub（VisiumCH/editjumps）发布了完整代码库、模型权重和自动化测试套件。

Abstract: Antibody lead optimization calls for a small, bounded set of edits to an existing candidate: substitutions, but also insertions and deletions. Edit-based generative models are the only ones that allocate such an edit budget without fixing the edit positions, the edit count, or the output length in advance. However, the existing approaches Edit Flows and EvoFlows did not release code or complete training specifications. Here, we show that both methods follow the same underlying process -- edits firing one at a time, at learned rates, in continuous time -- the pure-jump case of generator matching over finite sequences. With EditJumps we introduce the first open implementation of this framework, with a single generalist antibody editor trained on 1.66M Observed Antibody Space homolog pairs to propose homolog-like variants of a seed sequence, editing unseen leads zero-shot, without the per-family retraining original approaches require. Replicating this system from scratch exposes why open code is essential for generative biology: reconciling published edit distributions required reverse-engineering an undocumented rate-scaling hyperparameter that dictates realized mutation counts. Moreover, we show that published evaluation metrics are highly sensitive to reference sample size, frequently flipping method rankings. We release our full codebase, automated test suite, and configurations at: this https URL

</details>


### [303] [A Convergence Framework for Deep $V$-Learning: Error Propagation and Sharp Action-Gap Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18782)
*Yury Kolomeytsev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为深度V-学习（Deep V-Learning）建立了有限时域收敛框架，通过将更新误差分解为六个残差（拟合、转移复用、目标构建、回放、动作选择、探索），在L^s集中性条件下得出期望L^1策略损失的显式边界，并证明了动作间隔（action-gap）界的最优指数与下界匹配，同时给出匹配预算下的最优样本分配方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度V-学习使用标量价值函数拟合执行转移的目标，并利用预测模型和价值函数选择动作。这种方法的总体目标算子（行为策略的期望T^β）与Bellman最优性算子T不同，需要建立系统的收敛性理论。现有工作缺乏对有限时域深度V-学习的统一残差分解、有限K传播系数、动作间隔正则性和样本分配策略的综合分析。

Method: 方法包括：(1) 将更新误差分解为六个确定性包络残差；(2) 使用L^s集中性条件和Hölder配对推导有限时域传播定理；(3) 引入Mammen-Tsybakov型动作间隔条件，将动作残差从线性改善为Λ^{1+α/p}阶；(4) 在匹配标签预算下求解连续最优分配和整数分配（2^ν因子内）；(5) 为生成重置过程建立神经回归率和表格拟合率；(6) 证明部署策略与真实得分策略的差异上界。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 期望策略损失界仅依赖最后H-1个更新块的残差，初始化项在K≥H-1时消失；(2) 在近单位折扣机制下，s=2时共享律传播系数最优阶为H^{5/2}；(3) 动作间隔条件给出1+α/p的指数，一步构造证明其尖锐性；(4) 直接层级重置在匹配预算下比共享时钟律在统计项上有√H优势；(5) 在精确得分oracle下，固定时域的生成重置近似ERM过程具有期望策略损失一致性；(6) 给出FIFO/交错SGD的显式残差衰减准则(114)。

Conclusion: 本文为深度V-学习建立了完整的有限时域收敛框架，将六个残差转化为期望策略损失边界。动作间隔条件可将线性动作残差升级为尖锐指数，一步构造证明其最优性。匹配预算分析表明直接层级采样在共享律之上有√H的统计优势。在固定时域和精确得分oracle下，生成重置过程具有策略损失一致性，并为实际FIFO/交错SGD实现提供了明确的残差衰减准则。

Abstract: We establish convergence bounds for deep $V$-learning with horizon $H$. The algorithm fits a scalar value function to targets from executed transitions and selects actions using a predictive model and the value function. For current observed-successor targets with fresh true-kernel outcomes, the conditional mean is $\mathcal{T}^\beta V$, which averages over behavior-policy actions. The Bellman optimality update is $\mathcal{T} V$. We decompose the update error into six residuals: fitting, transition reuse, target construction, replay, action selection, and exploration. Under $L^s$ concentrability, their $L^p$ norms ($p=s/(s-1)$) control expected $L^1$ policy loss. The bound explicitly weights residuals from only the last $H-1$ update blocks, plus an initialization term for shorter runs. We quantify the cost of a shared sampling distribution across horizon levels. For statistical error bounds of order $n^{-\nu}$, we derive optimal continuous allocations and an integer allocation whose objective is within a factor $2^\nu$ of the constrained optimum. A margin condition with exponent $\alpha$ gives action error of order $\Lambda^{1+\alpha/p}$, where $\Lambda$ combines network drift and score error; a one-step construction proves the exponent sharp. Bounds on the distance between frozen and optimal scores transfer an optimal-gap condition to frozen-iterate gap bounds while retaining the mass of optimal ties. Survival probabilities and coverage conditions at deployment yield bounds for policies selected with approximate scores. Separate spatial ReLU networks per horizon level give a conditional neural regression rate, and the finite-state case gives a log-free expected fit rate. These results give expected policy-loss consistency for the fixed-horizon generative-reset approximate-ERM procedure with exact action scores and provide an explicit residual-decay criterion for FIFO/interleaved SGD.

</details>


### [304] [WaveTLM: Reliable Time-Series Language Modeling through Task Compilation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18812)
*Jiahui Chen,Bingke Zhu,Hongyu Pan,Yingying Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出WaveTLM，一种基于"任务编译"思想的时序语言模型，通过将请求编译为类型化任务状态并由任务原生执行器构建输出，解决时序大模型输出"任务对象幻觉"（即文本看似合理但未能实例化任务所需的数值张量、合法决策或结构化记录）的可靠性问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时序大模型（TS-LLMs）以自由文本生成预测，但看似合理的语言并不保证任务输出的可靠性。模型可能违反预测的形状、尺度、通道顺序或时间对齐，分类和异常检测决策也可能落在合法标签空间之外。作者将这种失败定义为"任务对象幻觉"，并指出传统的JSON约束、语法解码或后修复等表面控制无法保证对象类型、维度、对齐、尺度、通道顺序、有限值约束和决策域的完整性。

Method: 1）形式化"可靠时序语言建模"为编译-执行范式：将任务分为任务对象可靠性（r_τ）与预测质量两部分，每类任务具有确定性契约 C_τ(m)。2）提出ExecTS-QA基准（35,323训练，4,795评测），覆盖预测、插补、分类、异常检测、波形分析五类任务，每实例配以自然语言请求、可见参数、任务原生目标和确定性契约。3）WaveTLM采用编译器-执行器架构：任务编译器将请求、语义补丁和波形证据编码为类型化任务状态 h_{τ̂}；任务原生执行器分别构建连续数值对象（预测/插补）、离散决策（分类/异常）和结构化记录（波形分析），并通过原生契约验证、序列化和往返恢复确保可靠性。训练目标联合语言建模损失 L_LM、槽位损失 L_slot 和任务损失 L_τ。

Result: 在ExecTS-QA上，单个WaveTLM检查点实现99.40%的契约有效覆盖率（CVC），最佳字符串优先基线（ChatTS-SFT）仅为37.83%；其可靠性收益RY为100%，缺口为0。在五个任务族的预测效用方面，WaveTLM是唯一在全部五族上都具有预测效用的语言接口模型：预测MAE .337、插补MAE .427、分类准确率 .706、异常F1 .847、波形类别准确率 .713。在外部基准上：TSQA-50（有监督适配）四个指标全部领先；IRTS-ToolBench（零样本）总体63.29领先；ARFBench（零样本）总体36.13、Tier I 81.98、weighted F1 24.83均领先；SciTS（零样本）数值成功率100%，并在MEU01和URU04异常F1上取得最高分。消融实验表明：任务特定执行器改善连续预测MAE（共享LoRA下预测MAE从.381→.322），任务特定LoRA路径恢复决策任务性能（异常F1从.000恢复至.847），二者互补。

Conclusion: 任务编译可以将看似合理的语言生成转化为可靠的时序输出。将任务对象可靠性从预测质量中独立评估是必要的；编译器-执行器架构通过显式绑定请求到类型化契约，使输出可靠性和构造路径显式可控。WaveTLM在单一检查点上同时实现高契约有效覆盖率和跨基准迁移能力，验证了编译式范式的有效性。

Abstract: Time-series language models provide a shared natural-language interface across temporal tasks, but plausible text does not guarantee reliable task outputs. Responses may appear reasonable while hallucinating the required object: numerical sequences can violate shape, scale, channel order, or temporal alignment, and textual decisions can fall outside the legal label space. We formulate reliable time-series language modeling, separating task-object reliability from predictive quality. We introduce ExecTS-QA, a contract-grounded benchmark spanning forecasting, imputation, classification, anomaly detection, and waveform analysis. We further propose WaveTLM, a unified compiler-executor model whose task compiler transforms user requests, visible arguments, and wave-grounded evidence into typed task states, while task-native executors construct numerical tensors, legal decisions, or structured records. On ExecTS-QA, a single WaveTLM checkpoint achieves 99.40% contract-valid coverage, compared with 37.83% for the strongest evaluated string-first baseline, while retaining balanced predictive performance across all five task families. Evaluations on SciTS, TSQA, IRTS-ToolBench, and ARFBench provide additional evidence of transfer. The code, construction scripts, and ExecTS-QA dataset will be publicly released upon publication. These results show that task compilation can convert plausible language generation into reliable time-series outputs.

</details>


### [305] [Interpretable Multi-Instance Learning Enables Early Prediction of Key Molecular Alterations from Routine Flow Cytometry in Acute Myeloid Leukemia](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18825)
*Jonathan Legrand,Aguirre Mimoun,Baudouin Denis de Senneville,Audrey Bidet,Pierre-Yves Dumas,Christèle Etchegaray*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 基于多示例学习的决策树模型，利用AML患者常规流式细胞术数据，在数小时内准确预测NPM1和FLT3-ITD突变状态，为早期治疗决策提供快速、可解释的替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NPM1和FLT3-ITD分子检测是AML早期治疗决策的关键依据，但传统检测需数周，远迟于治疗窗口期。流式细胞术在入院数小时内即可完成，若能从中直接预测突变状态，将实现零额外成本与延迟的精准决策支持。

Method: 开发基于决策树的可解释多示例学习（MIL）分类器，将每个患者样本视为细胞集合，从细胞级预测推断突变状态。基准对比包括基于临床变量的随机森林和适配多管流式数据的多管深度卷积神经网络。通过197例发现队列的交叉验证和161例独立测试队列进行验证，评估指标为AUROC和阳性预测值（PPV）。

Result: 发现队列交叉验证中，MIL模型对NPM1的AUROC为0.96（SD=0.05），对FLT3-ITD为0.86（SD=0.10），优于临床基线并与深度学习方法相当。在161例独立测试队列中，NPM1和FLT3-ITD的AUROC分别为0.90和0.82，PPV分别为0.87和0.68。细胞级解释成功复现已知免疫表型特征：NPM1突变呈CD33⁺/CD34⁻，FLT3-ITD呈CD33⁺/低侧向散射（SSC）。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，应用于常规诊疗数据的可解释模型可在数小时内预测AML分子状态，为早期、生物机制驱动的治疗决策提供了实用路径，且模型预测可直接关联已知生物学标志物。

Abstract: Background: Molecular testing for NPM1 and FLT3-ITD mutations guides critical early treatment decisions in acute myeloid leukemia (AML), but results can take weeks, long after these decisions must be made. Flow cytometry, already performed within hours of admission as part of routine care, may carry enough signal to predict these mutations directly, without added cost or delay. Methods: We developed an interpretable multi-instance learning classifier based on a decision tree, in which each patient sample is modeled as a collection of individual cells and mutation status is inferred from cell-level predictions. The model was benchmarked against a random forest trained on clinical variables and a deep convolutional neural network adapted for multitube flow cytometry data. Performance was assessed by cross-validation on a discovery cohort of 197 patients and tested on an independent cohort of 161 patients, using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) and positive predictive value. Results: In cross-validation on the discovery cohort, the MIL model achieved mean AUROCs of 0.96 (SD=0.05) for NPM1 and 0.86 (SD=0.10) for FLT3-ITD, outperforming the clinical baseline and matching deep learning approaches. The model then successfully generalized to the independent test cohort of 161 patients, reaching AUROCs of 0.90 (NPM1) and 0.82 (FLT3-ITD), with positive predictive values of 0.87 and 0.68, respectively. Cell-level interpretation recovered established immunophenotypic signatures (CD33${}^{+}$ /CD34___ for NPM1-mutated cases, CD33${}^{+}$ /low side-scatter for FLT3-ITD), directly linking model predictions to known biology. Conclusions: These results show that an interpretable model applied to data already collected in routine care can predict AML molecular status within hours, offering a practical route to earlier, biology-informed treatment decisions.

</details>


### [306] [Physics-based prediction, uncertainty quantification and decision-making for IN718 crystallographic texture intensity across LPBF defocus regimes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18863)
*Yisheng Lu,John Riris,Jie Song,Yao Fu,Jie Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对激光粉末床熔融(LPBF)Inconel 718合金<001>∥BD织构的可靠预测难题,提出一种两阶段物理约束混合模型框架。该框架通过物理锚定+随机森林残差修正+KNN适用性衰减+保形预测不确定性量化的分层决策机制,在分布偏移场景下显著优于纯黑盒模型,并能主动拒预测物理失效区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LPBF工艺参数与构件各向异性力学响应的关联依赖可靠的晶体织构预测。纯黑盒机器学习模型在分布偏移(shift)下泛化失败,且无法区分"数据支持不足"与"物理规律失效"两类问题,难以满足工艺认证(qualification)对可靠性的要求。Inconel 718的<001>∥BD织构受熔池热历史控制,需要将工艺-熔池几何-织构的物理链与数据驱动方法有机结合。

Method: 两阶段物理约束建模框架:Stage 1将工艺变量(功率、速度、离焦量等)映射到熔化模式(熔孔/传导)与熔池几何参数;Stage 2结合经验物理模型(physics anchor)与随机森林残差模型预测织构强度。引入三项关键机制:(1)k近邻权重衰减器对数据支持不足的查询点削弱残差修正;(2)研究特定的面能量密度(areal beam-power-density)判据将预测限定在导热模式包络内,主动拒预测熔孔/锁孔等物理失效区;(3)保形预测(conformal prediction)给出统计有效的预测区间,辅以SHAP和Sobol分析评估残差灵敏度。采用留一离焦(leave-one-defocus-out)与留一组(leave-one-group-out)交叉验证评估外推能力。

Result: 在留一离焦评估下:物理锚定模型R²=0.778,黑盒模型R²=-0.001(完全失效),门控混合模型R²=0.750。在留一组交叉验证下:门控混合R²=0.592,黑盒模型R²=0.538。保留集保形覆盖率达92.9%(宽度3.65 MUD,分组CV),转移到+80 mm离焦外推工况时达100%覆盖(宽度3.21 MUD)。示例映射给出BD方向弹性模量跨度127–187 GPa。在独立构建的9个新工况样本上,框架主动拒预测3个、衰减修正3个、对其余3个正确匹配测量排序,优于无约束模型。

Conclusion: 通过将"数据适用性"、"物理有效性"与"预测不确定性"分离为独立决策层,该框架能在无约束黑盒模型失效的场景下实现迁移,并在所有模型类别均不充分时主动拒预测。这种分层、物理约束的范式为LPBF工艺-织构-性能链的可靠建模与认证提供了新途径,尤其适用于需要外推和域外评估的关键工况。

Abstract: Reliable prediction of crystallographic texture in laser powder bed fusion is critical for linking process conditions with anisotropic response and for qualification. However, black-box models may fail under shift and cannot distinguish weak data support from loss of physical validity. This study develops a two-stage physics-based model for <001> || BD (build direction) texture in Inconel 718. Stage 1 maps process variables to melting mode and melt pool geometry. Stage 2 predicts texture by combining an empirical physics model with a random-forest residual model. A k-nearest-neighbor weight attenuates residual corrections for poorly supported queries, while a study-specific areal beam-power-density criterion withholds predictions outside the adopted conduction envelope. Conformal intervals are evaluated on the retained physics-valid set, and SHAP and Sobol analyses assess residual sensitivity. Under a controlled leave-one-defocus-out evaluation, the physics anchor achieved R^2 = 0.778, against -0.001 for the black-box model and 0.750 for the gated hybrid. Under leave-one-group-out cross-validation, the gated hybrid reached R^2 = 0.592 against 0.538 for the black-box model. Retained-set coverage was 92.9% at a mean full width of 3.65 multiples of a uniform distribution (MUD) under grouped cross-validation and 100% at a width of 3.21 MUD under transfer to a withheld +80 mm defocus regime. An illustrative mapping produced a retained BD elastic-modulus span of 127-187 GPa. On nine conditions from a separately built sample set, the framework withheld three, attenuated three, and matched the measured ordering for the rest. Separating data applicability, physics validity, and predictive uncertainty into distinct decisions lets the framework transfer where an unconstrained model does not, and withhold predictions where no model class performs adequately.

</details>


### [307] [Preventing Model Collapse: A Fisher-Rao Perspective on the Dynamics of Training with Synthetic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18878)
*Matteo Marchi,João Pedro Silvestre,Bahman Gharesifard,Paulo Tabuada*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型递归训练合成数据导致的"模型崩溃"问题，基于Fisher-Rao信息几何度量，建立了防止模型崩溃所需最小人-合成数据比的严格理论保证，证明了先前基于欧几里得度量的下界在高维下是空洞的，并提出在信息几何框架下所需的人数据比实际上比之前认为的更大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着高质量人类数据被逐渐耗尽，LLM越来越依赖合成数据进行训练，但递归使用合成数据会导致"模型崩溃"（model collapse），即模型逐步遗忘真实数据分布。注入人类数据是直观的应对策略，但当前缺乏关于防止崩溃所需最小人-合成数据比的严格理论保证。先前工作（基于欧氏度量）在高维下得到的下界会变得空洞（vacuous），无法真正指导实践。

Method: 1. 将生成模型的迭代训练建模为闭环随机过程（沿用Gerchinovitz & Remillard等框架）；2. 在概率单纯形 Δ^n 上引入 Fisher-Rao 黎曼度量，其诱导的测地距离即Hellinger距离 d_FR(θ,ϑ)=arccos(⟨√θ,√ϑ⟩)；3. 使用 KL 散度作为Lyapunov函数，沿连续时间动力学 ṫheta(t)=τ(θ)−θ+μ(θ₀−θ)+ε(t) 的向量场估计其Lie导数；4. 通过若干技术引理（Fisher-Rao下温度函数 τ 的 η_FR-Lipschitz性、KL与Fisher-Rao范数的等价性、轨迹远离单纯形边界的下界）将Ṽ分解为 (A) 温度项、(B) 线性项、(C) 扰动项并分别界定；5. 利用Young不等式得到指数收敛到Fisher-Rao球的显式界 ε_FR，并以缩放律（δ_n∼n^{−β₀}, μ_n∼cn^p, p>2β₀）对比欧氏度量下的界 ε。

Result: 主定理表明：当人-合成数据比 μ 满足 μ≥max{(1+Tη_FRκ)/(Tδκ), (η+2η_FR/κ)/δ} 时，动力学 (5) 的轨迹以速率 λ>0 指数收敛到大小为 ε_FR=πη√(n·max θ_{e,i})/(√2·κ(μδ−η)(1−2η_FR·max θ_{e,i}/(κ(μδ−η)))) 的 Fisher-Rao 球。命题1进一步对比：在缩放律 δ_n∼n^{−β₀}, μ_n∼cn^p, p>2β₀ 下，欧氏界 ε=Θ(n^{−p})，而Fisher-Rao界 ε_FR=Θ(n^{1/2+β₀−p})。当 p=2β₀+γ（γ>0）时，欧氏界预测 O(1/n) 误差，但Fisher-Rao误差并未受控；为达到 O(1/n) 的Fisher-Rao误差，需要 μ_n∼n^{5/2+γ}，远大于先前欧氏分析所暗示的线性增长 μ_n∼n。

Conclusion: 本文通过显式利用概率单纯形的信息几何结构（Fisher-Rao度量），推导出防止LLM模型崩溃所需人-合成数据比的严格定量下界，所得界在高维下仍然稳健有意义，避免了欧氏度量在高维下的失真。结论是：先前基于欧氏分析所给出的 μ~n 的界实际上过于乐观，实际所需人数据比应随维度至少以 n^{5/2+γ} 增长，才能保证Fisher-Rao度量下的误差受控。该结果为合成数据训练实践提供了更准确的理论指导。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are now routinely trained using synthetic data, since high-quality human data has been exhausted by the ever increasing needs of larger and larger models. However, recursive training on synthetic data frequently induces model collapse, a degenerative feedback loop where models progressively forget the true underlying data distribution. Training on a mixture of synthetic and fresh human data is a logical countermeasure and can prevent model collapse. However, it is an open question as to what is the exact minimum required ratio of human-to-synthetic data to maintain training stability. In this paper, we establish rigorous theoretical guarantees on the minimum rate of human data required to prevent model collapse. Although previous work established a formal lower bound for this ratio, such bound can be vacuous for very high dimensions, as the analysis relies on the usual Euclidean metric in R^n and is not adapted to the space of categorical probability distributions. Instead, in this paper we explicitly leverage the information-geometric structure of the probability simplex by analyzing the dynamics of the process under the Fisher-Rao metric. We derive quantitative contraction and invariance bounds that are stable and do not become trivial as the dimensions increase. Thus, we show that the effective required data ratio to prevent model collapse is different than previously implied.

</details>


### [308] [Changepoint-Aware World Models: Detecting Dynamics Shifts and Recovering by Forgetting Stale Replay in Model-Based RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18950)
*Everest Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CAWM（Changepoint-Aware World Models）是一种基于 DreamerV3 的模型强化学习代理，通过在线 CUSUM 检验检测动力学突变，并遗忘陈旧经验以更快恢复，在两种机器人突变（重力加倍和执行器增益减半）下优于被动再训练和重置动力学模型的基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人的动力学会因执行器磨损、负载变化等发生突变。基于模型的强化学习代理若继续用旧数据训练会恢复缓慢，原因是 replay buffer 中充斥着已过时的经验。需要解决两个问题：能否仅用代理自身信号检测突变，以及检测到后正确的响应方式是什么。

Method: 方法包含两部分：(1) 检测：使用 DreamerV3 自身计算的动力学预测损失 ℒ_dyn 作为信号，对其做滚动尾随基线标准化后，运行单边 CUSUM 检验（S_t = max(0, S_{t-1} + z_t - k)），阈值 h=8，仅对突变响应而不被缓慢学习漂移触发；(2) 响应：检测到后将 replay buffer 截断至最近 N_keep=10⁴ 条转移，保留编码器与策略，使世界模型在新数据上重新拟合动力学。基线 MBCD-style respawn 则在检测到时重新初始化动力学模型头部，对比"丢弃模型"与"丢弃数据"的差异。

Result: 在 walker_walk 任务（三种 seed）下，CAWM 在突变后 30k 帧窗口内比被动基线大幅领先，比 respawn 基线在瞬态窗口获得 +95 至 +153 的回报增益（gravity ×2.0 与 motor-gain ×0.5）。渐近性能与 respawn 相当（+18、+27），但避免了 respawn 的二次崩溃。闭环检测器在突变后 200–1000 帧内触发且无虚警，保留了大部分恢复收益。温和突变（gravity ×1.5）下遗忘策略不再有优势，验证了"仅在旧数据真正过时才有帮助"的条件性结论。

Conclusion: 对于面临突变的模型化代理，关键在于"丢弃什么"——保留表征而遗忘过时数据比丢弃整个动力学模型恢复更快。检测器无需额外网络，复用世界模型自身的损失信号，可直接嵌入 Dreamer 类代理。未来工作包括扩展到更复杂机器人形态、按突变幅度分级遗忘、引入 recency-weighted buffer 和显式模型库等更强基线。

Abstract: A robot's learned model of its own dynamics is only valid until those dynamics change: actuators wear, payloads shift, and joints stiffen. A model-based agent that keeps training as if nothing happened adapts slowly, dragged back by a replay buffer full of stale experience. We present Changepoint-Aware World Models (CAWM), a DreamerV3 agent that detects an abrupt dynamics shift from its own internal prediction error, using an online CUSUM test against a rolling baseline that fires only on abrupt change rather than on slow learning drift. It then forgets stale replay, keeping the learned representation while flushing obsolete data. On simulated locomotion under two robot-relevant shifts, doubled gravity and halved actuator gain, CAWM recovers substantially faster than passive retraining. It also beats a strong baseline that respawns a fresh dynamics model on detection, the deep-world-model analogue of model-bank methods. With the response triggered at the shift, CAWM gains +95 to +153 return in the first 30k post-shift frames over three seeds, while matching that respawn at asymptote. Running the detector in closed loop reproduces this gain on the gravity shift. The benefit holds across both shift types, and is largest when the shift is severe enough that old data is genuinely obsolete.

</details>


### [309] [FedGuide: Diffusion Prior Alignment and Value Baseline Guidance for Heterogeneous Federated Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18964)
*Zhilin He,Gauri Joshi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FedGuide 是一个联邦强化学习框架，通过利用扩散先验作为行为模型来应对异构客户端之间的分布不匹配问题。它使用最优传输混合专家(OT-MoE)聚合扩散先验，并结合分布修正估计(DICE)价值基线来引导本地策略改进，在异构环境下显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦强化学习方法（基于方差缩减、散度惩罚、动量优化等）主要同步策略或价值网络参数，未能明确处理异构客户端之间的分布不匹配问题，限制了FRL在异构环境下的性能。

Method: 1. 使用扩散先验作为行为模型，为异构本地策略学习提供个性化数据支持的分布；2. 通过最优传输混合专家(OT-MoE)在分布空间中聚合扩散先验，保留异构行为模式；3. 开发分布修正估计(DICE)价值基线，提供低方差、回报感知的本地策略改进指导。

Result: 在多种异构环境的实验中，FedGuide 在客户端平均回报、最终轮性能和最差轮鲁棒性方面均优于代表性FRL方法，并在更强的异构性下保持稳定的学习性能。

Conclusion: FedGuide 通过显式处理分布级别的异构性（而非仅仅参数级别的同步），为联邦强化学习提供了一种有效应对环境异构性的新框架，通过扩散先验的个性化与聚合实现了更优的协作策略学习。

Abstract: Federated Reinforcement Learning (FRL) enables collaborative policy learning across distributed agents with heterogeneous environments. While recent methods based on variance reduction, divergence penalization, and momentum optimization improve FRL under heterogeneous settings, they still primarily synchronize policy or value-network parameters and do not explicitly address distributional mismatch among heterogeneous clients. Therefore, we propose \textbf{FedGuide}, a FRL framework that uses diffusion priors as behavior models to provide personalized data supported distributions for heterogeneous local policy learning. Instead of directly averaging local policies, FedGuide aggregates those diffusion priors through Optimal-Transport Mixture-of-Experts (OT-MoE), preserving heterogeneous behavior modes in distribution space. It further develops a Distribution Correction Estimation (DICE) value baseline to provide low-variance, return-aware guidance for local policy improvement. Experiments across heterogeneous environments show that FedGuide outperforms representative FRL methods in client-average returns, final-round performance, and worst-round robustness, while maintaining stable learning under stronger heterogeneity.

</details>


### [310] [The Automaton Underneath: The Additive Input Pathway Is a Parasitic Attractor for State Tracking in Householder Linear RNN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18966)
*Gunner Levi Howe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过预注册的因果消融实验，揭示了Householder线性RNN中加性输入通路 $b_t = W_b e_t$ 是状态跟踪任务长度泛化失败的"寄生吸引子"：删除该通路后，同架构在S₅等非可解群上能达到16倍训练长度的精确泛化，并提出一个关于最小Householder因子数与生成元反射长度相关的表示相对律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DeltaNet/DeltaProduct类线性RNN理论上可表示硬状态跟踪自动机，但训练后无法长度泛化。既有工作将此归因于优化，但缺乏因果解释。作者意图在一个固定架构内通过删除单一加性输入项 $b_t$，提供因果性的损失景观解释。

Method: 采用预注册的同架构因果消融：(a) 在Householder线性RNN中比较保留 vs 删除加性输入 $b_t=W_b e_t$；(b) 跨parity、Z₃、S₄、A₅、S₅五个状态跟踪任务，变化Householder因子数 $n_h$，每格5种子；(c) 两个机制判别臂——从已验证精确解初始化观察加性路径生长；在推理时将 $W_b$ 置零观察恢复效果。

Result: 删除 $b_t$ 后，在律定宽度下所有任务达到位置512精度1.00（含非可解S₅）；最小泛化 $n_h$ 等于任务格式所钉表示中生成元的最大反射长度（parity 1、S₄ 3、A₅/S₅ 4），低于此宽度无法拟合；加性路径是从精确解出发的吸引子；推理时零化 $W_b$ 可在18/20种子中恢复精确泛化。加性通路是寄生的：既不执行拟合也不帮助拟合，其生长既使训练偏离精确解，又掩盖已学到的自动机。

Conclusion: 该工作将表达能力-可学习性差距定位为单一可识别通路（加性输入项），并将问题从"如何让模型学会状态跟踪"重新框架为"如何阻止一条通路劫持并隐藏模型已学到的东西"。提供了一个廉价的诊断工具（推理时零化 $W_b$）。局限：单一架构族、单一优化器与预算、两点生成器词汇、点跟踪格式；mod-3任务即使无 $b_t$ 也漂移。

Abstract: Linear RNNs with input-dependent Householder-product transitions (DeltaNet/DeltaProduct-class) can provably represent hard state-tracking automata, yet trained models fail to length-generalize -- a gap recent work attributes to optimization, without a causal account. We give one, in a pre-registered, within-architecture causal ablation: the same model with one term deleted -- the additive input injection $b_t = W_b e_t$. With $b_t$, models fit length 32 and collapse out-of-distribution on parity, $S_4$, $A_5$, and non-solvable $S_5$ word problems (0.20 at position 512 on $S_5$). Without it -- input acting only through the orthogonal transitions -- the same architecture learns the exact automaton: median accuracy 1.00 at 16x the training length, at every width admitted by a representation law we state and test: the minimal number of Householder factors per token equals the maximal reflection length of the task's generators in the format-pinned representation (parity 1, $S_4$ 3, $A_5$ and $S_5$ 4); below it, nothing fits. The contrast with DeltaProduct's $S_4$/$A_5$ at $n_h{=}2$ (group-element classification, $SO(3)$ realization) shows the law is representation-relative: task format is a hidden variable in state-tracking benchmarks. Two pre-registered arms locate the mechanism. (i) Initialized at a verified-exact solution with $W_b{=}0$, Adam grows the additive path and pulls the model off the exact solution; $-b$ controls stay at 1.00. (ii) Our registered prediction that the fit routes through $b_t$ fired its kill criterion: all 49 fitting seeds retain in-domain fit under $W_b{:=}0$ -- and at law-minimal width, zeroing $W_b$ at inference restores exact generalization (parity 5/5, $S_5$ 5/5, $S_4$ 4/5, $A_5$ 4/5). The additive pathway is parasitic: it destabilizes, then conceals, a correctly learned automaton. All 202 runs pre-registered; all numbers regenerate from artifacts.

</details>


### [311] [One Axis, No Brake: Self-Knowledge Limits the Filtering of Harmful Peer Conformity in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18998)
*Yibo Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文揭示了多智能体LLM系统中一个根本性限制：通过部署时信号过滤有害同伴修订(revision)本质上等价于模型判断自身正确性，而模型的自知(self-knowledge)能力远非完美(AUROC≈0.64–0.89)。即使白盒因果干预也无法突破这一"墙"，且在群体层面会演变为"悬崖"——当多数智能体初始错误时，辩论反而放大共同错误。有效干预必须在修订前增加信息而非事后过滤。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体LLM系统被广泛部署，其前提是通过辩论/投票提高可靠性，但同伴压力同样会推翻正确答案。核心问题是：能否在保留有益修订（修正错误）的同时，过滤有害修订（放弃正确答案）？论文将此实践问题转化为理论可测量的量，揭示其根本约束。

Method: 1) 协议：两轮问答——第一轮独立作答，第二轮看到同伴答案摘要后重新作答；定义修订集F及修订效价V=1−correct₀。2) 命题1（归约）：在修订集上，分辨有害与有益修订等同于读取初始正确性。3) 多种部署时信号测试：覆盖率校准置信门、隐藏状态探针、logistic回归集成、自一致性采样、文本分类器；4) 白盒测试：沿模型自身正确性方向的因果激活引导（CAA线性方向 + SAE特征方向）；5) 群体研究：6–24个智能体的多选"社会"实验，含多样性、少数正确派、强成员等救援测试；6) 均场模型预测群体双稳态分离线p*；7) 跨6个模型家族（含OLMo、Phi、Qwen 1.5B–72B、R1蒸馏模型）的系统验证，延伸至GSM8K/MATH自由生成任务。

Result: 核心发现：（1）"墙"——自我知识AUROC范围0.64–0.89（均值≈0.72），所有部署时信号触及此上限但无法超越；7/8数据单元中y≤x。（2）白盒引导无选择性刹车——在±0.05等效范围内ΔH≈ΔB（有益与有害修订臂同步移动），极端强度下为非选择性共崩。（3）"悬崖"——群体起始≥4:1错误时，置信错误共识率仍达0.41–0.98；6–24智能体规模、多样性（异质社会低于最优成员）、强成员、正确少数派均无法挽回（71–100%被否决）。（4）缓解手段：去相关同伴集减少≈2.2×有害修订；预承诺授权暴露约37%有害修订；事后过滤器无效。均场模型预测的分离线p*≈0.368与观测一致，无需拟合。

Conclusion: 过滤有害同伴修订本质上是自知问题，受限于模型不完美的自我认知能力。该限制在个体层面是"墙"，在群体层面是"悬崖"——群体无法通过内部动力学在硬题上自我修正。可靠降低不确定性需在修订前增加模型不持有的信息：更好的校准或独立验证器，而非对对话的后处理过滤。设计含义：在困难问题上，单纯增加智能体数量或多样性与悬崖效应相权衡；而接入一个能通向真值的外通道的验证器才是改变结果的关键。"局部一致不等于全局正确"。

Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems are expected to be more reliable because agents can catch each other's mistakes. But peer pressure cuts both ways: the same correction that fixes a wrong answer can overturn a right one. The tempting safeguard is a brake that keeps the beneficial revisions and blocks the harmful ones. We show this brake is hard to build, for a simple reason: a revision is harmful exactly when the original answer was right, so deciding whether to block it is the same as knowing whether the model was already correct. This turns the open-ended hunt for a brake into one measurable quantity, the model's self-knowledge: any brake built from a deploy-time signal is a correctness probe in disguise, and self-knowledge is far from perfect (AUROC $\approx 0.64$--$0.89$ across six model families). We call this ceiling the wall. Even white-box steering of the model's own correctness direction does not breach it: it changes how often the model revises, but harmful and beneficial revisions move together. At population scale the wall becomes the cliff: when most agents start wrong, debate amplifies the shared mistake into a confident, wrong consensus. In our multiple-choice societies, more agents, more model diversity, and a stronger member do not fix it. What helps is adding information before the revision, not filtering after it. Local agreement is not global correctness.

</details>


### [312] [Capability Emergence Can Be Forecast: Per-Seed, In Advance, With Calibrated Intervals, Certified False Alarms, and a Blind Pre-Registered Gate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19000)
*Gunner Levi Howe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出并验证了一套用于预测Transformer训练过程中能力涌现时间的方法论与协议。作者在466次grokking实验和118次语言模型实验中发现，基于机制性前驱电路（如前一个token注意力头）的形成时间，可在每个随机种子上提前预测归纳头（induction head）能力的涌现时刻，并通过了预注册盲测门控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 能力涌现通常表现为损失曲线平滑下降而特定能力突然出现，这种不可预测性是前沿AI安全的重要隐患。已有研究提出多种早期预警信号，但缺乏作为"预测"严格评分的工作：无提前量与误报率的联合控制、无校准、无负样本、无盲测验证。论文旨在建立这种严格的预测评估学科。

Method: 方法论核心包括：(1) 严格定义事件、提前量、误报率，使用绝对行为标准而非相对阈值；(2) 构造三类负样本（预算截断、结构性阻断、人工制造），人工制造负样本通过数据消融或架构修改使能力无法形成；(3) 预注册冻结预测规则，使用分共形校准区间（split-conformal intervals）量化不确定性；(4) 采用机制组合锚点（电路信号与行为信号合取）而非单一信号；(5) 通过预注册的盲测门控验证冻结规则的可迁移性；(6) 探索比例不变的涌现律（t_event ≈ 1.19 × t_anchor）。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 在30个相同配置的Transformer中，前驱形成时间预测归纳头涌现的Spearman ρ=0.977，中位提前量975步（约训练量的15%）；(2) 分共形区间在15/15保留种子上达到标称90%覆盖；(3) 冻结规则在两个未见配置上通过盲测门控（10/10和9/10覆盖）；(4) 陷阱语言测试中裸前驱信号误报10/10，但机制组合锚点在两种语言下均通过认证（0误报），ρ=1.000；(5) 80次有效锚点实验发现比例律 t_event ≈ 1.19 × t_anchor（中位0.843），在第三个盲测门控中5/5覆盖；(6) 33个人工制造负样本上误报率为零；(7) 在Pythia、OLMo、OLMo-2三个模型家族、七个公开套件中前驱均领先于能力出现。

Conclusion: 结论：对于具有已知机制前驱的具名能力，在小型Transformer中，涌现时间可按种子逐次提前预测约15%训练量，具有校准区间、认证误报率和盲测验证。核心贡献是建立了涌现预测的评估学科——人工制造负样本、（相关性、提前量）配对报告、误报率上限与最小负样本数、绝对事件标准、预注册冻结。已确认但不适用于前沿部署的局限包括：需要已知前驱、大规模可行前缺乏制造负样本的能力、配方变化会破坏定标校准、比例律的分数值（0.843）尚未解释。论文发布了所有数据、代码和预注册链。

Abstract: Emergent capabilities are widely treated as unpredictable: loss improves smoothly while abilities appear abruptly. Prior work offers early-warning indicators but never scores them as forecasts: no lead time at controlled false-alarm rate, no calibration, no negatives, no blind tests. We supply that discipline and show that, in grokking model systems and small language models, emergence timing is forecastable per run, in advance, with calibrated uncertainty. Across 30 transformers at identical configuration, the formation time of the previous-token head forecasts each seed's induction-head emergence at Spearman rho=0.977 with median lead 975 steps (~15% of training); a best-case loss rule ties the ranking with 50-step lead (a nowcast). Conformal intervals covered 15/15 held-out seeds, and the frozen rule passed blind pre-registered gates on TWO never-seen configurations (10/10 and 9/10 coverage). A trap-language rung then attacked our own rule as pre-registered: where previous-token context pays for the task itself, the bare precursor false-alarms on 10/10 capability-blocked runs, while the mechanism-composed conjunction is certified in both language classes (0 false alarms) and times emergence at rho=1.000. Finally, a gap-origin study broke the fixed offset (both lr and batch move the gap ~2.3x; no external clock owns it) and revealed the law beneath: across 80 valid-anchor runs the anchor fires at 0.843 of time-to-emergence -- t_event ~= 1.19 x t_anchor -- and this multiplicative rule passed its own blind gate (5/5) at a third unseen configuration. False alarms are certified against 33 manufactured negatives. The precursor leads across 3 public model families (Pythia, OLMo, OLMo-2; 7 suites), with OLMo-2 at 1B tokens showing precursor formed, capability absent. Four pre-registered kill criteria fired and are reported. Every freeze precedes its data in a public commit chain.

</details>


### [313] [CompileRover: Revolutionizing Virtual Machine Compiler Optimization with a Tri-Role LLM-Driven Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19004)
*Mingqiao Mo,Yunlong Tan,Hao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CompileRover是一个面向虚拟机(VM)编译器的端到端LLM驱动优化框架，采用"裁判(Referee)-顾问(Advisors)-操作员(Operator)"三角色协作机制，结合MCTS与Q-learning搜索优化路径，并通过DISC指标保障语义一致性，在跨架构与跨编译器场景下显著优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有虚拟机编译器输出常存在冗余计算、低效循环结构和次优函数实现等性能瓶颈；传统基于规则的方法难以适配异构工具链，机器学习方法又受限于数据集多样性与GPU资源，而现有LLM代码优化框架难以保持控制流完整性与语义对齐，且缺乏动态知识整合机制。

Method: 三阶段流水线：(1)数据处理阶段用BPE-dropout进行文本分词并提取运行时指标；(2)优化引擎构建"优化圆环(OC)"，由Referee做语义校验、四个专门Advisor(语义一致性SCA、数据流DFA、控制流CFA、ISA)提议优化候选、Operator执行代码变换，候选路径通过MCTS生成并以Q-learning评估长程价值；(3)验证系统采用基于余弦相似度的语义漂移过滤(阈值0.85)和DISC度量(融合寄存器一致性RC、控制流完整性CFI、指令语义等价ISE，阈值0.7)结合AddressSanitizer做正确性验证。训练语料覆盖1800+ Ubuntu C/C++包在x86_64/ARM-v8a下经GCC-7/9/11与Clang-9/11/12五个优化级别编译。

Result: 在BLEU、ROUGE-L、METEOR与余弦相似度等指标上优化后获得25%–55%的提升；DISC分数在六种编译器配置下普遍提升12%–18%(o3-后端)与5%–7%(gemini-2后端)；跨架构加速比最高达3.8×(Fibonacci)、3.6×(矩阵乘)、3.5×(数值精度)，并新增RISC-V可移植性3.2×；消融实验表明3个Advisor为精度与延迟的最佳折衡(85.8% DISC、漂移率1/100、1.2×延迟)；不同LLM后端(GPT-4o、Gemini-2.5、Claude 3.5等)DISC分数稳定在83%–88%。

Conclusion: CompileRover通过角色专业化、语义感知优化与GPU-free的轻量强化学习搜索，在异构编译环境中可靠地兼顾性能提升与语义保持，是首个同时支持强化学习接口、实时性能分析、跨平台与零样本优化的编译器优化框架；但在大型代码库(>10,000行)上存在40%编译时间增长，且绝对编译速度仍远慢于GCC。

Abstract: Code optimization plays a crucial role in the development of virtual machine compilers, with optimization frameworks significantly enhancing the performance of generated assembly code. However, existing virtual machine compiler outputs frequently exhibit redundant computations, inefficient loop structures, and suboptimal function implementations, which collectively impair execution efficiency. To address these shortcomings, we propose CompileRover, an advanced optimization framework specifically designed for virtual machine compilers. CompileRover employs a sophisticated three-role collaboration mechanism, comprising a referee, an advisor, and an operator, effectively overcoming performance bottlenecks by leveraging comprehensive optimization algorithms and novel methodologies, including control flow analysis, code structure transformations, and dynamic execution pattern recognition. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that CompileRover consistently surpasses state-of-the-art virtual machine compilers, achieving significant improvements in execution performance across various benchmarks. Furthermore, performance analyses validate that the introduced optimizations notably reduce execution overhead, improve dataflow consistency, and robustly enhance compiler performance, showcasing CompileRover as an effective and reliable approach to optimizing virtual machine compilers.

</details>


### [314] [TwinMark: A Unified Watermark for Provable Survival Under Feature and Logit Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19011)
*Redwanul Karim,Tobias Feigl,Christopher Mutschler,Felix Ott*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 TwinMark，一种统一的水印方案，通过两个互补的线性泛函（cov-Feat 和 cc-FALC）从单一 SHAKE128 密钥中读取水印秘密，覆盖分类器 API（KL 知识蒸馏）和仅表示宿主（特征匹配 KD）两种部署接口，在 KD 攻击下提供可证明的存活保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型水印方案存在两大缺陷：(1) 单通道方案仅保护分类器 API（logit 端）或仅表示宿主（特征端）中的一类部署接口，无法同时应对两种 KD 攻击模式；(2) 参数扰动代理（ℓp-ball）下的鲁棒性证书与 KD 实际收缩的几何度量不匹配，导致缺乏在 KD 几何下的形式化存活保证；堆叠两个独立水印又会倍增攻击面，易被通道选择性移除。

Method: 方法核心是"一个密钥、两个线性泛函"。从 SHAKE128 派生出所有非训练缓冲区（载体集、比特向量、类别签名矩阵、FALC 基、协方差投影器）。特征端 cov-Feat 通过 Frobenius 内积 ⟨W_k, Σ_C^T⟩ 读取载体集协方差，由协方差拟合铰链损失保证边际 m_cov。logit 端 cc-FALC 将每类 FALC 有效载荷叠加到分类器头上 z_T(x) = z_T^base(x) + α·G·C·ω_{y(x)}，由最小概率下限和正交损失支撑。验证统一为 s_k(F) = ⟨A_k, T(F)⟩ 模板，由部署场景限制的 OR 规则（FM-KD 仅看特征侧，KL-KD 仅看 logit 侧）裁定，并采用校准零假设最大统计量与二项比特投票双测试。理论证明 cov-Feat 在算子范数下取得严格优于 Frobenius-Cauchy-Schwarz 的秩盲证书，cc-FALC 通过居中 logit-gap 直接绕过 softmax-Pinsker 链中的温度、中心倾斜和 Schur 特征值项。

Result: 在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、Mini-ImageNet 上的 13 种攻击下，TwinMark 在所有保留任务效用的格点上验证成功，存活跨架构蒸馏（ResNet-18/50、VGG-16、MobileNet-V3），并迁移至 GNSS 少样本、VOC 检测、ISIC 分割及 STL-10 SimCLR。cc-FALC 在 CIFAR-100 的 m=100 类中嵌入 K=1024 比特（10.24× 过编码），位投票达 z=23.0σ，教师准确率代价仅为 +0.9±0.2 个百分点；位重建模式（K≤32, BER≤0.05）可精确恢复密钥串。

Conclusion: TwinMark 通过统一的线性泛函模板消除了"单通道覆盖盲区"与"参数代理证书不匹配"两大水印空缺，提供在 KD 几何下可证明存活的双通道版权保护，且具备跨架构、跨任务的可迁移性与远高于类数的容量上界（K≤mP）。其局限包括比较空间剥离、自适应密钥探测与 top-k-only API 不在认证威胁模型内。

Abstract: We propose TwinMark, a watermarking scheme that reads a single SHAKE128 secret through two complementary linear functionals of model-output summaries: a covariance projector against the carrier-set covariance (cov-Feat) and a class-conditional Fisher-aligned linear carrier decoded from class-mean logits (cc-FALC). The two readouts share one bit vector and cover the two extraction surfaces of a deployed vision model: a classifier API attacked by KL knowledge distillation (KD) (Std. KL-KD), and a representation-only host attacked by feature-matching KD (FM-KD). Each readout admits a teacher-measurable a posteriori certificate that lower-bounds post-distillation detection power, and the two channels combine under a regime-restricted OR rule whose test statistic (calibrated null or bit vote) is selected by the exposed surface. cov-Feat admits a rank-blind operator-norm certificate, cc-FALC admits a centered-logit-gap certificate that decouples bit capacity from class count: at K=1024 in m=100 classes (a 10.24x over-encoding), the bit-vote attains z=23.0 sigma at a teacher-accuracy cost of +0.9+-0.2%p. Across 13 attacks on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Mini-ImageNet, TwinMark verifies on every cell whose post-attack model retains task utility, survives cross-architecture distillation onto ResNet-18/50, VGG-16, and MobileNet-V3, and ports to GNSS few-shot, VOC detection, ISIC segmentation, and STL-10 SimCLR.

</details>


### [315] [Integrated Optimization of Automated Warehouse Operations and Last-Mile Transport for Differentiated On-Demand Delivery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19048)
*Xiaozhu Sun,Bilal Farooq*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对差异化按需配送场景，提出了一种集成优化智能仓库AGV调度与最后一公里多式联运的深度强化学习框架。内部仓库采用MORM-AGDQN算法（结合多奖励机与A*引导的深度Q网络），外部配送采用MRMH-HCVRP算法（结合多奖励与多头注意力的异构容量车辆路径规划），通过Pareto前沿实现内外系统的动态衔接。实验表明该框架显著优于传统方法：仓储准时率达100%，最后一公里平均配送时间减少29.3%–53.2%，总运输距离减少46.4%，高优先级服务率提升至92%以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电商与即时配送的快速发展要求物流系统具备高吞吐、低成本与高服务水平的能力。但现有研究通常将仓库内部调度与外部最后一公里配送独立优化，难以在动态约束下实现全局最优。同时，多目标权衡（能耗、安全、库存、客户优先级）、异构车队调度以及高优先级订单的差异化服务是当前物流系统的核心难题。因此，亟需一种能够联动内外系统、兼顾多目标的集成优化方法。

Method: 1. **双架构MDP建模**：将仓库内部AGV调度建模为合作式多智能体MDP，将外部异构车队路径规划建模为另一个MDP，通过状态向量（含Pareto前沿优先级）实现信息互通。2. **MORM-AGDQN（仓库内部）**：多通道状态张量（环境、外部因素、AGV状态、订单属性）→ CNN特征提取（3层Conv+3层FC）→ A*引导的ε-greedy策略；设计四个奖励机（RM_En、RM_In、RM_Ex、RM_Sa）分别编码能耗、库存、外部影响与安全，并采用指数加权的Pareto层优先级奖励。3. **MRMH-HCVRP（外部配送）**：基于Transformer架构，编码器采用多头注意力捕获地理、优先级、时间窗、容量与交通特征；解码器分车辆选择与节点选择两层，奖励由优先级、时间与拥堵三项乘积构成。4. **集成机制**：通过3D Pareto前沿将外部因素翻译为时间敏感的AGV拣选序列，作为外部调度的输入。5. **场景设计**：基于Amazon真实配送数据构建基线、峰值与不确定性三类仿真场景。

Result: 1. **算法性能**：MORM-AGDQN在1000回合训练中收敛平滑、累积奖励高于DQN/PG/AGDQN/MO-AGDQN，并能从小规模（17单）泛化至大规模（96单）。MRMH-HCVRP在44–49次迭代内收敛，电动车短距成本降低44.2%，摩托车降低42.6%，货车长距提升63.6%。2. **路径规划对比**：MRMH-HCVRP总距离272.67 km（最优）、总时间3.41 h（最短），快速交付率与优先率均达92%/93.62%，显著优于时间序列聚类、最短路径聚类与HCVRP。3. **KPI提升**：仓储准时出库与拣选率100%，平均履约时间9.85 min；外部平均配送时间58 min（较FIFO减少29%），总里程209 km（减少46.4%），准时率97.06%，高优先级满意度92.31%；系统综合高优先级服务率78.11%，平均完成时间缩短27.5%至66.38 min。

Conclusion: 本文提出的集成MORL框架通过双网络架构与多奖励机机制，实现了仓库内部AGV调度与外部异构车队路径规划的协同优化，在效率、服务水平与运营成本之间取得了良好平衡。实验证明跨决策层级的信息互通对高密度、时间敏感的物流场景至关重要。未来工作可结合数字孪生、量子计算与更细粒度的实时交通信息，进一步提升方法的可扩展性与鲁棒性。

Abstract: In the context of differentiated on-demand goods delivery services, this study proposes an integrated optimization method for automated guided vehicles (AGVs) based smart warehouse operations and the last-mile multi-modal transport. A deep reinforcement learning algorithm for multi-objective joint scheduling is designed to establish a dynamic connection between two systems, solving key challenges such as achieving high-throughput continuous order scheduling, meeting competing requirements, and improving the overall system sensitivity and adaptability. For warehouse optimization within this framework, we propose an improved algorithm based on multi-objective, Multi-Reward Machines-A* Guided Deep Q-Network (MORM-AGDQN), which combines service level, system cost, and external transportation demand. For external optimization, we propose an improved algorithm based on a Multi-Reward, Multi Head attention-Heterogeneous Capacity Vehicle Routing Problem (MRMH-HCVRP) framework, which incorporates the optimized scheduling order sequence and grouping, combined with customer location, demand, and priority, vehicle capacity, speed, and service range. The results show that the proposed framework significantly outperforms traditional methods, achieving 100% on-time delivery rate for warehousing operations. After joint optimization, the average delivery time for the last mile was reduced by 29.3% to 53.2%, the total transportation distance was reduced by 46.4%, the high-priority service rate was increased to over 92%, and a balance was maintained between operating costs and customer satisfaction.

</details>


### [316] [LightSleepX: A Lightweight, Inception-Based Dual-Modal Network for Sleep Staging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19062)
*Yi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LightSleepX 是一个用于睡眠分期的轻量级双模态（EEG/EOG）深度学习框架。该模型结合了多分支 Inception 风格特征提取器（采用深度可分离卷积）、多尺度增强注意力（MEA）融合模块和双向 Mamba 编码器，仅用 0.049M 参数和 195.9 MFLOPs，即可在 Sleep-EDF-20、Sleep-EDF-78 及 ISRUC-S3 数据集上达到当前最优性能（特别是在 ISRUC-S3 上 accuracy 提升了 5 个百分点）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有睡眠分期深度学习模型虽准确但参数量大、计算开销高，难以部署在资源受限的家庭或可穿戴设备上，且云端处理存在隐私问题；而传统基于手工特征和浅层模型的方法泛化能力差。该研究旨在填补精度与效率之间的鸿沟，实现本地化、保护隐私的睡眠监测。

Method: 1. 输入：S=10 个连续 30 秒 epoch 的 EEG/EOG 原始信号；2. 多分支 Inception 风格特征提取器（核大小 {3,5,7}，各分支用深度可分离卷积）独立提取单 epoch 特征；4. EEG/EOG 沿通道拼接后经多尺度增强注意力（MEA）做通道加权融合；5. 双向 Mamba 编码器（含前向与反向两个选择性 SSM 分支）对 epoch 序列建模长程时序依赖；6. MLP 分类头输出 5 类别概率。训练使用 Adam（lr=1e-3）、Dynamic Focal Loss（γ=2.0）和 100 epoch 早停。

Result: Sleep-EDF-20：ACC 85.9%、Macro-F1 80.7、κ=0.81；Sleep-EDF-78：ACC 82.6%、Macro-F1 78.7、κ=0.77（N1 F1 达 63.0%，SOTA）；ISRUC-S3（10 折交叉被试）：ACC 81.80%、Macro-F1 0.796、κ=0.761，较 DAN 提升超 5 个百分点。模型仅 0.049M 参数、195.9 MFLOPs，比 SeqSleepNet 小约 3.3 倍、比 TinySleepNet 小约 22 倍。消融实验验证了 Inception 主干、MEA 融合及 Mamba 编码器均为关键组件。

Conclusion: LightSleepX 通过 Inception 多尺度特征提取、MEA 多模态融合和 Mamba 长程时序建模的协同设计，在保持极小参数量的同时实现了 SOTA 睡眠分期性能，特别在跨被试泛化和少数类 N1 识别上表现突出，适合在资源受限、保护隐私的边缘/家庭场景部署。未来工作将扩展多生理信号（EMG、ECG）、硬件感知优化（量化/剪枝）以及半监督与域自适应方法。

Abstract: Automatic sleep staging is fundamental to personal health monitoring, yet many existing approaches are ill-suited for real-world applications. Traditional pipelines often rely on hand-crafted features or shallow machine learning models that struggle to generalize, while state-of-the-art deep learning methods, though accurate, are computationally heavy and impractical for resource-constrained environments. This paper introduces LightSleepX, a lightweight framework designed to deliver robust sleep analysis in resource-constrained environments. LightSleepX combines an Inception-style architecture with depthwise separable convolutions and Multi-scale Enhanced Attention for efficient multi-modal EEG/EOG feature extraction, and a Mamba encoder for rule-free long-range temporal modeling. On public benchmark datasets, LightSleepX achieves 85.9% accuracy and a 0.803 macro-F1 score on Sleep-EDF-20, and 81.8% accuracy and a 0.796 macro-F1 score on the cross-subject ISRUC-S3 dataset. With 0.049M parameters and 195.9 MFLOPs, the framework targets practical local deployment where computational cost and privacy are central constraints.

</details>


### [317] [Evidence-Grounded Agentic Formulation Development in an Autonomous Laboratory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19099)
*Michael M. Craig,Riley J. Hickman,Yingshan Ma,Rémi Piché-Taillefer,Christine Allen,Pauric Bannigan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Andromeda 2，一种基于证据驱动的智能体（agentic）系统，用于自乳化药物递送系统（SEDDS）的自动化配方开发。该系统在紫杉醇（paclitaxel）这一难溶性药物上显著优于传统概率优化（Andromeda 1）和实验设计（DoE）方法，在固定实验预算内实现了更高的命中率、更多满足目标产品特性（TPP）的配方，以及约 3.3 倍于已发表 S-SEDDS 配方的有效载药量。消融实验表明，结构化的内部实验证据使平均 AUC 提升了 34%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SEDDS 配方开发需要同时优化油、表面活性剂、助溶剂、载药量等多种参数，设计空间巨大，传统 DoE 或概率优化方法通常从零开始学习性能地形，难以利用跨项目积累的实验知识。因此，研究者希望探索：能否让自主实验室系统利用已有的结构化内部实验证据，更有效地分配有限的湿实验预算？

Method: Andromeda 2 是一个基于 LLM 的智能体系统，它在共享的配方语境上进行提议（proposal）、批判（critique）、规划（planning）和约束检查，并通过调用概率模型等工具构建 16 个配方的批次。关键特征包括：(1) 启动时即接入 Intrepid 的结构化内部配方证据（不含紫杉醇数据），(2) 确定性可行性引擎强制执行湿实验约束，(3) 配方科学家仅做安全和可行性审查，不重新设计。在相同的微型化自动化实验室平台上，以匹配的 96 个配方预算与 Andromeda 1（无历史证据的概率优化）、实验 DoE 以及一个减少证据的 Andromeda 2 消融配置进行基准比较。主要评价指标为 FaSSIF 中 10–240 min 的 AUC（Trapzoidal），辅以四个 TPP 目标（最小溶解 AUC、240 min 浓度下限、240 min 溶出比例、沉淀抗性比 C240/C30≥0.85）。

Result: 在紫杉醇上：(1) Andromeda 2 的高 AUC 命中率为 50%，远高于 Andromeda 1 的 17% 和 DoE 的 2%；中位 AUC 分别为 70.1、12.0 和 3.5 mg·min/mL。(2) Andromeda 2 识别出 12 个满足全部四项 TPP 的配方，而 Andromeda 1 仅 6 个，DoE 为 0。(3) 最高 AUC 方面两者相近（157.7 vs 156.4），说明优势在于整体分布的上移而非单一最优点。(4) 证据消融实验显示，接入结构化内部证据使平均 AUC 提升 34%，且减少了后期批次的性能退化。(5) 在 Type IIIB/IV 区域内，Andromeda 2 的命中率仍达 49%，高于 Andromeda 1 的 29%，说明优势不能简单归结为定位到高产区域。(6) 选定配方的有效载药量约 19±5% w/w，约为已发表 S-SEDDS（5.7% w/w）的 3.3 倍。

Conclusion: 证据驱动的智能体设计能够显著提高 SEDDS 配方开发的实验效率。在固定实验预算下，Andromeda 2 通过结合自主实验与基于历史证据的智能体决策，能比概率优化或 DoE 更频繁地识别出高性能配方。结构化的内部实验证据是这一优势的重要组成部分，支持对新 API 更高效的顺序适应。研究支持一种将实验数据作为可复用证据积累、从而使配方开发随机构知识增长而渐进提效的范式，但仍需跨 API 复现、消化耦合测试及体内药代研究来验证其泛化性和转化价值。

Abstract: Self-emulsifying drug delivery systems (SEDDS) can improve the oral bioavailability of poorly soluble drugs, but identifying high-performing formulations remains experimentally intensive. We present Andromeda 2, an agentic system that reasons over structured in-house experimental evidence and invokes computational and experimental tools to design and execute successive formulation batches. Using a miniaturized automated laboratory at a matched budget, we benchmark it against Andromeda 1, a probabilistic optimization model deployed across dozens of live development projects, and a wet-lab design-of-experiments (DoE) campaign. For paclitaxel, Andromeda 2 achieved a 50% high-performance hit rate versus 17% for Andromeda 1 and 2% for DoE, and identified 12 formulations meeting all four target product profile (TPP) objectives versus 6 and 0, respectively. Median $AUC_{10-240}$ was 70.1, 12.0, and 3.5 mg$\cdot$min/mL, while maximum AUC was comparable between Andromeda 2 and Andromeda 1. A selected full-TPP formulation achieved an apparent effective paclitaxel loading of $19 \pm 5\%$ w/w at the first FaSSIF measurement, approximately 3.3-fold higher than the 5.7% w/w loading reported for a published paclitaxel S-SEDDS. A controlled ablation showed that access to structured in-house experimental evidence increased mean AUC by 34%.

</details>


### [318] [How Model Growth, Recursion, and Boundary Operators Influence Scaling Exponents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19107)
*Zixi Chen,Akshay Vegesna,Samip Dahal,Andrew Gordon Wilson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文挑战"架构干预仅能影响scaling law常数项"的传统观点，证明模型生长（model growth）、循环（looping）和边界算子（boundary operator）等架构干预能够改变scaling指数，从而在预训练中实现随计算量增加而指数级增长的性能提升。7.4B的模型生长架构在CORE基准上以约20倍更少的计算量匹配GPT-3 13B的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统观点认为架构变化只能影响scaling law的常数项，而无法改变指数项。本文探索是否存在架构干预能够改变scaling指数，从而在计算预算增加时获得超越常数因子的复利效益。核心动机是"计算深度"概念：在固定计算预算下，希望最大化transformer的可有效利用深度。

Method: 以prelude-core-coda结构的looped transformer为基础架构家族，通过三个独立轴进行匹配对比：(1)边界算子（Boundary Operator，BO=h+e的归一化与前奏注入）与标准transformer对比；(2)权重共享（tied vs untied）；(3)模型生长（训练中增加core pass数，从K=2增长到K=4）。在FineWeb和FineWeb-Edu上拟合每个架构的compute-optimal配方（分四个阶段：基础超参→TPP→生长时机→学习率缩放规则），对比单epoch和多epoch（数据受限）设置。

Result: 1) 边界算子本身就能改善scaling指数：在10^20 FLOPs时，Operator-1相对Vanilla达到1.25×计算效率倍数；2) Untied-Grow效果最佳，在10^20 FLOPs时达到1.55×，在10^25 FLOPs时外推达2.7×；3) 7.4B Untied-Grow在1.23×10^21 FLOPs下达到CORE 0.3865，与GPT-3 13B的0.3852相当，计算量减少约20×；4) 权重共享仅改善常数项而不改善指数项；5) 多epoch设置中，最优循环次数随计算量增加而增加，缩放循环次数比缩放模型大小节省2.2×计算量；6) 生长时机存在内点最优，token分配倾向于较小的初始模型+更多token。

Conclusion: 架构干预确实可以改变scaling law的指数项，这一现象可从"计算深度"视角理解：边界算子缓解了"深度诅咒"（使每层都有贡献），模型生长避免了早期为不需要的深度付费。这些效果随深度增加而增大，由于compute-optimal模型随计算预算变深，因此带来随尺度增大的计算效率优势。在数据受限的多epoch场景中，循环成为更优的容量扩展方式，权重共享充当正则化器。该研究强调评估新架构时应区分常数项改进和指数项改进。

Abstract: Scaling laws predict how loss decreases with increases in computation. We show, contrary to conventional wisdom, that architectural interventions can modify scaling exponents in pre-training, leading to exponential improvements in performance with increases in computation. As an anchoring point, we consider the architectural formulation of looped transformers. Although not typically used in this way, looping, also known as recursive depth, provides a mechanism for model growth, by increasing the number of loops during training. Model growth, with and without shared weights, provides the biggest changes to the scaling exponents. In particular, a 7.4B model growth architecture matches GPT-3 13B on CORE with roughly $20\times$ less compute, and has compute efficiency gains that increase with scale. Moreover, simply using a boundary operator in a vanilla transformer, which normalizes and injects an earlier block, also provides increasing compute-efficiency gains, although to a lesser extent. In the data-constrained, multi-epoch setting, standard looping has a useful regularizing effect, where we find it is compute-optimal to increase the number of loops with scale. These results can be understood through the lens of computational depth: for a given computational budget, we wish to increase the usable depth of the transformer, which can lead to efficiency gains that increase with scale.

</details>


### [319] [Exponential Hardness of Off-Policy Evaluation under History-Dependent Logging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19135)
*Pranaya Jajoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了在历史依赖的记录策略下，即使满足常数级的动作覆盖、信念覆盖和行为边际结果揭示条件，部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）中的离线策略评估（OPE）仍然具有指数级样本复杂度下限Θ((3/2)^H log(1/δ))。作者构造了两个仅含2个潜在状态、3个动作的简单POMDP，通过"门控重置"机制擦除关于目标策略值的关键转移信息，并证明即使候选模型和目标策略完全已知，任何(1/8, δ)-精确估计器都需要指数级样本。文章还给出了精确的统计降维（三符号实验）、匹配的最优估计器，以及在有向双车道网格世界中的仿真验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Zhang和Jiang (2025) 在其猜想中指出，在历史依赖记录、基于模型、多步揭示的设定下，OPE可能具有难处理性，但未给出证明。本文旨在回答这一开放问题：能否在满足强覆盖和揭示条件的同时，仍然需要指数级样本来评估目标策略的值？

Method: 方法包括：(1) 构造两个POMDP候选模型M₀和M₁，共享相同的记录策略（具有3个记忆标签）和目标策略（总是选择"继续"动作），两者仅在第一个转移上有所不同；(2) 通过有向双车道网格世界实现，记录策略依赖历史动作而非观察；(3) 使用二元测试归约（Le Cam方法）推导样本复杂度下界，D_KL(P₀||P₁) = p_H log(3)/2，其中p_H = (1/3)(2/3)^(H-2) 指数衰减；(4) 通过三符号降维（将轨迹映射为{⊥, 0, 1}）精确刻画统计实验；(5) 推导最优估计器（似然比检验 + 平局公平抛硬币）及其有限样本误差界；(6) 使用Chebyshev不等式和Cauchy-Schwarz不等式证明覆盖常数的界；(7) 在网格世界中进行仿真验证，使用256-512个独立数据集。

Result: 主要定理（定理4.1）：对于每个H≥3，构造的POMDP类满足：(i) 每个阶段至多2个潜在状态，3个动作；(ii) 记录策略对每个动作分配至少1/6概率；(iii) 覆盖常数C_A=6, C_H=3, C_F=35/9, C̃_F=9均与H无关；(iv) 评估确定性目标策略至1/8精度需要n ≥ 2·kl(1-δ,δ)/(p_H log 3)个轨迹，即Θ((3/2)^H log(1/δ))的指数级下界。匹配上界由最优估计器达到（推论4.2）。仿真结果在H∈{4,8,12,16,20,24}上验证了精确风险预测，90%成功率预算从43（H=4）增长到143,982（H=24）。信息控制实验表明，下界确实是由于目标路径的稀有性造成的。

Conclusion: 本文建立了历史依赖记录、模型已知情况下OPE的指数级难处理性，回应了Zhang和Jiang (2025)的猜想。核心机制是"门控重置"——一旦发生重置，记录策略的最后一个重置动作就确定了通道，使得在重置后的所有后续观察在两个候选模型下具有相同分布。关键洞见在于：覆盖条件是关于当前状态的，而目标值评估需要的是关于过去转移的信息；这两者可以通过构造分离。该结果表明，仅有行为边际揭示条件不足以保证多项式样本复杂度，正面结果需要额外的结构将记录策略的延续与实际历史联系起来（联合状态覆盖、遗忘性或信息性受控未来）。证明已在Lean 4中形式化验证。

Abstract: Can a logged dataset visit every hidden state frequently and still be exponentially uninformative about a target policy's value? We show that it can when the logger depends on history. For every horizon $H \ge 3$, we construct two POMDPs with at most two latent states per stage, three actions, and a common logger with three memory states. Action coverage, belief coverage, and two behavior-marginal outcome-revealing conditions all have constants independent of $H$. Nevertheless, evaluating a known deterministic target policy to accuracy $1/8$ requires $\Theta((3/2)^H \log(1/\delta))$ logged episodes at confidence $1-\delta$, for $0 < \delta \le 1/4$, even when both candidate models are known. The mechanism is simple: a reset erases the unknown transition that determines the target value. We characterize the resulting statistical experiment exactly and obtain a matching optimal estimator. A directed two-lane gridworld realizes the construction, and trajectory simulations agree with its finite-sample prediction. The result establishes intractability for the history-dependent-logging, model-based case posed by Zhang and Jiang (2025, arXiv:2503.01134 ), under their behavior-marginal definition of revealing.

</details>


### [320] [On Predicting Post-Click Conversion Rate via Counterfactual Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.04816)
*Junhyung Ahn,Sanghack Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ESCIM（Entire Space Counterfactual Inference Multi-task Model）通过结构因果模型（SCM）对未点击样本进行反事实推断，回答"如果用户点击了推荐商品，是否会转化"，生成反事实转化标签以缓解点击后转化率（CVR）预测中的样本选择偏差和数据稀疏问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CVR预测模型仅基于点击样本训练（因转化只能在点击后观察到），面临两大挑战：①样本选择偏差（MNAR）——点击样本不能代表全部曝光空间；②数据稀疏性——点击和转化数据极少（如Ali-CCP仅3.85%曝光被点击，0.55%点击转化）。现有方法ESMM、ESCM²、DCMT存在局限性：ESMM高估CVR、ESCM²正则化器依赖稀缺点击样本、DCMT简单地将所有未点击样本反事实标签设为1导致分布偏移。

Method: 1. **构建SCM**：因果图包含用户-物品特征X→点击C、点击C、特征X、外生变量Z→转化V，点击与转化→CTCVR事件T，其中Z~N(0,I)为转化的外生隐变量。2. **反事实推断三步**：预训练MLP f_θ(x,z)建模V；用VAE g_φ变分推断后验p(Z|X,C,V)；对未点击样本执行do(C=1)干预；采样Z后预测反事实pCVR。3. **标签转换**：两种方法——max方法（pCVR超过点击样本最大pCVR则标1）和ratio方法（按比例选择top-k个标1）。4. **多任务训练**：结合CTR、CTCVR、事实CVR损失（IPS加权）和反事实CVR损失进行联合优化。

Result: 1. **离线实验**（Ali-CCP与Ali-Express数据集，MLP/DeepFM/AutoInt/DCN-V2骨干）：ESCIM在所有骨干上一致优于ESMM、Multi-IPS/DR、ESCM²-IPS/DR、DCMT等基线；CVR和CTCVR AUC平均分别提升1.01%和1.02%。2. **在线A/B测试**（5天）：相比ESCM²-IPS，CVR提升17.35%、CTCVR提升5.60%、CPA降低23.36%。3. **消融实验**：准确估计后验p(Z|X,C,V)显著优于不使用Z或简单假设Z~N(0,I)的方法。4. **潜在转化数据**：在训练验证阶段未点击但测试阶段点击的样本上，ESCIM-max的CVR AUC达0.6905（提升1.80%），CTCVR AUC达0.6289（提升3.66%），且预测分布更偏向高值，展现优越泛化能力。5. **超参数敏感性**：α_CF=1e-4时性能最佳，过大将损害性能（α_CF=1e-1时下降5.56%）。

Conclusion: ESCIM通过因果驱动的反事实标签生成，为未点击样本生成更合理的二元转化标签，有效缓解了样本选择偏差和数据稀疏问题。在公开数据集和真实工业场景中均验证了其优越性和鲁棒性，尤其在潜在转化数据上展现出色的泛化能力。未来可探索更精确的反事实标签生成流程以及减轻逆倾向加权不稳定性的方法。

Abstract: Accurately predicting conversion rate (CVR) is essential in various recommendation domains such as online advertising systems and e-commerce. These systems utilize user interaction logs, which consist of exposures, clicks, and conversions. CVR prediction models are typically trained solely based on clicked samples, as conversions can only be determined following clicks. However, the sparsity of clicked instances necessitates the collection of a substantial amount of logs for effective model training. Recent works address this issue by devising frameworks that leverage non-clicked samples. While these frameworks aim to reduce biases caused by the discrepancy between clicked and non-clicked samples, they often rely on heuristics. Against this background, we propose a method to counterfactually generate conversion labels for non-clicked samples by using causality as a guiding principle, attempting to answer the question, "Would the user have converted if he or she had clicked the recommended item?" Our approach is named the Entire Space Counterfactual Inference Multi-task Model (ESCIM). We initially train a structural causal model (SCM) of user sequential behaviors and conduct a hypothetical intervention (i.e., click) on non-clicked items to infer counterfactual CVRs. We then introduce several approaches to transform predicted counterfactual CVRs into binary counterfactual conversion labels for the non-clicked samples. Finally, the generated samples are incorporated into the training process. Extensive experiments on public datasets illustrate the superiority of the proposed algorithm. Online A/B testing further empirically validates the effectiveness of our proposed algorithm in real-world scenarios. In addition, we demonstrate the improved performance of the proposed method on latent conversion data, showcasing its robustness and superior generalization capabilities.

</details>
